chapters.title: He was dismissed if they did not acknowledge his message to the Arabs
paragraphs: [Chapter: If they do not acknowledge his message to the Arabs]

Or they did not acknowledge his message to the Arabs or others, but rather said about him what the Arab polytheists used to say, that he was a poet, or a magician, or A lying slanderer, and the like, and it is said: They have this assessment, so your evidence is also false, and it is not permissible for you to use this assessment as evidence of your disbelief. To Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - with some of the words of the prophets before him, whether you believe Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - in everything he says:

Or in some of it, or you have denied it, then your evidence is false, so it requires that your religion is invalid according to every estimate, and whatever is proven to be false according to every estimate, then it is It is false in the matter itself, so it is proven that it is false in the matter itself, and that is because if you deny Muhammad, there is no way left for you to know him. He believed other prophets, so in addition to his disbelief, it is impossible to say that others were truthful. Rather, whoever believes that he is a lie and believes others is not a scholar. With the truthfulness of others, rather he is confirming them without knowledge, and if he is not aware of their truthfulness then it is not permissible for him to argue with their words at all. That is a statement on his part without knowledge and he is arguing about something of which he has no knowledge. Indeed, the evidence indicating the truthfulness of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - is greater. There is more evidence that indicates the truthfulness of Moses and Jesus, and their miracles are greater than the miracles of others, and the book with which they were sent is more honorable than the book. With which someone else was sent and the law with which he brought

More perfect than the law of Moses and Jesus - peace be upon them - and his nation is more perfect in all virtues than the nation of this and that, and it is not found in the Torah and the Gospel. Beneficial knowledge and righteous deeds unless it is in the Qur’an or something like it or from it, and in the Qur’an there is beneficial knowledge and righteous deeds that are not found. The like of it is in the Torah and the Gospel. There is no attack by the enemies of the prophets against Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, except that it can Directing that and greater attack against Moses and Jesus.

This is a simplified sentence elsewhere, and we have not simplified it here. Because the answer to their words does not require that, so it is impossible to acknowledge the prophecy of Moses and Jesus - peace be upon them - while denying the prophecy of Muhammad - May God’s prayers and peace be upon him - and no one does that except one of the most ignorant and misguided of people, or one of the most stubborn among them and following his own desires, and that is These people used as evidence what they reported from the prophets, and they did not mention the evidence indicating their truthfulness. Rather, they took that as a given and demanded To use as evidence what they narrated from the prophets before him and what they narrated from him as proof of the validity of their religion.

This is a conclusive argument whether they believe him or deny him. If they believe him, their religion is invalid, and if they deny him, their religion is invalid. If they believe him, then their religion is invalid. It was known that he called them and all the people of the earth to believe in him and obey him, just as he called on Christ, Moses, and other messengers, and that he annulled what They are against him from the union and elsewhere, and he declared them unbelievers in other places, and for this reason the mere belief that Muhammad is the Messenger of God, even to the Arabs, is obligatory. The invalidity of the religion of the Christians and Jews and every religion that contradicts his religion. For whoever is a messenger of God does not lie to God and Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace. Peace and blessings of God be upon him - it is known from him that he called on the Christians and Jews to believe in him and obey him, just as he called on others, and that he declared disbelief to those who did not believe. With it and His promise of the Fire, and this is frequently reported from him, the public and the private teach it, and in the Qur’an there is much mention of that, as he said - Almighty -:

{The disbelievers from among the People of the Book and the polytheists were not to dissipate until clear proof came to them} [Al-Bayyinah: 1] (1) {A messenger from God reciting pages Purified} [Al-Baynah: 2] (2) {In it are valuable books} [Al-Baynah: 3] (3) {And those who were given the Book did not separate except after clear proof had come to them} [Al-Baynah: 4] (4) {And they were not commanded except to worship God, sincere to Him in religion, being upright, and to establish prayer and pay zakat. That is the religion of value.} [Al-Baynah: 5] (5) {Indeed, those The disbelievers from among the People of the Book and the polytheists in the fire of Hell to abide therein. Those are the worst of creation.} [Al-Bayyinah:

6] (6) {Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - these are the best of creation} [Al-Bayyinah: 7] (7) {Their reward with their Lord is the Gardens of Eden flowing from Beneath it are the rivers, to abide therein forever. God is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him. That is for him who fears his Lord.} [Al-Baynah: 8]

And He Almighty said: {Allah bears witness that there is no god but Him, and the angels and the possessors of knowledge, standing with justice. There is no god but He, the Mighty. The Wise} [Al Imran: 18] (18) {Indeed, the religion with Allah is Islam, and those who were given the Book did not differ except after knowledge had come to them out of envy among themselves and He who disbelieves in the signs of God, for God is quick to reckon.} [Al Imran: 19] (19) {And if they dispute with you, say: I have submitted my face to God and to those who follow, and say to those who have been given The scribes and the unlettered. You have submitted to Islam, and if they have submitted, then they have been guided; but if they turn away, then it is your responsibility only to convey the message, and Allah is Ever Seeing of His servants.} [Al Imran:

The disbelief of the Jews and Christians has been mentioned in more than one place, as God Almighty says about the Christians: “Indeed, those who say that God is the Messiah have disbelieved.” The son of Mary. Say, “Who can possess anything against God if He wishes to destroy the Messiah, the son of Mary, and his mother, and all who are on earth?” [Al-Ma’idah: 17].

And God Almighty said: Also, “Those who say, “Indeed, God is the Messiah, the son of Mary,” have disbelieved. And the Messiah said, “O Children of Israel, worship God, my Lord and your Lord.” Indeed, whoever associates anything with God, God has forbidden to him Paradise, and his abode is the Fire, and the wrongdoers will have no helpers.} [Al-Ma’idah: 72] (72) {Indeed, those who say have disbelieved. Indeed, God is the third of three, and there is no god but one god, and if they do not desist from what they say, a painful punishment will surely touch those who disbelieve among them.} [Al-Maeda: 73] (73) {Will they not repent to God and ask His forgiveness? And God is Forgiving, Merciful} [Al-Maeda:

74] (74) {The Messiah, the son of Mary, is nothing but a messenger. Messengers have passed away before him, and his mother was a truthful one. They used to eat food. See how We will explain to them. verses, then see how they will be failed.} [Al-Ma’idah: 75] (75) {Say, “Do you worship besides God that which possesses no power for you to harm or benefit? And God is the Hearer.” The All-Knowing} [Al-Ma’idah: 76] (76) {Say, “O People of the Book, do not go to extremes in your religion other than the truth, and do not follow the inclinations of a people who went astray before and were led astray.” They have strayed from the right path} [Al-Maeda: 77].

And God Almighty said: {O People of the Book, do not go to extremes in your religion and do not say about God anything but the truth. Indeed, the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, is the Messenger of God. And His word which He conveyed to Mary, and a spirit from Him: So believe in God and His messengers, and do not say: “Desist from three.” It is better for you. God is but one God, Glory be to Him. That he should have a son; to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and God is sufficient as a disposer of affairs.} [An-Nisa: 171] (171) {The Messiah will not disdain to be a servant. To God, nor to the angels who are brought near, and whoever refrains from worshiping Him and is arrogant - He will gather them all to Himself} [An-Nisa:

172] (172) {But as for those who believe and do righteous deeds, He will give them their rewards in full, and increase them of His bounty; but as for those who disdain and are arrogant, Then He will punish them with a painful punishment, and they will find for themselves besides Allah no guardian or helper.} [An-Nisa: 173] (173) {O people, there has come to you proof from your Lord. And We sent down to you a clear light.} [An-Nisa: 174] (174) {So as for those who believe in God and hold fast to Him, He will admit them into mercy from Him and bounty. And He guides them to Himself on a straight path.} [An-Nisa: 175]

And He Almighty said: {And the Jews said, “Uzair is the son of God,” and the Christians said, “The Messiah is the son of God.” That is what they say with their mouths, imitating the words of Those who disbelieved before - God killed them. How can they be saved?} [At-Tawbah: 30] (30) {They took their rabbis and monks as lords besides God, and the Messiah is the son of Maryam, and they were not commanded except to worship one God; there is no god but Him. Glory be to Him above what they associate with Him.” [At-Tawbah: 31].

And He - the Most High - said: {And when God said, “O Jesus, son of Mary, did you say to the people, ‘Take me and my mother as two gods besides God?’” He said, “Glory be to You, what will happen?” It is permissible for me to say what I have no right to say. If I said it, then you knew it. You know what is in my soul, but I do not know what is in your soul. Indeed, you are the Knower of the unseen.} [Al-Maeda: 116] (116) {I did not say to them except what you commanded me to do: ‘Worship God, my Lord and your Lord,’ and I was a witness over them as long as I was among them. But when you took me, I was You are the Watcher over them and You are Witness over all things} [Al-Maeda: 117].
God Almighty said: “Indeed, those who say that God is the Messiah, the son of Mary, have disbelieved.” [Al-Ma’idah: 17] in the two places.

And He - the Almighty - said: {Those who say, “Indeed, Allah is the third of three” have disbelieved} [Al-Ma’idah: 73] And He - the Most High - said: {And do not say: “Desist from three, is better for you”” [An-Nisa’: 171] .
And He - the Almighty - said: {And the Christians said: The Messiah is the Son of God} [At-Tawbah: 30].
The Christians said the three sayings, so God mentioned these sayings about them, but some people think that this is the saying of a sect. Among them, and this is the saying of a group of them.

As mentioned by a group of commentators, such as Ibn Jarir al-Tabari, al-Thalabi, and others, and then sometimes they narrate on the authority of al-Yaqubiyyah that Jesus is God. And on the authority of the Nestorians that he is the Son of God, and on the authority of the Mariusians, that he is the third of three, and sometimes they say of the Nestorians that he is the third of three, and on the authority of The monarchy means that He is God, and they explain their saying: He is the third of three things through the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.

What is correct is that all of these sayings are the sayings of the well-known Christian sects, the Melkite, Jacobite, and Nestorian sects, for these All sects believe in the three persons of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit, so they say that God is the third of three, and they say of Christ that He is God, and they say He is the Son of God, and they agree on the unity of divinity and humanity, and that what is united is the Word, and they agree on the doctrine of their faith, which This includes what they say:
We believe in one God, the Father, Almighty, Creator of the heavens and the earth, all that is seen and unseen, and in one Lord, Jesus Christ, the Son of God The only begotten of the Father
Before all ages, Light from Light, true God from true God, begotten, not created.
As for His saying - the Almighty -: {And do not say three} [An-Nisa: 171] and His saying: {Indeed, those who say, “Indeed, Allah is the third of three” have disbelieved} [Al-Ma’idah: 73].

They explained it with the well-known trinity mentioned in their trustworthiness. Among the people are those who say: God is the Messiah, the son of Mary. The Jacobites, and their saying “the third of three” is the saying of the Christians who believe in the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit, and they have placed God in it. The third of the three, and they called each of the three God and Lord, and a group interpreted it by making Jesus and his mother two gods to be worshiped without God.
Al-Suddi said in His saying - the Most High -: {Indeed, those who say that God is the third of three have disbelieved} [Al-Ma’idah: 73].

He said: The Christians said that God is the Messiah and his mother. That is what he said: “Did you say to the people, ‘Take me and my mother as two gods besides God?’” [Al-Maeda: 116] A third, stranger statement than that was said on the authority of Abu Sakhr, who said: It is the Jews’ saying that Uzair is the son of God, and the Christians’ saying that Christ is the son of God, so they made God the third of three, and this is weak. Sa’id bin The Penguin: In the news of the Christians, there is a sect among them called the Marianites, who say that Mary is a god and that Jesus is a god.

As for the first, it is directed, because the Christians who all agree on honesty say that God is the third of three, and God Almighty has forbidden them. About them saying that, God Almighty said: {O People of the Book, do not go to extremes in your religion, and do not say about God except the truth. Indeed, the Messiah, Jesus, is the son of Mary is the Messenger of God, and His word which He conveyed to Mary, and a spirit from Him. So believe in God and His Messengers, and do not say: “Desist.” [An-Nisa’:

171] So, Glory be to Him, in this verse, He mentioned the trinity and the union, and forbade them from them, and made clear that Christ is only the Messenger of God and His Word. He gave it to Mary and a spirit from Him.
And He said: {So believe in God and His Messengers} [An-Nisa: 171] Then He said: {And do not say three things: “Desist, that is better for you”} [An-Nisa: 171]

He did not mention his mother here. And His saying - the Most High -: {And His word which He delivered to Mary, and a spirit from Him} [An-Nisa’: 171] He said: Ma’mar, on the authority of Qatada, and His word which He delivered to Mary is He. His saying: Be and it was.
Likewise, he said: Qatada did not become Jesus by the word, but by the word he became Jesus.

Likewise, he said: Imam Ahmad in his work, which he compiled in his book in response to the Jahmiyah, and Al-Khallaal and Judge Abu Ya’la mentioned it about him. He said: Ahmad. Then Al-Jahm made a claim and said: We found in the Book of God a verse indicating that the Qur’an was created. We said: Which verse? He said: A statement. God {The Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, is only the Messenger of God and His Word} [An-Nisa: 171] So we said:

Indeed, God has prevented you from understanding Jesus - peace be upon him - in the Qur’an, using words that do not apply to the Qur’an. Because Jesus brings forth a breath, a newborn, a child, a boy, and a boy who eats and drinks, and he is addressed with commands and prohibitions. The promise and the threatened is from the descendants of Noah and from the descendants of Abraham, and it is not permissible for us to say in the Qur’an what we say about Jesus. Did you hear God say? In the Qur’an, what did Jesus say? But the meaning in his saying - glory be to Him - {The Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, is only the Messenger of God, and His word which He delivered to Mary, and a spirit from Him} [An-Nisa’:

171] So the word that he delivered to Mary when he said: To him be, and Jesus was with be, and Jesus is not the being, but with the being he was, so the be is from God. His saying: The universe is not a created being, and the Christians and the Jahmiya lied to God about Jesus, and that is because the Jahmiya said: Jesus is the Spirit of God. And his word; Because the word is created.

The Christians said: The spirit of God is from the essence of God, and the word of God is from the essence of God, just as it is said: This piece of clothing is from this garment. And we said that Jesus By the Word He was, and Jesus is not the Word.

Ahmad said, and as for his saying - glory be to Him - {And a spirit from Him} [An-Nisa: 171] He says of His matter, the spirit was in it, as in His saying: {And He subjected to you what is in The heavens and all that is on the earth, all of it.} [Al-Jathiya: 13] He says of His command, and the interpretation of the Spirit of God only means that it is a spirit by the word of God, God created them. As it is said: the servant of God and the sky of God, and in a copy there is a spirit possessed by God that God created.

And he said: Al-Shu’bi in His saying - the Most High -: {And His word which He conveyed to Maryam} [An-Nisa’: 171] the word when He said: His is “be,” so Jesus used “be” and not “be.” Jesus is the universe, but it was through the universe.

And he said: Laith, on the authority of Mujahid, a spirit from him. He said: A messenger from him. Mujahid meant to say: {So We sent to her our spirit, and he appeared to her as a perfect human being} [Maryam: 17] (17) {She said, “Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Gracious from you, if you are pious} [Maryam: 18] (18) {He said, “I am only the messenger of your Lord” [Maryam: 19]

The meaning is that Jesus was created from the spirit, and he is Gabriel, the Holy Spirit. He was called a spirit just as he was called a word. Because he was created by the word, and the Christians say in their faithfulness that he was incarnated by Mary and by the Holy Spirit. Because it is the same in the previous books, but they thought that the Holy Spirit is an attribute of God and made it His life and power, and He is Lord. This was a mistake on their part, for none of the prophets called the life of God, nor His power, nor any of His attributes, the Holy Spirit. Rather, the Holy Spirit in In more than one place in the words of the prophets - peace be upon them - what is meant by it is what God sends down to the hearts of the prophets, such as revelation, guidance, and support. What is meant by it is the king. This is also in the interpretation of Ibn al-Sa’ib on the authority of Abu Salih on the authority of Ibn Abbas that Jesus, son of Mary, received a group of Jews. When they saw him, they said:
The sorcerer, the son of the witch, and the doer, the son of the doer, came, and they slandered him and his mother. When Jesus heard that,
He said, “Oh God, you are my Lord, and I came from your spirit, and with your word you created me, and I did not come to them of my own accord.” He mentioned the entirety of the hadith.

And God Almighty said: {And she who has maintained her chastity, so We have breathed into her of Our Spirit and made her and her son a sign to the worlds} [Al-Anbiya’: 91] And God Almighty said -: {And Maryam, the daughter of Imran, who guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her of Our Spirit} [Al-Tahrim: 12] This agrees with His saying - the Most High -: {So We sent to her Our spirit, and he appeared to her as a perfect human being} [Maryam: 17] (17) {She said, “Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Gracious from you, if you are pious.” [Maryam: 18] (18) {He said, “I am only a messenger.” Your Lord} [Maryam: 19].

What is meant here is that whether they believed Muhammad or disbelieved him, then their religion must be invalid according to both estimates, for if he was a prophet He is truthful. He has conveyed on behalf of God in this book the disbelief of the Christians in more than one place, and he called them to believe in him and commanded their struggle. So who knows? He is a prophet, even if it is to a specific sect, he must be believed in everything he informs, and he has informed of the disbelief and misguidance of the Christians, and if it is proven This does not make it unnecessary for them to use anything from the books or reason as evidence. Rather, it is known from the general point of view that everything they use as evidence is correct. Their religion is false, even if it does not explain the falsity of their arguments in detail. Because the prophets only speak the truth, just as Christ - peace be upon him - when he ruled that those among the Jews who lied to him were disbelievers, that was all that he protested. The Jews say otherwise is invalid, so everything that opposes the infallible saying of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - is invalid, even if they disbelieve Muhammad. A general and absolute denial, and they said, “He is not a prophet at all, nor was he sent to anyone, neither to the Arabs nor to anyone else.” Rather, he was a liar. He refrained from this. To believe in the prophecy of others, for the way by which the prophecy of Moses and Jesus was known is by which the prophecy of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - was known - by The first is when they say:

The prophecy of Moses and the Messiah was known through miracles, and the miracles were known through frequent transmission to us. They were told of the miracles of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace. And peace be upon him - the greatest, and its frequency is the most eloquent, and the book that Muhammad brought - may God bless him and grant him peace - is the most complete, and his nation is the best, and the laws of his religion He is best, and Moses brought justice, and Jesus brought it to perfection with grace, and he is
- May God bless him and grant him peace - He combined justice and virtue in his law.

If it is possible for someone to say that he is a liar and slanderer, there is someone else who is more deserving of that being said about this false assessment. So, by their denial of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - invalidates all the prophecies they have. If he ruled over one of the two things, he ruled the like of it, so how about that? Is he better than him? If someone said that Aaron, Joshua, David, and Solomon were prophets, and Moses would not have been a prophet, or that David, Solomon, and Joshua were Prophets, and Christ was not a prophet. Or he said what Samaria says:
That Joshua was a prophet, and those after him, like David, Solomon, and Christ, were not prophets. Or he said what the Jews say: David and Solomon

And Isaiah, and Habakkuk, and Melicha, and Amoz, and Daniel were prophets, and the Messiah, the son of Mary, was not a prophet. This was a well-known contradictory statement. Falsehood, for those from whom these people denied prophecy are more deserving of prophecy and more complete prophecy than those for whom they confirmed it, and there are evidences of prophecy. The most complete is better, so how is it permissible to prove the prophecy of the virtuous prophet rather than the virtuous one, and this becomes as if someone said that Zufar and Ibn al-Qasim Al-Muzani and Al-Athram were jurists, while Abu Hanifa, Malik, Al-Shafi’i and Ahmad were not jurists, or he said:
Al-Akhfash, Ibn Al-Anbari, and Al-Mubarrad were grammarians.

Al-Khalil, Sibawayh, and Al-Farra’ were not grammarians, or he said: Sahib Al-Maliki, Al-Musbahi, and other medical books were doctors. And Socrates, Galen and the like were not doctors, or he said: Koshyar, Al-Kharqi and the like knew the science of the body. Ptolemy and the like had no knowledge of the form.

Whoever says: David, Solomon, Melicha, Amoz, and Daniel were prophets and Muhammad bin Abdullah was not a prophet, his contradiction is clearer. The corruption of his statement is clearer than all of this, and so is he who said:

Moses and Jesus are messengers, and the Torah and the Gospel are two books revealed from God, and Muhammad is not a messenger, and the Qur’an was not sent down from God. The invalidity of his statement is extremely apparent and clear to anyone who ponders what Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - brought with it and what came before him. And he pondered his book and the books before it and the verses of his prophecy and the verses of these people’s prophecy and the laws of his religion and the laws of these people’s religion and these The sentence is detailed and explained elsewhere, but what is meant here is to point out the generality of their response, and these people did not come. With a single piece of evidence that indicates the truthfulness of the prophets whom they used as evidence. If someone were to look at them and disbelieve in these prophets, all of them would be polytheists. As for the atheists, what they mentioned was no proof for them, nor is there any proof for them against the Muslims who acknowledge the prophethood of these people. The majority of The Muslims only knew the truthfulness of these prophets by telling Muhammad that they were prophets, so it is impossible for them to believe in the branch while slandering it. The basis by which they knew their truthfulness.

Also, the way in which the prophecy of these people was known was through what was proven of their miracles and their reports, so the prophecy of Muhammad is known through what was proven Of his miracles and news through the first method, it is forbidden for any of the Muslims to believe in the prophecy of one of these people despite his disbelief. To Muhammad in a word of what he brought.

chapters.title: Chapter on the response to the Christians in their claim that Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, did not give good tidings
paragraphs: [Chapter: The response to the Christians in their claim that Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, was not given good tidings.]

It should be known that many Christians rely in prophecies on the prophets’ good news about those who will come after them. So they say: The Messiah - peace be upon him - was given good tidings by the prophets before him, unlike Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - for no prophet gave good tidings of him. The answer to these has two aspects.
One of them is to say:

Rather, the good news of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - in the previous books is greater than the good news of Christ, as the Jews interpret. The good news of Christ is that he is not Jesus, son of Mary, but rather someone else whom they are waiting for, and in reality they are only waiting for the Antichrist. For he is the one whom the Jews follow, and seventy thousand mutils from the Jews of Isfahan go out with him, and the Muslims kill them with him, until he says Trees and stones, O Muslim, this is a Jew behind me. Come and kill him, as that was proven in the Sahih on the authority of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - and it was also proven In the Sahih on the authority of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - he said:

“Jesus, son of Mary, will descend from heaven on the white minaret east of Damascus, break the cross, kill the pig, and impose the tax. The Messiah of guidance, Jesus, son of Mary, will kill the one-eyed Messiah of misguidance, the Antichrist, a few ten paces from the gate of Lydda, so that it may be clarified.

To the people that man is not a god, so he who claims that he is God should be killed, and he is innocent of what he claims about him who claims that he is God. He is an impostor and a liar. Such are the good tidings about Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - in previous books, and some of the People of the Book may interpret them. Unlike its interpretation, as it has been explained in another place, the words in the mention of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - were explained in the books that are in my hands. The People of the Book has another place.
The second answer:

To say that it is not a requirement for the Prophet to bring good news of it to those who come before him, just as Moses was a messenger to Pharaoh, and he did not come to Pharaoh with good news of it. Likewise, Al-Khalil - peace be upon him - was sent to Nimrod, but no prophet’s good news was brought to him. Likewise, Noah, Hud, Salih, Shuaib, and Lot were brought to him. These people did not bring good news to their people despite the fact that they were true prophets. The evidence of the Prophet’s prophecy is not limited to news. Rather, the evidence of prophecy, some of which are miracles and some of which are not miracles, as has been explained in another place, and these Christians are only The basis of their religion regarding the Trinity, the unity, and other things is hearing, and it is their claim that the divine books stated this, not their basis. There is reason in it, so if it becomes clear that despite their disbelief in Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - it is impossible to

The prophecy of others is proven. Their evidence is not based on auditory matters. As for intellectual matters, if they cling to some of them, they acknowledge that Their argument regarding it is weak, and it is in contradiction to their doctrine, more evidence than it is for their doctrine, and we will show, God Almighty willing, that there is no evidence. They have neither hearing nor reason, but all of that is an argument against them.

As for their representation of the letter with the document on the back of which the payment was written, it is a false and inconsistent representation. Because acknowledging repayment is acknowledging the extinguishment of the debt, and there is no contradiction between the confirmation of the debt at first and its extinguishment at the end with repayment. Rather, it is possible with this. His claim: As for whoever states that he is the Messenger of God, it is not possible for him to acknowledge that he is the Messenger of God in some of what he prophesied about God and not in some. It is possible to follow some of his book which he stated was revealed from God and not part, for if he is truthful in what he says:

He is the Messenger of God. He was infallible in what he reported on the authority of God. It is not permissible for him to be lied to about any of it, whether intentionally or by mistake. It is necessary to follow The book that he brought is from God, and it is not possible to reject anything of what he mentioned that he brought from God, even if he was lying in a single word of it. He was told about it on the authority of God, for he is one of the liars and fabricators, so it is not permissible for anything of their religion or the religion of others to be used as evidence simply by being told about God, and not merely by his information and words, even if he does not mention that he reported on the authority of God, just as it is not permissible for anyone else to know that he He is lying when he says:
I am the Messenger of God, like Musaylimah al-Hanafi, al-Aswad al-‘Ansi, Tulayha al-Asadi, al-Harith al-Dimashqi, and Baba
Rumi and others like them are liars.

And one of the Muslims, even if God does not hold him accountable for forgetfulness or error. Rather, the Messenger as well, even if he is not held accountable for forgetfulness. The error is in something other than what is conveyed about God according to the Salaf, the Imams, and the majority of Muslims, but what is conveyed about God is not permissible. There is an error in it, for if it is permissible for him to convey about God what He did not say, and that is established and people take it from him, believing that God said it - and God did not say it - this was contrary to the intent of the message, and he was not a messenger of God in that, but rather he was a liar in that, even if he did not He does it intentionally, and if he conveys on behalf of God what he did not say and is truthful in that, then he who says something untrue about God has been spoken truthful, and he who says something about God that is not true has been confirmed. He says it, even if it is not intentional, and in such a case it is impossible for God to believe him in everything he tells him about him or to establish signs for him. And the proofs are what indicate his truthfulness in everything that he tells about him, even though the matter is not like that, and whoever the proofs and verses are based on his truthfulness in what He informs him about God. He is truthful in everything he informs about God. It is not possible for there to be any lie in his information about God, whether intentionally or intentionally. Wrong, and this is what all people, Muslims, Jews, and Christians, have agreed upon.

And others did not dispute that it is not permissible for an error to be established in his information about God. Rather, they disputed whether it is permissible for some error to occur. He corrects it and clarifies it, so it does not contradict the intent of the message, as was reported from the statement: “Those are the highest of the cranes, and their intercession is hoped for.” This There are two opinions about it among the people: some of them also forbade that and challenged the occurrence of that, and some of them said: they heard what he did not say, so it was The error is in their hearing and Satan has cast something into their hearing.

And whoever permitted that said: If the statement was made and what Satan said was abrogated, then there was nothing wrong with that, and that was evidence of his truthfulness. His honesty and religion, and he does not follow his own desires or insist on anything other than the truth, like the action of a seeker of leadership who insists on his mistake.

If there is nothing wrong with abrogating what it is certain that God sent down, then abrogating something like this is more likely to have nothing wrong with it. He provided evidence for that by saying: “And We did not send before you any messenger or prophet, but when he wished, Satan made his wish, and it was abrogated.” God does not cast Satan; then God establishes His signs, and God is All-Knowing, All-Wise.} [Al-Hajj: 52] (52) {To make what Satan casts a test for those in whose hearts Sickness, and hardened are their hearts, and indeed the wrongdoers are in far-off discord.} [Al-Hajj:

53] (53) {And that those who have been given knowledge may know that it is the truth from your Lord, and believe in it, so that their hearts are humbled before Him. Indeed, God is the guide of those who believe to A straight path} [Al-Hajj: 54]

And according to every statement, people are agreed that the one whom God sent and who established the signs is truthful in what he conveys about God: what he conveys is not Unless it is true, otherwise the verses indicating his truthfulness indicate the truthfulness of someone who is not truthful, and the invalidity of the meaning of certain evidence. Abstaining.

The truthfulness, which is the meaning of the verses and proofs of the prophets, is that his information from God is consistent with the one who informs him, and does not contradict him intentionally or intentionally. A mistake, even if someone says: I do not call a mistake a lie, or says: The one who makes a mistake is not guilty of his mistake.

It was said to him: This is of no use here, for the verses indicate that God sent him to convey His messages about him, and God does not send someone whom He knows. He is reporting something contrary to what he told him, just as it is not permissible to send someone who is deliberately lying to him. Rather, one of the people does not send someone he knows. He conveys something contrary to what He sent him with, and if he had known that He would say against him what he did not say and sent him with that, he would have been ignorant and foolish and not knowledgeable and wise. How can this be permissible for the most knowledgeable of scholars and the wisest of rulers? .

Also: The verses and proofs indicate his truthfulness in everything he informs about God, and that God believes him in everything he informs him, so he refrains from saying: That he should not be truthful in any of that, and it is forbidden for God to believe in all of that who does not believe in all of that, for believing someone who does not believe A lie, and lying is forbidden by God.

If it becomes clear that the one who mentioned that he is the Messenger of God is either a truthful Messenger in everything that he conveys, then this is a contradiction. His news; Because they are all truthful, and if he is not truthful, even in a word, then he is not a messenger of God, so nothing that he tells about God cannot be used as evidence. The representation of someone who stated that he is the Messenger of God that he acknowledged the fulfillment of his document was false, as the owner of the document who acknowledged its fulfillment After that, he had an argument and then fulfilled it.

Whoever states that he is the Messenger of God is either telling the truth or lying, and according to both estimates it is not permissible for some of his words to be used as evidence and not others, and if he said He who said: My intention is to show that it is contradictory, and that his very words show that it was not sent to us, and that our religion is true, just as the same words of the one who He has the right and he is the one who acknowledges the fulfillment. It was said:

If his words are contradictory, then he is not a messenger, and in that case it is not permissible for you to use as evidence anything of what he conveyed from God other than the one who acknowledged the fulfillment. His acknowledgment is accepted on his own behalf, for he bears witness against himself of loyalty, and the acknowledger’s acknowledgment is on himself and his witness is on himself. It is acceptable even if he is an infidel and a sinner, contrary to his testimony and information about God.

Whoever likens the acknowledgment of the one who acknowledges himself to the statement of the one who says: He is the Messenger of God, this indicates the utmost ignorance of his analogy and consideration. And acting. The confession of the one who makes the confession against himself is proof against him, even if he is a sinner known to lie, it is not the same as a person’s testimony against others. His testimony against others is not accepted if he is known to be a liar, so what about the one who testified against God that God sent him?

The one who acknowledges himself can have his confession made against himself accepted, but his claim against someone else may not be accepted. Likewise, a witness may have his testimony accepted regarding something that is not He is an opponent therein and his testimony is not accepted regarding what he claimed.

As for whoever says: He is the Messenger of God, it is not possible for him to believe in some of what he tells about God and to lie in some of it. Rather, if he is a liar in One word, then he is not a messenger of God, so his words cannot be used as evidence, even if it is assumed that the words in themselves are true, but attributing them to God is God sent him with it and inspired it. He cannot be truthful in it if he lies in a single word. Because God does not send a liar.

And if he is not lying about a single word, then he must be believed in everything he tells, for it is not possible to believe him in some of what he tells about God. Not to mention any other person, other than the confessor and the witness.
If the intention was to point out his contradiction, then this was an argument that he is not a messenger, so this will not benefit them even though it has become clear that he is not Paradoxically.

If the intention is to oblige Muslims to do it, then we have shown that it is not obligatory for them in several ways. This indicates that it is not permissible for them to do so. They may use as evidence some of the words of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - whether they believe him or deny him.

Then it is said to them secondly: in the answer to the representation by the document: Acknowledging the fulfillment contradicts the fulfillment of the truth, and as for the Qur’an that came Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - there is nothing in his informing that he was sent to Quraysh and then to the Arabs that contradicts his informing that he was sent To all people: People of the Book and others.

Nor is it in his telling that he was sent to the Children of Israel and God addressing them by saying: {O Son of Israel} [Taha: 80] what It prevents him from being sent to Jews other than the Children of Israel and to Christians and polytheists, and he never said: I was not sent except To the Arabs, and he did not say anything that indicates this. Rather, it is proven by mutawatir transmission that he said: It is sent to all jinn and mankind. The People of the Book and others, even if it were assumed that he said: It was not sent except to the Arabs, and then he said:

Indeed, I was sent to the People of the Book. It would have been sent to the People of the Book after it was sent to the Arabs, as He said: {Say: I do not find anything in what was revealed. It is forbidden to anyone to eat unless it is a carcass, or spilled blood, or the flesh of a swine.” [Al-An’am: 145]

He also said: {He only forbade to you carrion, and blood, and the flesh of swine} [An-Nahl: 115] Then after this, God forbade other things, so there was no denial. Prohibiting it in the first time and proving that it was forbidden in the second time is a contradiction.

But religion becomes apparent if it obligates something and then abrogates its obligation, just as the obligation of charity is abrogated before the negotiations. In such a case, the text is adhered to. The abrogator is not the abrogated, just as he clings to the acknowledgment of fulfillment that abrogates the acknowledgment of the debt.

chapters.title: Chapter on invalidating the Christians’ inference of the validity of their religion based on what came from previous prophets
paragraphs: [Chapter: Invalidating the Christians’ evidence for the validity of their religion based on what came from the previous prophets] [Methods of proving the prophecy of the previous prophets It is proof of the prophecy of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace.]

We have mentioned that it is not permissible for them to use anything from the Qur’an or what has been transmitted from Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - as evidence unless they believe in his message. And while his message is disbelieved, it is not possible to acknowledge the prophecy of anyone else, nor to use any of the words of the prophets as evidence, thus denying them. It necessitates their disbelief in someone else, so if the prophethood of someone else is proven, his prophethood is proven, and that necessitates the invalidity of their religion, so it is valid. Their evidence necessitates the invalidity of the signified, and the corruption of the signified necessitates the corruption of the evidence. The evidence is binding on the signified, and if it is verified The necessary is confirmed, and if the necessary is absent, the binding is absent. If the evidence is proven, the indicated is proven, and if the indicated is corrupted, then it is binding. Corruption of evidence, for falsehood is not supported by sound evidence.

If Muhammad is the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - then their religion must be invalid, and if their religion is invalid it is not permissible for there to be sound evidence of Its authenticity, and if he was not the Messenger of God, then it is not permissible to use his words as evidence, so it has been proven that their inference from his words is invalid according to both estimates.

chapters.title: Methods of proving the prophecy of previous prophets are proof of the prophecy of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace
paragraphs: We mention here that it is not permissible for them to use as evidence the words of any of the prophets or messengers for the validity of their religion. Also, those who They argued that they, like Moses, David, Christ, and others, argued that they either knew that they were prophets based on evidence of their prophecy. Such as using their signs and proofs that are called miracles as evidence, or they believed that without knowledge or evidence, or They may have used this as an excuse against the Muslims because they accept the prophecy of these people, and in all respects their evidence based on what they say is not valid.

As for the first, because any way in which the prophecy of one of these prophets - peace be upon them - is proven, the prophecy of one of these prophets - peace be upon them - is proven. Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - with something like it and greater than it, and then, if they do not acknowledge the prophecy of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - although all Evidence that indicates the prophecy of Moses, David, Jesus, and others indicates the prophecy of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - they had to have refuted their evidence. So they made it exist in the absence of its meaning, and if the evidence is invalidated, its meaning is invalidated, for it only indicates if it is necessary for the meaning.

If it sometimes exists with the signified and sometimes it does not exist, it is not necessary for it, so it is not evidence; Whoever makes miracles evidence of the prophecy of a prophet and says: A miracle is an extraordinary act coupled with a sound challenge from The opposition, and other things mentioned in this regard, and they made that evidence of the prophecy of Moses, Jesus, and other prophets.

It was said to him: If this is evidence, then it is evidence of the prophecy of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and if it is not evidence, then it is not evidence of prophecy. Moses and Jesus, for miracles have been proven from Muhammad unless the like of him has been proven from anyone else, and the narration of his miracles is more frequent than Transmitting the miracles of Jesus and others, so it is impossible to believe in his signs while disbelieving in the signs of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace.

And if they say: The miracles of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - were not frequent among us, it is said: It is not a condition of frequency that they be frequent among a specific sect. Rather, this is what the polytheists, the Magians, and others say. The miracles of Moses and Christ - peace be upon them - do not occur frequently among us. Rather, they occur frequently. The news of every person is with those who saw those who were watching him or who saw those who saw them, and so on.

It is known that the companions of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - who saw him and reported on his miracles were twice as numerous as the companions of Christ - peace be upon him - and their followers. Those who reported this on the authority of the Companions also do so. It is necessary to believe in the miracles of Christ - peace be upon him - to believe in the miracles of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace. Peace and blessings of God be upon him - and part of denying the miracles of Muhammad is denying the miracles of Christ.

And if they say: The prophecy of the Messiah was known through the glad tidings of the prophets before him, it is said: And in the previous books there are good tidings of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace. Peace and blessings of God be upon him - such as what is in it of good news of Christ and more, and some of them will come, God Almighty willing.

And if they interpret those good tidings about Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - in a way that prevents their significance, they will be told, “And the Jews interpret the good tidings of the Messiah.” Which prevents its significance to Christ.

So if they say: These interpretations are false in well-known ways, it will be clear to them that these interpretations are also false in similar ways, and even stronger. There is no type of evidence that indicates the prophecy of Moses and the Messiah except that its evidence for the prophecy of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - is stronger and more numerous. Therefore, it is necessary that the prophecy of Moses and the Messiah be proven that the prophethood of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - is proven, and from challenging the prophecy of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - Contesting the prophecy of Moses and the Messiah.
And if they say: Christ is God, it will be said to them: Proving that he was God if it were possible is more remote than proving that he was a messenger. So how if it were? Abstaining? .

This is because they have nothing to indicate his divinity except what they transmit from the sayings of the prophets or the supernatural, and the supernatural do not indicate Divinity, for the prophets still came with signs that were extraordinary and did not indicate the divinity of any of them.

As for the sayings of the prophets - peace be upon them - there is no doubt that their indication of his message and the message of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - is clearer than that. Its indication of the divinity of Christ, so it is impossible to use it as evidence against the divinity of Christ without the message of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and his message Christ and when it was proven that

chapters.title: Nullifying the Christians’ claim to the divinity of Christ, peace be upon him
paragraphs: Muhammad is the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - the divinity of Christ has been invalidated, for he has declared disbelief whoever says: He is God or the Son of God. And so it is when It has been proven that Christ, the Messenger of God, is invalid because he is God, because his being God and his being the Messenger of God are contradictory.
[Invalidating the Christians’ claim to the divinity of Christ, peace be upon him]
And their saying that he is a god in his divinity and a messenger in his humanity is false in many ways.

Among them is that the one who was speaking to the people was either God or the Messenger of God. If he was God, his being the Messenger of God was invalid, even if The Messenger of God was a hero because he was God.

For this reason, when the one who spoke to Moses - peace be upon him - from the tree was God, the scriptures did not say that he was the Messenger of God, and this is possible in any way. In one way they explained the union, it is known that the people were hearing words from Christ in his well-known voice, and his voice did not differ or differ. His state when speaking changed, just as a person changes, and his state when speaking when the jinn came to him and if the jinn separated from him, then the jinn If he speaks in the language of an epileptic, the difference between that epilepsy and other people becomes apparent. Rather, the state of the epilepsy and the state of his speech and being heard from him are different. There are some words that he knows with certainty that he does not know them, and his mind has been absent to the point that
This appears to those present, but his voice and tone differ. So how about the One in whom the Lord of the Worlds is, the One with whom He speaks His words?
For there must be a difference greater than the difference between what is fabricated and what is not. The one who is struck by something that has no relation between them.

This shows that when Moses heard his words, he heard an extraordinary voice, contrary to the sounds he was accustomed to, and he saw extraordinary signs. And the wonders show that no one but God can speak of what he heard. As for Christ, there was no intermediary between his words and his voice. His long life and the words of other people are a difference that indicates that he is a prophet, in addition to indicating that he is a god, but it was only known that he is a prophet based on evidence. Separately, and his situation was no different, even though they say:

That the union was inherent to him from the time his humanity was created in the womb of his mother Mary, and forever, and the divinity of that humanity would never separate from him. Then it is It is known that his speech to the people, if it was the speech of the Lord of the Worlds, was not His Messenger, and if it was the speech of His Messenger, it was not the voice of the Lord. The two worlds.
The second aspect: His speech is the speech of a messenger and a prophet, as was proven about him in most places.

Third: The fate of the two things is one thing, as long as they remain as they are without impossibility, and mixing is forbidden according to the clear mind, but rather What is reasonable is that when they are united, they become transformed and mixed, like water with wine and milk, for if they become one thing, they become transformed and mixed.
Fourth:

That with unity, the two things become one thing, so God is the Messenger, and the Messenger is God. Since this is this, and if the god is other than the Messenger, then they are two things, no matter how they represent it in what they say, such as likening it to fire in Iron and the spirit in the body, this indicates the corruption of their saying: Whenever iron is struck or placed in water, it becomes the cause of fire. Likewise, if the body is hungry or crucified and suffers, that pain afflicts the soul, so it is necessary that the Lord of the Worlds must have afflicted the pain of hunger. Thirst, as well as beatings and crucifixion, according to what they say, and this is worse than what the Jews said:
That he is poor, that he is stingy, and that he is affected by idle talk.

chapters.title: The Muslims did not believe the prophecy of any of these except with the prophecy of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace
paragraphs: [Chapter: The Muslims did not believe the prophecy of any of these except with the prophecy of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace.]

And if their intention was to argue that against the Muslims, they would be told: Firstly, this is a controversial argument, so what is your basis for what is between you and By God, in believing one person and disbelieving another, even though the indication of truthfulness in them is the same, rather it is more evident in the one you disbelieved, if it is a necessary truth. Believing those whom you disbelieved has corrupted your religion, and if it is false, then your evidence for your religion with it is invalid, so it is proven that they are with Muhammad’s disbelief - may God bless May God bless him and grant him peace - it is not right for them to use as evidence the words of any of the prophets - peace be upon them.

And it was said to them, secondly: Muslims only knew the truthfulness of these prophets by what indicated to them the truthfulness of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and if not Muhammad was truthful. They did not know the truth of these people, so your evidence is invalid. And if he was truthful, then the Christian religion is invalid, so the evidence of its authenticity is invalid, so its invalidity is proven. Guide them to every appreciation.

And it was said to them thirdly: Muslims did not believe the prophecy of any of these people except with the prophecy of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - even if it was said that they They knew this through another way, for the evidence that indicates the truthfulness of one of them indicates the truthfulness of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - through the first way. They can believe a prophet while disbelieving Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace.

And it was said to them fourthly: They only believe Moses and Jesus who gave good tidings about Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - so if they had given good tidings about him then it is proven. His prophecy, and if they were not given good tidings of it, then they do not believe except in those who are given good tidings of it and in the Torah and the Gospel in which it is written.

If it is determined that this is not the case, then they do not accept the existence of Moses, Jesus, the Torah, and the Gospel sent down from God, in which there is no mention of Him - may God bless him and grant him peace. He said hello.
And if they say:

We believed these prophets without our knowledge of their truthfulness or any way to indicate their truthfulness. Because this is the religion of our fathers. We found them venerating these people and saying they are prophets, so we followed our fathers in that without knowledge, and this is it. It was said that if this is what you say about the prophets and about what they testified to, if they testified then it follows that they should not be. Knowing it, but rather following in it their fathers without knowledge in the way of the first, and with this the purpose is achieved, which is that what you are following is Belief in the religion of Christianity. You have no knowledge or evidence that it is true. Rather, in it you are following your fathers, just as you follow the Jews and polytheists. For their fathers.

There is no doubt that this is the condition of the Christians, and for this reason God called them misguidance in His saying: {And do not follow the inclinations of a people who had gone astray before and were led astray. They have strayed from the right path.} [Al-Maeda: 77]

And He Almighty said: {And He warns those who say, “Allah has taken a son. They have no knowledge of him, nor did their fathers.” [Al-Kahf: 4] And He Almighty said: {And indeed those who They differed concerning it; they were in doubt about it. They had no knowledge of it. Doubtful} [Al-Shura: 14].

For this reason, the Christians were known for their ignorance and misguidance, just as the Jews were known for their injustice, cruelty, and stubbornness. We reminded him that while Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - was disbelieved in one word, they could not use the statement of one of the prophets as evidence. On something of their religion or the religion of anyone else.

chapters.title: Chapter on refuting the Christians’ claim is the specificity of Islam due to the fact that its book is in the Arabic language
paragraphs: [Chapter: Refuting the Christians’ claim regarding the specificity of Islam because its book is in the Arabic language]
As for the fact that the Qur’an was revealed in the Arabic language alone, there are answers for it: one of them is:

To say that the Torah was revealed in the Hebrew language alone, and Moses - peace be upon him - only spoke in Hebrew, and likewise Christ did not speak the Torah, the Gospel, or anything else except in Hebrew. Likewise, the rest of the books are not revealed by God except in a language. One in the language to whom it was revealed and in the language of his people to whom he addresses first, then after that the books and the words of the prophets are conveyed to all Nations, either by it being translated for those who do not know the language of that book, or by the people learning the language of that book and knowing its meanings. Or by explaining to the addressee the meanings of what the Messenger - may God bless him and grant him peace - was sent to him with in his own tongue, even if he did not know the rest of it. He was sent with it.
God has told in the Qur’an what the messengers said to their people and what they said:

For them - and most of them were not Arabs - and God revealed it in the Arabic language, and at that time, the condition of the obligation is that the servants be able to understand what The Messenger was sent with it to them, and that happens by sending it in a language in which his intention is known. Then all people are able to know what he means by knowing it. That language, or they know the meaning of the Book by translating the one who translates its meaning, and this is possible for the servants, and whoever is not able to understand the words of the Messenger Unless he learns the language in which he was sent, he is obligated to do so, because what is obligatory is not fulfilled without it, it is obligatory in contrast to what is not fulfilled. It is obligatory only because of it, for it is not obligatory, and God does not burden a soul beyond what it can bear, neither in the original nor in its completion, so we do not need to say what is not fulfilled. What is obligatory except for it - and it is possible for the one who is accountable - it is obligatory, because what is not possible for the servants should not be entrusted with it, but it may be possible for him to do it. on it and they are not responsible for it.

Since ability is a condition for the obligation of Hajj, it is not necessary to achieve ability other than covering distances, for it is not a condition for the obligation. For this reason, it is obligatory for a person to perform Hajj from far and near if he is able.

The majority of people do not know the meanings of the divine books: the Torah, the Gospel, and the Qur’an, except by someone who clarifies and explains them to them, even if They knew the language, so it is obligatory for these people to seek knowledge by which they know what God has commanded them to do and forbidden them, and this is a quest. The knowledge imposed on creation, as well as what the Messenger - may God bless him and grant him peace - explained of the meanings of the Book that God revealed to him. Creation is seeking knowledge of that from those who know it, if knowledge of that does not come about merely by the tongue.

It is also narrated on the authority of Ibn Abbas - may God be pleased with them both - that he said: The interpretation of the Qur’an is in four aspects: an interpretation that the Arabs know from Her words and an explanation that no one is excused for being ignorant of, an explanation known to scholars, and an explanation known only to God - Blessed and Most High - so who He claimed to know, but he is a liar.
And God Almighty said, “And We did not send any messenger except in the language of his people, that he might make it clear to them.” [Ibrahim: 4] He did not say:

And We did not send any messenger except to his people, but he did not send him except in the language of his people to whom he first addressed him, so that he might explain to his people. He explained to his people what he wanted, and that was what was intended for them and for others. His people, to whom he first conveyed it, can convey it. He has the pronunciation, and they can convey the meaning from him to those who do not know the language, and others can learn his language from them. So he knows what he means, so the argument is based on creation, and guidance comes to them through someone transmitted from the Messenger:

Sometimes the meaning and sometimes the pronunciation; For this reason, it is permissible to transmit his hadith with its meaning, and the meanings of the Qur’an are permissible to be translated for those who do not know Arabic, according to the agreement of scholars.

Some of them permitted it to be read in a language other than Arabic when one was unable to read it in Arabic, and some of them permitted it absolutely, and the majority The scholars have prohibited it from being read in a language other than Arabic, although it is permissible for it to be translated for understanding in a language other than Arabic. It is also permissible to interpret it and explain its meanings. Even if the interpretation is not a recited Qur’an, the same applies to the translation. He said: The Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - “May God bless the man who heard a hadith from us.” So he conveyed it to those who did not hear it. Perhaps someone carrying jurisprudence is not a jurist, and perhaps someone carrying jurisprudence is being conveyed to someone who is more knowledgeable than him.”

He also said in the authentic hadith: “The guidance and knowledge with which God has sent me is like a rain that strikes the earth, and from it there are good masses.” It accepted the water, and it produced pasture and abundant grass, and there was a group of it that held the water, and God benefited the people through it, so they planted and watered. And there was a group of them, but they were bottoms that did not hold water or grow grass. This is the parable of one who understands the religion of God and what God has sent me with benefits him. Of guidance and knowledge, and the example of one who does not raise his head for that and does not accept the guidance of God with which I was sent.”

Then the Prophet - may God’s prayers and peace be upon him - called for someone who would convey his hadith, even if he did not agree on it, and said: “There may be someone who carries jurisprudence who is not a jurist, and perhaps someone who carries jurisprudence to Who is more knowledgeable than him?

Those who knew the Arabic language when God sent Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - were only found in the Arabian Peninsula and what surrounds it as a land. Hijaz, Yemen, and some of the Levant and Iraq, then it spread and became the majority of people living in the middle of the Arab world, even the Jews and Christians. Those in the middle of the earth speak Arabic, just as most Muslims speak it. Indeed, many Jews and Christians speak it. Arabic is better than what many Muslims speak.

This language has spread more than other languages, to the point that the ancient books are among the books of the People of the Book and among the books of the Persians. India, Greece, Copts, and others were Arabized in this language.

Knowing books written in Arabic and Arabic speech is easier for the general public than knowing books written in non-Arabic. The Hebrew, Syriac, Roman, Coptic, and other languages, even if a group of people know them, are those who know the Arabic language the most. Who knows one of these tongues?

Also, knowing what God has commanded His servants in general is what the nation transmitted from its Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - a frequent narration. They unanimously agreed upon it, such as the command to bear witness that there is no god but God, and that Muhammad is the Messenger of God, and that it was sent to all people, even the most illiterate. And other than their illiterate people, and performing the five daily prayers, paying zakat, fasting the month of Ramadan, and performing the Hajj to the Ancient House, whoever is able, is a way and an answer to it. Truthfulness, the prohibition of immoral acts and injustice, the command to believe in God, His angels, His books, and His messengers, and resurrection after death is what Muslims know it in general, and to know that, a person does not need to memorize the Qur’an. Rather, a person can know what was commanded. God has it on the tongue of His Messenger, even if he does not know the Arabic language, it is sufficient for him to recite the Fatihah of the Book and a surah along with it, and he prays them often. Of the Persians, Romans, Turks, Indians, Abyssinians, Berbers and others, they do not know how to speak Arabic in the usual way. They converted to Islam and became among the pious friends of God, and among them were those who memorized the entire Qur’an, and when he spoke to people, he could only speak to them. In his tongue, not in Arabic, and if he was addressed in Arabic, he would not understand what was said to him.

The second aspect: that Christ - peace be upon him - had a Hebrew tongue, and so did the tongues of the disciples who followed him first and then he sent them. To the nations, they address them and translate for them what Christ - peace be upon him - said, and if they say: The apostles of Christ have had their tongues turned to The tongues of those to whom it was sent.

It was said that this was transmitted in the messengers of Christ and in the messengers of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - whom he sent to the nations. There is no doubt that the messengers of God’s messengers As the messengers of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and Christ - peace be upon him - to the nations, they must know the language of those sent by the Messenger - may God bless him and grant him peace. And peace be upon them - or that there be with those people someone who understands their language and the language of the Messenger - may God bless him and grant him peace - to translate for them. If not Those to whom Christ was sent should have someone who knows Arabic, so his messenger must speak their language.

Likewise are the messengers of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - whom he sent to the nations. When the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - returned from Hudaybiyyah He sent his messengers to the people of the earth, so he sent to the Arab kings in Yemen, Hijaz, the Levant, and Iraq, and he sent to the Christian kings in the Levant. And Egypt captured their Copts, Romans, Arabs and others, and the Magi kings of Iraq and Khorasan were sent to the Persians.

Muhammad bin Saad said in Al-Tabaqat, he mentioned sending the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - messengers with his letters to kings and others calling them, and he mentioned What the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - wrote to people from the Arabs and others. Then he said: Muhammad bin Omar Al-Aslami informed us. He said: Tell me. Muammar bin Rashid and Muhammad bin Abdullah, on the authority of Al-Zuhri, on the authority of Ubayd Allah bin Abdullah, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, said:

On the authority of Al-Waqidi, Abu Bakr bin Abdullah bin Abi Sabrah narrated to us, on the authority of Al-Miswar bin Rifa’ah, and Abdul-Hamid bin Ja’far narrated to us On the authority of his father, on the authority of his grandmother

Al-Shifa’, and Abu Bakr bin Abdullah bin Abi Sabrah told us, on the authority of Muhammad bin Yusuf, on the authority of Al-Sa’ib bin Yazid, on the authority of Al-Ala’ bin Al-Hadrami Ibn Muhammad Al-Ansari told us, on the authority of Ja’far bin Amr (bin Ja’far bin Amr) bin Umayyah Al-Dhamri, on the authority of his family, on the authority of Amr bin The Umayyahs of Al-Damri included the hadith of some of them in the hadith of others. They said, “The Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - when he returned from Hudaybiyyah in Dhul-Hijjah In the year six, he sent to the kings inviting them to Islam, and wrote letters to them, and it was said, O Messenger of God, that kings do not read a book except It was sealed, so the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - took a silver seal on that day, a piece of which was inscribed with three lines. Muhammad is the Messenger of God. He concluded the letters with it, and six of them went out in one day, in Muharram, the seventh year, and each one of them began speaking. In the language of the people to whom he was sent.”

The Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - sent to Heraclius Dihya bin Khalifa Al-Kalbi and to Al-Muqawqis, owner of Egypt and Alexandria, Hatib Ibn Abi Balta'ah, and to Khosrow was Abdullah Ibn Hudhafa Al-Sahmi, and he sent to Al-Harith Ibn Abi Shimr Al-Ghassani, who was ostensibly a Christian. Damascus, so Shujaa bin Wahb Al-Asadi sent to him, and he sent to other than these people.

He also said: Al-Haytham bin Adi informed us, saying: Dalham bin Salih and Abu Bakr Al-Hudhali informed us on the authority of Abdullah bin Buraidah bin Al-Hasib Al-Islami said: Muhammad bin Ishaq narrated to us on the authority of Yazid bin Roman and Al-Zuhri, and Al-Hasan bin Amara narrated to us on the authority of Firas on the authority of Al-Sha’bi included the hadith of one of them in the hadith of another: that the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - said to his companions:

“Bring me all of you in the morning. When the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - prayed the dawn prayer, he would sit in his place of prayer for a little while, praising God and supplicating, then He turned to them and sent several to another and said:

- May God bless him and grant him peace - Be sincere to God in the matter of His servants, for whoever is informed about any of the affairs of the Muslims and then does not advise, God will forbid it from him. Paradise: Go and do not do as the messengers of Jesus, son of Mary, did, for they came to those near and left those far away, so they became, meaning the messengers and all of them. Among them is known by the language of the people to whom it was sent. The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, mentioned that and said: This is the greatest of God’s rights. Almighty - the Almighty - over them in the matter of His servants.

The third aspect: The Christians have many Arabs since the time of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - and everyone who understands the Arabic language can His understanding of the Qur’an, even if the origin of his language was Persian, Roman, Turkish, Indian, or Coptic, and those who sent this The writers are Christian scholars who read the Qur’an and understood from it what they understood, and they understand it in Arabic, and they used verses from the Qur’an as evidence. So how? With this, it is permissible for them to say, “How can we make an argument against a book that we do not understand?” .

The fourth aspect: The ruling of the People of the Book in this matter is the ruling of the polytheists, and it is known that the polytheists among them are Arabs and among them are non-Arabs - Turks and Indians. And others - just as all polytheists are like Arab polytheists, and likewise all the People of the Book are like the People of the Book, whether Arabs or Jews. The Christians are among those who know the Arabic language, which no one can count except God Almighty.
The fifth aspect:

Understanding every verse of the Qur’an is not obligatory for every Muslim. Rather, the Muslim must know what God has commanded him to do and what he has forbidden. In any word, this is possible for all nations, and for this reason all types of non-Arabs, including Persians, Turks, and Indians, entered Islam. And the Saklabi and the Berbers, and among these are those who know the Arabic language, and among them are those who know what God has enjoined upon translation, and we have presented that It is permissible to translate the Qur’an for purposes other than prayer and expression, just as it is permissible to interpret it according to the agreement of the Muslims, but they disputed over whether it should be read in a language other than Arabic. Reciting it as it is recited during prayer. The majority of scholars forbade that. In that case, if a non-Arab recites the Fatihah of the Book and two surahs with it,

In Arabic, it is sufficient, and so is the Tashahhud and other dhikr that is commanded. This is an easy matter, easier than most of the obligatory duties. So how? It is impossible for God - Blessed and Most High - to command His servants to do so.

As for most of what the Messenger - may God bless him and grant him peace - commanded, such as prayer, zakat, fasting, Hajj, truthfulness in hadith, and fulfillment of trusts, The connection of family ties and what God has forbidden of polytheism, immoral acts, injustice, and other things, this is something that each one can know by defining who he is. He defines it either in the Arabic language or in another language. The definition of this does not depend on the Arabic language.

chapters.title: A chapter on what gives the illusion of privacy due to the fact that the Qur’an is Arabic
paragraphs: [Chapter: Rejecting the illusion of privacy due to the fact that the Qur’an is Arabic]

As for His saying - the Most High -: {Indeed, We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur’an that you may understand} [Joseph: 2] And His saying: {And if We had made it a foreign Qur’an, they would have said: If its verses had not been explained in detail, whether foreign or Arab.

3] This includes God’s blessings upon His servants; Because the Arabic language is the most complete of tongues and the best in explaining meanings, so the revelation of the Book is a greater blessing to creation than its revelation. With anything else, it was only addressed to the Arabs first so that they would understand it, then those who knew their language would understand it as they understood it, then those who did not know. Their language was translated for him by whoever knew their language, and the proof was to be established by it against the Arabs first and to be bestowed upon them first because of his knowledge of them. With its meanings before others knew it.
God Almighty said: {For We only made it easy with your tongue so that they might remember} [Al-Dukhan: 58]

And He said: {We only made it easy with your tongue so that you might give good news thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a stubborn people} [Maryam: 97] And al-lod is the plural of al-ald, and it is the most crooked in its meaning. The debater who evades the truth, as he said: The Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - “Indeed, the most hateful of men to God is the most bitter adversary.” And as for his saying - God Almighty -: {And We did not send any messenger except in the language of his people, that he might make it clear to them} [Ibrahim: 4] So it is as He - the Most High - said: And the people of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace. And peace be upon them - they are Quraysh, and with their language He was sent, and He, Glory be to Him, did not say:

And We have not sent any messenger except to his people. Rather, the Messenger is sent by God to his people and to other than his people, just as the Christians say: He was sent The Messiah - peace be upon him - and the disciples are not from the children of Israel and are not from his people. Likewise, he sent Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - to His people and other than his people, but he is sent in the language of his people to explain to them, and then the explanation is given to others by mediating the explanation to them. Either in their language

And by their language, or by their interpretation, and if it had not become clear to his people first, the purpose of the message would not have been achieved, neither for them nor for anyone else.
