So gather your affairs and your partners, then let your affair be no distress to you. Judge for me and do not wait.} [Yunus: 71] (71) {And if you turn away, I have not asked you for any reward. My reward is only from Allah, and I have been commanded to be of Muslims} [Yunus:
72] This is Noah, who drowned the people of the earth with his call and made all of his descendants remember that he had been commanded to be Muslims.

As for Al-Khalil, God Almighty said: {And when Abraham raised the foundations of the House, and Ishmael. Our Lord, accept it from us. Indeed, You are the Hearer, the Knower.} [Al-Baqarah: 127] (127) {Our Lord, make us submissive to You, and from our descendants a nation submissive to You, and show us our rituals, and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting, the Merciful} [Al-Baqarah: 128] He - the Almighty - said: {And whoever turns away from the religion of Abraham except one who fools himself. And We have chosen him in this world, and in the Hereafter he will be among those who The righteous} [Al-Baqarah: 130] (130) {When his Lord said to him, “Submit.” He said, “I have submitted to the Lord of the Worlds.”” [Al-Baqarah:

131] (131) {And Abraham enjoined it upon his sons, and upon Jacob, my sons. Indeed, God has chosen for you the religion, so do not die unless you have submitted.} [Al-Baqarah: 132] God Almighty told that He commanded the Hebron to Islam, and that He said: I have submitted to the Lord of the Worlds, and that Abraham commanded his sons, and Jacob commanded His children should not die except as Muslims.

And He Almighty said: {Abraham was neither a Jew nor a Christian, but was an upright Muslim, and he was not of the polytheists} [Al Imran: 67] (67) {Indeed, he is more deserving The people by Abraham belong to those who followed him, and this is the Prophet and those who believe, and God is the Guardian of the believers.} [Al Imran: 68] And He - Most High - said: On the authority of Joseph Al-Siddeeq, son of Jacob He said, “My Lord, You have given me the power of dominion and taught me the interpretation of hadiths. Creator of the heavens and the earth. You are my guardian in this world and in the hereafter, grant me death.” Submit and join me with the righteous.} [Yusuf: 101] And God Almighty said:

On the authority of Moses {And Moses said, “O my people, if you believe in God, then put your trust in Him if you are Muslims.” [Yunus: 84] And he said about the sorcerers who believed. By Moses: {They said, “There is no harm. Indeed, we are returning to our Lord.” [Al-Shu’ara’: 50] (50) {Indeed, we hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins if we are the first. The believers} [Al-Shu’ara’: 51] And they also said: “And you did not take vengeance on us unless we believed in the signs of our Lord when they came to us. Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die.” Muslims} [Al-A'raf: 126] And He - the Most High - said: In the story of Solomon {Indeed, he is from Solomon, and indeed, in the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful} [An-Naml:

30] (30) {Will you not prevail over me and come to me in submission?} [An-Naml: 31] And He said: “He said, ‘O eminent ones, which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me?’” Submitters} [An-Naml: 38] And He said: {And We were given knowledge before it, and we were Muslims} [An-Naml: 42]

And he said about Bilqis, who believed in Solomon {My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submitted with Solomon to God, Lord of the worlds} [An-Naml: 44] And he said: about the prophets Children of Israel {Indeed, We sent down the Torah, in which is guidance and light. The prophets judged by it, who submitted to those who were guided} [Al-Ma’idah: 44] And He, the Most High, said: On the authority of the disciples: {And when I revealed to the disciples, “Believe in Me and in My Messenger.” They said, “We believe.” And I bear witness that we are Muslims.} [Al-Ma’idah: 111] And God Almighty said: {Our Lord, we believe in what You have sent down, and we have followed the Messenger, so we are recorded with the witnesses} [Al Imran: 53].

These prophets and their followers are all mentioned by God Almighty as being Muslims, and this is what shows that His saying - the Most High -: {And whoever Whoever seeks a religion other than Islam, it will not be accepted from him.} [Al Imran: 85] And his saying: {Indeed, the religion with Allah is Islam} [Al Imran: 19] is not specific to the one who was sent. To him is Muhammad. Rather, it is a general ruling regarding the first and the last. This is why God Almighty said: {And who is better in religion than he who submits his face to God, and He is A doer of good, and he followed the religion of Abraham, upright, and God took Abraham as a friend.} [An-Nisa: 125] And He - the Most High - said:

{And they say, “None will enter Paradise except he who is a Jew or a Christian.” That is their wishful thinking. Say, “Bring your proof, if you are truthful.” Indeed, whoever submits. His face is toward God, and he is a doer of good. So he will have his reward with his Lord, and there will be no fear upon them, nor will they grieve” [Al-Baqarah: 111].

chapters.title: Separating the Muslims’ mediation between the shortcomings of the Jews and the extremism of the Christians
paragraphs: [Chapter: Muslims mediate between the shortcomings of the Jews and the extremism of the Christians]

Their saying: Then we found in this book the glorification of the Lord Christ and his mother, where it says in Surat Al-Anbiya: “And she who guards her chastity.” So We breathed into it of Our Spirit and made it and its son a sign to the worlds} [Al-Anbiya’: 91] And He said in Surah Al Imran {And when the angels said, “O Mary, indeed God has chosen you, purified you, and chosen you above the women of the worlds} [Al Imran:

42] With the testimonies of the Lord Christ’s miracles and that his mother conceived him without sexual intercourse with a man, for the good news of the angels of God to his mother. And that He spoke in the cradle, and brought the dead to life, and healed the blind, and cleansed the leper, and that He was created from clay like the form of a bird, and He breathed into it, and it was Flying by God’s permission, that is, by the permission of divinity, which is the word of God united in humanity, and we also found in the book that God raised him to Himself.

And he said: In Surat An-Nisa {And they did not kill him of certainty, but rather God raised him to Himself} [An-Nisa: 157] and in Surat Al Imran {Indeed, I will cause you to die, and I will raise you to Me, and I will purify you. of those who disbelieve, and I will place those who follow you above those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection} [Al Imran: 55] And He said: In Surah Al-Baqarah {And We gave Jesus the son of Mary the clear evidence, and We supported him with the Holy Spirit} [Al-Baqarah: 87] and he said:

In Surat Al-Hadid, “We created Jesus, son of Mary, and gave him the Gospel, and placed in the hearts of those who followed him compassion, mercy, and monasticism.” They invented it, We did not prescribe it for them except to seek the pleasure of God, but they did not maintain it as it should be cared for. So We gave those of them who believed their reward} [Al-Hadid: 27] And he said in Surah Al Imran {Among the People of the Book is a standing nation who recite the verses of God during the night, and they prostrate themselves. They believe in God and the Day And they enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong and hasten in good deeds, and those are among the righteous.} [Al Imran:
113] Then we found him preaching our Gospel.

The answer: As for glorifying Christ and his mother, it is right, and so is praising whoever followed his religion, which was not changed before he was sent or remained on it. That is until Muhammad was sent and he believed in him. Indeed, these are believers, Muslims who are guided, and so are those who followed the religion of Moses, which was not changed to If the Messiah was sent and believed in him, then these are believers, guided Muslims, and we have presented that Muslims are just and average and do not deviate to Exaggeration or neglect.

As for the Jews and Christians, they are on two opposite sides: they deviate to one side and the other to the opposite side, as we mentioned. They are identical in abrogation, and they are also similar in prohibition, permissibility, purity, and impurity. The Jews were forbidden to good things while they were They go to extremes in avoiding impurities to the point that menstruating women do not eat them, live with them, or have intercourse with them, and they do not consider removing impurity from The garment, rather, it closes its place, and they extract the blood from the veins and from the bands and shackles that were on them.

As for the Christians, you will find that their common people do not see anything forbidden or unclean, except what man naturally hates, and they pray with Impurity, impurity, impurity, and eating impurities such as blood, carrion, and the flesh of pigs, except for those of them who dislike something and abandon it. And the Muslims are in the middle, as God Almighty said about them: {And thus We have made you a moderate nation that you may be witnesses over the people and that the Messenger may be a witness over you} [Al-Baqarah: 143] That is, just and good. God Almighty said:

{And My mercy encompasses all things, so I will record it for those who fear and pay zakat and who believe in Our signs} [Al-A’raf: 156] (156) {Who They follow the Messenger, the unlettered Prophet, whom they find written in the Torah and the Gospel. He commands them to do what is right and forbids them to do evil. The evil, and makes lawful for them the good things, and forbids for them the evil, and removes from them their burden and the shackles that were upon them, so those who believe in him And they aided him and supported him and followed the light that was sent down with him. Those are the ones who will be successful.} [Al-A’raf: 157]

For this reason, whoever among the Muslims deviated into resemblance to the Jews and Christians was commanded to abandon that deviation and follow the straight path. Those upon whom God has bestowed blessings, of the prophets, the truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous, and those are good companions, not upon whom is His wrath, like the Jews and not those who go astray. Like Christians.

This is like someone who goes to extremes in avoiding impurities, so he defiles what God and His Messenger have not made him impure, and he forbids what God and His Messenger have not forbidden. The obsessive person takes him to avoid impurities and forbids good things that God has made permissible for Muslims, such as those who think that the analogy is that impurity does not It disappears neither with water nor anything else, or he sees that if it disappears and no traces of it remain, then the place is unclean if it does not disappear according to what he stipulates. Of water or anything else, or he believes that the good things that God has made lawful forbidden are evil because they are impossible to do with the forbidden, even though vinegar is lawful, even if It would have been wine, according to Muslim agreement, if he looks at its condition or sees that good water and good liquids in which there is no trace of The evil person is forbidden because the evil person came into contact with it or was consumed in it even though it is among the good things and not among the bad things, or he sees the prohibition of anything else. The place of blood that is considered harm and other things that some scholars said, but others disputed that and followed what they indicated. The Book and the Sunnah.

Even greater than that is the one who declares the Muslims who disagree with him to be unbelievers and sees the impurity of the infidels as many of the heretics among the Rafidites do. And the Kharijites and others, if someone else eats from their bowl, it becomes impure to them. As for what many people do without saying it, A scholar is like someone who washes his hands and clothes and confines his house under the illusion of its impurity, or orders a menstruating woman, once pure, to change her clothes. First, or you wash her, or the one who is in a state of impurity is prevented from eating or drinking until he washes. This is common among those who resemble the Jews, rather they resemble Samaria of the Jews.

As for those who resemble Christians, they are like those who think well of those who do not purify themselves and do not pray, among those who are attributed to poverty, asceticism, and worship. Such as one who is in places of devils and impurities, such as doves, kilns, and dunghills, while he is contaminated with urine and impurity, and has intercourse with Dogs, and he does not perform ablution or bathe in case of impurity, but rather he does not pray, or he prays without ablution, and it is known from the religion of Islam that it is necessary by necessity. The five daily prayers are obligatory for everyone, and that ablution in case of ritual impurity and ablution in case of impurity are obligatory. One should not pray except with the ability and without He performs tayammum if he is able, so whoever denies the obligation of that is an unbeliever, according to Muslim agreement.

And who makes an ascetic a worshiper who has some kind of supernatural abilities, such as some kind of revelation and behavior, which is one of the devils and the ignorant people think? It is one of the blessings of God’s saints, if he does not pray the five daily prayers, perform ablution, or bathe from impurity on the part of the believers or from Guardians of God, then he is an unbeliever, according to Muslim agreement, and whoever does not forbid the impure things that God and His Messenger have forbidden, such as urine, dung, and blood. And dead meat, pork meat, and wine, then he is an unbeliever according to Muslim agreement, and whoever makes that permissible with the knowledge that he is in violation of the religion of the Messenger As a guardian of God, he is an infidel, according to Muslim agreement, and the same applies to him who impersonates Islam and disparages the People of the Book who is a hypocrite in the police. lower than the Fire, and many of the Jews and Christians will have a lighter torment in the Hereafter than it. God Almighty said, “Indeed, the hypocrites are in the bottom of the Fire, and you will not find for them a helper} [An-Nisa:

145] (145) {Except those who repent and make amends and hold fast to God and are sincere in their religion for God - those are with the believers, and God will give A great reward for the believers.} [An-Nisa: 146] And likewise the Muslims and the Sunnis among the Muslims, and likewise in monotheism, for the Jews resembled The Creator to the created being, with regard to the created being, which are the qualities of imperfection from which the Lord must be distanced, and the Christians likened the created thing to the Creator. With regard to the Creator, which are the attributes of perfection that no one deserves except God, Blessed and Most High, so those among the Jews said this.

{Indeed, God is poor, and we are rich} [Al Imran: 181] And they said: {God’s hand is bound} [Al-Maeda: 64] and he is stingy, and they said that he created the world and it became laborious. So he rested.

It was narrated about some of them that he said: He wept over the flood until he turned red, and the angels did this, and that he mourned over some of His servants who destroyed it. Just as an afflicted person wails over his dead, and similar things that God transcends and sanctifies - Glory be to Him, the Most High.

Also, they are arrogant in worshiping God and obeying His Messengers, and they disobey His commands and transgress His limits, and they do not allow Him to abrogate He did not legislate it, but rather they prohibit it.

The Christians describe the creation as the Creator is described, making him the Lord of the worlds, the Creator of all things, and His Sovereign, who is All-Knowing and All-Knowing. He has power over all things, and they took their rabbis and monks as lords besides God and the Messiah, the son of Mary, and they were commanded only to worship one God who has no power. There is no god but Him. Glory be to Him above what they associate with Him. And they took the angels and the prophets as lords, and they made images of created beings, and they took them as intercessors. They will intercede for them with God, just as the idol worshipers did, as He said:

God Almighty {And they worship besides God that which neither harms them nor benefits them, and they say, “These are our intercessors with God.” Say, “Will you inform God of what He is not known in the heavens or on the earth.} [Yunus: 18] And for this reason - the Almighty - He said: {And warn thereby those who fear that they will be gathered before their Lord. Besides Him there is a guardian and no intercessor that they may become righteous.} [Al-An'am: 51] And - the Almighty - said: {It is God who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six days, then He is established above the Throne. Besides Him you have neither guardian nor intercessor.} [Al-Sajdah:

4] And Muslims are in the middle, describing God as He described Himself and His Messengers, without distortion, obfuscation, adaptation, or representation. They describe him with the attributes of perfection and free him from the shortcomings that are impossible for the Creator and he cannot be characterized by them.

Except for the created being, whom they describe with life, knowledge, power, mercy, justice, and benevolence, and they separate it from death and sleep. Ignorance, helplessness, injustice, and annihilation, and yet they know that there is no equal to him in any of the attributes of perfection, for no one knows like his knowledge. He does not have power like His power, nor has mercy like His mercy, nor hears like His hearing, nor sees like His sight, nor does He create like His creation, nor is He equal like His creation, nor is It comes as it is brought forth and does not descend as it descends, as God Almighty said: {Say: He is God, the One} [Al-Ikhlas: 1] (1) {God is the Eternal, the Eternal} [Al-Ikhlas: 2] (2) {He does not beget, nor does He He is born} [Al-Ikhlas:

3] (3) {And there was no one equal to Him} [Al-Ikhlas: 4] They do not describe any of the creatures with the characteristics of the Creator, glory be to Him, but rather everything else. The angels, the prophets, and the rest of creation. His servant is in need of Him, and He is the Eternal One, whom everything needs, and every one asks of Him, and He is He is self-sufficient and does not need anyone for any of the things, as God Almighty said: {And they say: The Most Gracious has taken a son} [Maryam: 88] (88) {Indeed You have come to something terrible.} [Maryam: 89] (89) {The heavens are almost torn apart from it, and the earth is splitting open, and the mountains fall down in ruins} [Maryam: 90] (90) {If they call upon The Most Gracious has a son} [Maryam:

91] (91) {And it is not befitting for the Most Merciful to take a son} [Maryam: 92] (92) {Indeed, everyone in the heavens and the earth does not come to the Most Merciful as a servant} [Maryam: 93] (93) {Indeed, He has numbered them and numbered them} [Maryam: 94] (94) {And they will all come to Him alone on the Day of Resurrection} [Maryam: 95]

And God Almighty said: {O People of the Book, do not go to extremes in your religion and do not say about God anything but the truth. Indeed, the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, is the Messenger of God. And His word which He conveyed to Mary, and a spirit from Him: So believe in God and His messengers, and do not say: “Desist from three.” It is better for you. God is but one God, Glory be to Him. That he should have a son; to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and God is sufficient as a disposer of affairs.} [An-Nisa: 171] (171) {The Messiah will not disdain to be a servant. To God, nor to the angels who are brought near, and whoever refrains from worshiping Him and is arrogant - He will gather them all to Himself} [An-Nisa:

172] (172) {But as for those who believe and do righteous deeds, He will give them their rewards in full, and increase them of His bounty; but as for those who disdain and are arrogant, Then He will torture them with a painful punishment, and they will find for themselves besides God no guardian or helper.} [An-Nisa: 173] And so they are in Christ, for the Christians say, “It is He.” God, and they also say that he is the Son of God, and he is a perfect God and a perfect man, and the Jews say that he was born of adultery, and he is the son of Joseph the carpenter. And they say about Maryam that she is an unbeliever of Jesus, as God Almighty said: {And they say against Maryam a great slander} [An-Nisa: 156] And they say that he is a sorcerer. A liar.

As for the Muslims, they say, “He is the servant of God and His Messenger, and His word which He bestowed upon Mary, the virgin, and a spirit from Him, and He is of authority in This world and the Hereafter, and from those who are close, and they describe him with what God described him in His Book, not exaggerating in it like the exaggeration of Christians, nor falling short of it. The negligence of the Jews, and likewise what they say about the rest of the prophets and messengers and about the saints of God. The Jews killed the prophets and those they commanded. With justice from the people and the Christians, they took their rabbis and monks as lords besides God and the Messiah, son of Mary, and they were not commanded except to worship One God, there is no god but Him. Glory be to Him above what they associate with Him. Despite this, the Christians participated with the Jews in depriving the truth of many of the prophets. They say that Solomon was not a prophet, and they say that the disciples are like Moses and Abraham, and they say that whoever does God’s commandments without The prophets became like the prophets and had the right to legislate a law. Some of the Jews went to extremes regarding Al-Uzair to the point that they said that he was the Son of God.
For this reason, our Prophet said in the authentic hadith, “Do not extol me as the Christians extolled Jesus, son of Mary, for I am only a servant of God, so say, “Abdullah.” And His Messenger.

And God Almighty mentioned in the Qur’an, in Surat (Kaha’is), the story of the cousin’s sons, Yahya and Jesus, and Yahya the Christians call him John, and he is John. According to them, the Baptists said - God Almighty - after mentioning the story of Yahya: {And mention in the Book Maryam when she withdrew from her family to a certain place. Eastward} [Maryam: 16] (16) {Then she took a veil from them, and We sent to her Our Spirit, and he appeared to her as a normal human being} [Maryam: 17] (17) {She said, “Indeed, I seek refuge.” By the Most Merciful from you, if you are pious.} [Maryam: 18] (18) {He said, “I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you a pure boy} [Maryam:

19] (19) {She said, “How can I have a boy when no human being has touched me, and I have not been a transgressor?” [Maryam: 20] (20) {He said, ‘Thus said, “Your Lord said, ‘It is easy for me, and let us make it easy.’” A sign to the people and a mercy from Us, and it is a matter decreed.} [Maryam: 21] (21) {So she carried him and withdrew with him to a far away place} [Maryam: 22] (22) {Then labor came upon her. To the trunk of the palm tree, she said, “I wish I had died before this and been forgotten, forgotten.” [Maryam: 23] (23) “So he called to her from beneath her: ‘Do not grieve me.’ He had made Your Lord will cover you in secret.} [Maryam: 24] (24) {And shake to you the trunk of the palm tree, and it will cause fresh, fresh dates to fall upon you.} [Maryam:

25] (25) {So eat and drink and soothe the eyes, and when you see any human being, say, ‘Indeed, I have vowed a fast to the Most Gracious, and I will not speak to any human being today.’” [Maryam: 26] (26) {So she brought him to her people carrying him. They said, ‘O Mary, you have done something strange.’” [Maryam: 27] (27) {O sister of Aaron, your father was not an evil person. And your mother was not a transgressor.} [Maryam: 28] (28) {Then she pointed to him. They said, “How can we speak to someone who was a child in the cradle?} [Maryam: 29] (29) {He said, ‘I am a servant of God. He came to me.’” The Book and made me a prophet} [Maryam: 30] (30) {And He made me blessed wherever I may be and enjoined upon me prayer and zakat as long as I live} [Maryam:

31] (31) {And he was kind to my mother and did not make me a wretched tyrant} [Maryam: 32] (32) {And peace be upon me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I am resurrected alive} [Maryam: 33].

Then He said: God Almighty {That is Jesus, son of Mary, the word of truth about which they dispute} [Maryam: 34] (34) {It is not for God that He should take from a son Glory be to Him, when He decrees a matter, He only says to it, “Be,” and it is.} [Maryam: 35] (35) {And God is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path} [Maryam: 36] (36) {Then the parties differed from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved because of the sight of a terrible Day} [Maryam: 37] (37) {Hear about them and see the Day They come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error} [Maryam:

38] So, Glory be to Him, mentioned the story of Mary and the Messiah in this Meccan surah that He sent down at the beginning of the matter in Mecca in the surah that He mentioned. It contains the foundations of the civil religion in which those from the People of the Book and the believers who followed the prophets are addressed when the Christians of Najran came against them. In it, the speech was made to the People of the Book, and He - the Almighty - said: {Indeed, God chose Adam and Noah and the family of Abraham and the family of Imran above the worlds} [Al Imran: 33] (33) {Offspring of one another, and God is All-Hearing, All-Knowing} [Al Imran:

34] (34) {When the wife of Imran said, “My Lord, I have vowed to you what is in my belly, freeing it, so accept it from me. Indeed, you are the Hearer, the Knower” [Al Imran: 35] (35) {So when She gave birth, saying, “My Lord, I have given birth to her as a female, and God knows best what she has given birth to, and the male is not like the female, and I have named her Maryam, and I I seek refuge with You and her offspring from the accursed Satan} [Al Imran: 36].

And in the two Sahih books, on the authority of Abu Hurairah, on the authority of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - that he said: “There is no newborn that the devil does not touch and begin screaming. From Satan, except Maryam and her son. Then Abu Hurairah says, “Recite if you wish.” Imran: 36] He - the Almighty - said: {So her Lord accepted her with a good acceptance, and caused her to grow a beautiful plant, and took care of her as Zachariah whenever Zachariah entered upon her. The mihrab found with her sustenance. He said, “O Mary, how can you get this?” She said, “It is from God. Indeed, God provides for whomsoever He wills without reckoning.” [Al Imran:
37] Then he mentioned the story of Zechariah and Yahya, then he said

{There, Zachariah called on his Lord. He said, “My Lord, grant me a good offspring from Yourself. Indeed, You hear supplication} [Al Imran: 38] (38) {Then the angels called to him while he was He is standing and praying in the sanctuary. Indeed, God gives you good news of Yahya, confirming a word from God, and as a master and a protector and a prophet from among the righteous.} [Al-Imran: 39] (39) {He said, “My Lord How can I have a boy when old age has reached me and my wife is barren? He said: “Thus does God do whatever He pleases” [Al Imran: 40] (40) {He said, “My Lord, make for me a sign.” He said Your sign is that you will not speak to people for three days except in brief, and remember your Lord often and glorify Him in the evening and the early morning} [Al Imran:

41] (41) {And when the angels said, “O Mary, indeed God has chosen you and purified you, and has chosen you above the women of the worlds. O Mary, be obedient to your Lord and prostrate.” And kneel with those who kneel.} [Al Imran: 42] (43) {This is of the news of the unseen. We reveal it to you, and you were not with them when they cast their pens as to which of them would be responsible. Maryam, and you were not with them when they disputed} [Al Imran: 44] (44) {When the angels said, “O Maryam, God is giving you good news of a word from Him, whose name is the Messiah.” Jesus, son of Mary, is distinguished in this world and the hereafter, and among those brought near.} [Al Imran:

45] (45) {And He speaks to the people in the cradle, as mature and of the righteous.} [Al Imran: 46] (46) {She said, “My Lord, how can I have a child when no human being has touched me?” He said likewise. God creates whatever He wills. When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, “Be,” and it is.} [Al Imran: 47] (47) {And He teaches it the Book and the Wisdom and the Torah. And the Gospel} [Al Imran:

48] (48) {And as a messenger to the Children of Israel: Indeed, I have come to you with a sign from your Lord, that I create for you out of clay like the shape of a bird, and breathe into it. And it will be a bird, by God’s permission, and I will heal the blind and the lepers, and bring the dead to life by God’s permission, and I will inform you of what you shall eat and what you shall store. In your homes. Indeed, in that is a sign for you, if you are believers.} [Al Imran: 49] (49) {And to confirm what was before me of the Torah, and that I might make lawful to you part of that which It has been forbidden to you, and I have come to you with a sign from your Lord, so fear God and obey me.” [Al Imran:

50] (50) {Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path} [Al Imran: 51] (51) {And when Jesus sensed disbelief from them, he said, “Who are my supporters?” God. The disciples said: We are supporters of God. We believe in God and bear witness that we are Muslims.} [Al Imran: 52] (52) {Our Lord, we believe in what You have revealed, and we follow the Messenger. So We wrote with the witnesses. And they plotted, and Allah plotted, and Allah is the best of planners.} [Al Imran:

53] (54) {When God said, “O Jesus, indeed I will cause you to die, and I will raise you to Me, and I will purify you from those who disbelieve, and I will place those who follow you above those who disbelieve.” On the Day of Resurrection, then to Me is your return, and I will judge between you concerning that wherein you differed.} [Al Imran: 55] (55) {But as for those who disbelieve, I will punish them. A severe punishment in this world and the Hereafter, and they will have no helpers.} [Al Imran: 56] (56) {And as for those who believe and do righteous deeds, He will give them in full their rewards. And God does not like the wrongdoers.} [Al Imran: 57] (57) That is {We recite to you of signs and the Wise Reminder} [Al Imran:

58] (58) {Indeed, the likeness of Jesus with God is like that of Adam. He created him from dust, then said to him, “Be,” and he was.} [Al-Imran: 59] (59) {The truth is from your Lord, so do not be of Al-Mumitarin} [Al-Imran: 60] (60) {So whoever disputes with you about it after the knowledge that has come to you, say, “Come, let us call our sons and your sons and our women.” And your women, and ourselves, and yourselves, then we will pray and place the curse of God upon the liars.} [Al Imran: 61] (61) {Indeed, this is the true story. And there is no god but Allah, and indeed Allah is the Mighty, the Wise} [Al Imran: 62] (62) {But if they turn away, then surely Allah is All-Knowing of the corrupters} [Al Imran: 62]

63] (63) {Say, O People of the Book, come to a common word between us and you: that we worship none but Allah, and do not associate anything with Him, and that He does not take Some of us are lords other than God. But if they turn away, say, “Bear witness that we are submissive.” O People of the Book, why do you dispute about Abraham and what was revealed? The Torah and the Gospel except after him. Do you not understand?} [Al Imran: 64] (65) {Here you are, you have argued about what you have knowledge of, so why do you dispute? concerning that of which you have no knowledge, and Allah knows while you do not know} [Al Imran:

66] (66) {Abraham was neither a Jew nor a Christian, but he was an upright Muslim, and he was not of the polytheists} [Al Imran: 67] (67) {Indeed, he is the most deserving of people. By Abraham to those who followed him, and this is the Prophet and those who believe, and God is the Guardian of the believers} [Al Imran: 68].

He, Glory be to Him, mentioned the story of Mary and the Messiah in these two surahs, one of which is Meccan and was first revealed with the introductory surahs. For the principles of religion, which is Surah (Kaha’is), and the second: a Madinan surah that was revealed after he was commanded to emigrate and perform jihad, and for this reason it included a debate with the people of The Book and their struggle, just as it was revealed in the innocence of their struggle, so it was told in the Meccan surah that when she was alone to worship, God sent His spirit came to her, and he appeared to her as a normal human being, and she said, “Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Gracious from you, if you are pious.” [Maryam: 18].

Abu Wael said: She knew that the pious person has the intention, that is, his piety forbids him from immorality, and she was afraid that he might intend it. She said, “I seek refuge in the Most Gracious from you if you are pious.” That is, you fear God. And what some ignorant people say is that there was among them an immoral man whose name was Pious, it is a kind of nonsense, and it is an obvious lie that only an ignorant person would say. Then he said, “I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you A pure boy. And in the other reading: {I will give you a pure boy} [Maryam:

19] So he informed this spirit, who appeared to her as a normal human being, that he was the messenger of her Lord. The words indicated that this spirit is a self-standing eye. It is not an attribute of anything else

That he is a messenger from God is not an attribute of God, and for this reason the majority of scholars said that it is Gabriel - peace be upon him - for God called him the Faithful Spirit. He called him the Holy Spirit, and he called him Gabriel, and so it is according to the People of the Book, that he was incarnated from Mary and from the Holy Spirit, but their error was They think that the Holy Spirit is the life of God, and that He is a God who creates, provides, and is worshipped, but it is not in any of the divine books or in the words of the prophets. God called His attribute that resides in Him the Holy Spirit, and He did not call His words or any of His attributes a Son, and this is one of the things that proves the error of the Christians. And they distorted the words of the prophets and interpreted them in a way other than what the prophets intended. The origin of their triangulation is based on what is in Uhud. The Gospels indicate that Christ - peace be upon him - said to them:

Baptize people in the name of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit, and it will be said to them: If this was said by Christ, and it is not in the language of Christ or the language of anyone else. The prophets are that they call the attribute of God that exists in him, nor his word, nor his life, neither the Son, nor the Holy Spirit, and they do not call his word the Son, nor They call Himself the Son and not the Holy Spirit, but what they narrate from them is that they describe the honored Chosen One as a son, and this is found in The truth of Christ and others, as they mention, is that He - the Almighty - said: To Israel, you are my son, my firstborn.
That is, the children of Israel.

What is meant by the Holy Spirit is the spirit that descends upon the prophets as it descended upon David and others, for it is in their books that the Holy Spirit was in David and others, and that Christ said: Theirs is my Father and your Father, my God and your God, so he called him the Father of all. Christ was not special to them. In the name of the Son, and the word “son” is not found among them except as a name for the honored Chosen One, not as a name for any of the attributes of God, nor in the books of the prophets. The attribute of God was born from Him.

And if that were the case, then this would show that what is meant by the Son is not the ancient and eternal Word of God that they say was generated. From God to them, although it is eternal, and not by the Holy Spirit, the life of God. Rather, what is meant by the Son is the humanity of Christ, and by the Holy Spirit, what was revealed to him. From the revelation and the angel that was sent down with it, so he commanded them to believe in God and His Messenger and in what He revealed to His Messenger and the angel that was sent down. By Him and by this all the prophets were commanded. Christ did not have any special property by which He deserved to have some of the divinity in Him, but the light of God appeared in Him. And the word of God and the Spirit of God, as it appeared in other prophets and apostles, for others also included
They quote him from the prophets. He is called the Son and the Holy Spirit dwelt in him, and this is explained elsewhere.

What is meant here is to point out that the words of the prophets - peace be upon them - confirm each other and that there is no auditory argument or evidence with the Christians. A mentality that agrees with what they invented, but they interpreted the words of the prophets in a way that does not indicate them, and according to them in the Gospel, he said: The Hour will not Neither the angels nor the Son know it, but the Father alone knows it. So it became clear that the Son does not know the time, so he knew that the Son is not the old one. The Eternal, but He is the temporal creation.

chapters.title: Separating the difference between what is added to God of His attributes and what is added to Him of His possessions
paragraphs: [Chapter: The difference between what is added to God of His attributes and what is added to Him of His kingdoms]
The genitive to God is of two types. The genitive can either be an attribute that does not exist on its own, such as knowledge, power, speech, or life, or To be a source that exists on its own.

The first is to add an attribute, such as His saying: {And they encompass nothing of His knowledge} [Al-Baqarah: 255] and His saying: {Indeed, Allah is the Provider, the Possessor of Power, the All-Powerful} [Al-Dhariyat: 58] And His saying: {Have they not seen that God, who created them, is more powerful than them?} [Fussilat: 15].

And the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - said in the authentic hadith, the hadith of istikharah: “If one of you is concerned about the matter, let him bow two rak’ahs without The obligatory prayer, then to say: O God, I seek guidance from You through Your knowledge, I seek guidance from You through Your power, and I ask You of Your bounty.

And His saying - the Most High -: {And the word of your Lord was completed in truth and justice} [Al-An’am: 115] And His saying: {This is the judgment of God. He judges between you} [Al-Mumtahina: 10] And His saying: {This is the command of God which He has sent down to you} [At-Talaq: 5] and the second: adding a spring, as in His - the Most High - saying: {And purify My House for those who circle around} [Al-Hajj: 26] And His saying: {God’s she-camel and He watered it} [Al-Shams: 13] and His saying: {A spring from which the servants of God drink} [Al-Insan: 6] So the genitive in the first is an attribute of God. It is a list of Him, not a creation created for Him, separate from Him, and what is added in the second:
He belongs to God, a creation that is distinct from Him, but he is favored and honored because of the qualities God has bestowed upon him that necessitate his addition to God.

- Blessed and Most High - just as He singled out Salih’s she-camel from among the camels, and just as He singled out His house in Mecca from among the houses, and just as He singled out His righteous servants from among Creation. From this point of view, His saying - the Most High -: {Then We sent to her Our spirit} [Maryam: 17] He described this spirit as appearing to her as a human being. Together, and that she sought refuge in God from him if he was pious, and that he said: {I am only the messenger of your Lord} [Maryam:

19] All of this indicates that it is an eye existing on its own, and it is what in theorists’ terminology is called a substance, and it may be called a body if it is a sign. To it, although people differ as to whether the body is composed of individual substances, or of matter and form, or is it not composed of either of these or of the other? This is since God has made it clear that the genitive here is not from the attributes that exist in other things, but rather from the entities that exist in themselves. It is known that The noun belongs to God and is created for Him, but its addition to God indicates God’s designation of it for it through selection and honor as He has enjoined. Specification by addition, and I mentioned what I wrote before this in response to the Christians, talking about this and other things, and I explained that There are two types of things attributed to God:
Characteristics and descriptions.

When attributes are added to it, such as knowledge, ability, speech, life, contentment, anger, and so on, the addition indicates that it is Adding a description to it that is based on it is not a created thing; Because an attribute does not exist by itself, it must have a description by which it performs. If it is added to it, it is known that it is an attribute of Him, but it may be expressed By the name of the adjective from its object, it is called that which is capable by power, and that which is created by the word in speech, and that which is known by knowledge, and the one to whom mercy is shown, as in the saying The Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - “Indeed, God created mercy one hundred times on the day He created it.”
And His saying - the Almighty - regarding what His Prophet narrated about him, is that He said: To Paradise (“You are My mercy; I have mercy on You whom I will.”).

It is said of the rain and the clouds, “This is the power of the All-Powerful,” and “this is a great power,” and it is said in supplication, “May God forgive you for his knowledge of you,” that is, for his knowledge of you.

As for entities, if they are added to God Almighty, they are either added by virtue of the general aspect in which the creature participates, such as their being Created, owned by Him, powerful, and the like. This is a common general addition, such as His saying: {This is God’s creation} [Luqman: 11]. And it may be added. Because of a specific meaning that distinguishes the genitive from others, such as:

The house of God, the she-camel of God, the servant of God, and the spirit of God. It is known that the Saleh she-camel is special because of what distinguishes it from all other camels, and likewise The specialty of the Kaaba and the specialty of the righteous servant who worshiped God and obeyed His command, and likewise the holy spirit that was distinguished by what it departed from. Other than the spirits, the creatures share in the fact that they are created beings owned and controlled by God, upon whom His judgment and decree are carried out. Its value and this addition has no specialization or advantage for the added over anything else.

Some of them are distinguished by the fact that God loves him, is pleased with him, chooses him, brings him close to Him, commands him, or glorifies him and loves him, so this addition It is specific to some creatures, such as the housemaid, the she-camel, the soul, and the servants of God, for that matter.
And He - the Almighty - said: In Surat Al-Anbiya: {And she who has guarded her contentment, so We have breathed into her of Our Spirit and made her and her son a sign to the worlds} [Al-Anbiya’: 91]

And he said in Surat Al-Tahrim {And God set forth as an example for those who believed the wife of Pharaoh when she said, “My Lord, build for me a house with you in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his work, and save me from the wrongdoing people} [Al-Tahrim: 11] (11) {And Maryam, the daughter of Imran, who guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her of Our Spirit. And she believed in the words of her Lord and His books, and she was of the obedient ones} [Prohibition:

12] So he mentioned Pharaoh’s wife who raised Musa ibn Imran and brought him together with his mother until his mother nursed him by her side. And he mentioned Mary, the mother of The Messiah whom she gave birth to and raised. These two women raised these two noble apostles. When he said here: “And We breathed into her” [Al-Anbiya’: 91], that is, into The woman and in it, that is, in her vagina, from our spirit.

And he said here: “So We sent to her our spirit” [Maryam: 17] to his saying: (I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you a pure boy) indicates that his saying What is meant by our spirit is not that it is an attribute of God, nor is it life or anything else, nor is it a Creator Lord, nor is it an attribute of the Creator Lord, but rather it is A spirit from among the spirits that God has chosen and honored, as previously mentioned in His saying: {So We sent to it Our Spirit} [Maryam: 17] and that most of them are It is Gabriel.

This principle that we mentioned of the difference in what is attributed to God, between His attributes and His kingdoms, is a great principle in which many people have gone astray. The land is made up of people of all religions. The books of the prophets, the Torah, the Gospel, the Qur’an, and other things, added things to God regarding this. The face and other things like this, so people disagreed about this addition, and the mutilator said the negation of attributes from people of religion:

Everything is an addition to a kingdom, but God has no life that exists in Him, nor knowledge that exists in Him, nor power that exists in Him, nor speech that exists in Him, nor love, nor Hatred, anger, or contentment, but all of that is one of His creatures.

This is the first thing that the Jahmiyah invented in Islam, but they only invented it after the era of the Companions and the greatest of their followers had disappeared. With goodness, and the leader of them was a man called Al-Jahm bin Safwan, so the Jahmiyah was attributed to him, and they denied the names and attributes, and he followed them. The Mu'tazilites and others denied the attributes but not the names, and a group of philosophers who followed Aristotle agreed with them.

The Hululiyyah said: Rather, what is added to God may be an attribute of Him, even if it is distinct from Him. Rather, they said: He is ancient and eternal, so they said: Spirit. God is ancient, eternal, an attribute of God, to the point that many of them said that the souls of the children of Adam are ancient, eternal, an attribute of God, and they said that what people hear The voices of the reciters and the ink of the Qur’an are ancient and eternal and are an attribute of God.

And he said, “The cleverness of these people, rather, His anger, His satisfaction, His love, His hatred, and His will for what He creates is ancient and eternal, and it is the attribute of God and His words that Moses heard it, ancient and eternal, and he was still satisfied and loving the one whom he knew was obeying him before he was created, and he was still angry and discontented with the one who He knew that he would disbelieve before he was created, and he did not stop saying, “O Adam, O Noah, O Abraham, before they came into being and after their death,” and he did not He continues and continues to say, “O assembly of jinn and mankind, before they were created and after they enter Paradise and Hell.

As for the predecessors of the Muslims among the Companions and those who followed them in righteousness, and the Imams of the Muslims who are famous for their Imamate, such as the four And others, and people of knowledge of the Qur’an and Sunnah, differentiate between His properties and His attributes, so they know that His servants are created with attributes. Servants are created things, and their bodies, souls, speech, and voices are governed by the Divine Books and other things, and their ink. And their leaves, the angels, the prophets and other things, and they know that the attributes of God that exist in Him are not created like His knowledge and power. His speech, his will, his life, his hearing, his sight, his contentment, his anger, his love, and his hatred. Rather, he is described by what he described himself with. And because his messengers described him without distortion, without distortion, without adaptation or impersonation, they do not negate what he described himself with. And His messengers described Him with it, and they do not distort words from their proper places, nor do they interpret the words of God other than what He intended, nor do they represent the attributes of the Creator with other attributes. created being, but they know that God

- Glory be to Him - there is nothing like Him, neither in itself, nor in His attributes, nor in His actions. Rather, He is described with the attributes of perfection, free from shortcomings, and He is not He has a likeness in some of His attributes, and they say that He has always been and continues to be described with the attributes of perfection. He has never ceased to speak by His will when He wills. And His power, and He is still knowledgeable, and He is still capable, and He is still alive, hearing and seeing, and He is still willing, so every perfection in which there is no deficiency can be characterized by Him. He has always been, and still is, described with the attributes of perfection and described with the attributes of majesty and honor - Glory be to Him, the Most High.

The Christians are among the people who are most confused about this principle, sometimes making the words he spoke like the Torah and the Gospel a separate creation. And they negate the attributes from Him, and sometimes they make His word ancient, eternal, and generated from Him. It has not ceased to exist and still does. Then they say this word. It is his son, and they make this word his knowledge or wisdom, and they say that this word is a creator God and it is He who created the heavens. And the earth, and that this word is Christ, and Christ is God, the Creator of the world.

And they say: However, this word is not the Father who created the heavens and the earth, so they make His word an ancient and eternal attribute. And they make her his son, and they make the character a creator god, and they make Christ the creator god, and they say, along with this, he is a god. True from God, true from the essence of His Father.

And they have in the word of God its attributes of contradiction and confusion and contradiction to the words of the prophets and interpretation of it in a way other than what they wanted and a clear violation of What is reasonable and authentic in the narration is what we will mention - God willing - of which God - Glory be to Him - the Most High - will make easy - by explaining the corruption of the sayings of the Christians There is no room for this book to exhaustively. And when God Almighty told the story of the Messiah, He said, “That is Jesus, the son of Mary, who speaks the truth” [Maryam: 34], that is, They complain and slander like the Jews and Christians.
Then He Almighty said: {Then the parties differed from among themselves} [Maryam:

37] Then the Jews and Christians disagreed about it, then the Christians disagreed about it and they became very numerous parties such as Nestorianism, Jacobism, and the monarchy. And the Baroubiyyah, the Mariamaniyya, the Sumayatiyyah, and similar sects, as we will mention - God willing - many of their sects. And their differences in their assemblies, as one of their eldest ones, Sa’id ibn al-Batriq and others, said about them. Indeed, among the nations there are not more There is a difference of opinion among them in the Lord of the worlds. So woe to those who disbelieve from all of these groups because of the sight of a great day.

{Listen to them and see on the Day they come to Us} [Maryam: 38] God Almighty says: “I will not hear them, nor will I see them on the Day they will come to Us.” But it is the wrongdoers. Today, like the Christians who were wronged with their immorality and polytheism in clear error, they have strayed from the truth in Christ, and God has described the Christians as being astray in Such as His saying - the Almighty -: {Say, “O People of the Book, do not go to extremes in your religion other than the truth, and do not follow the desires of a people who have gone astray before.” And they have misled many, and strayed from the right path.} [Al-Ma’idah: 77] And God Almighty said:

{And He warns those who say, “Allah has taken a son.” They have no knowledge of him, nor did their fathers. A word that comes out of their mouths is arrogant if they say anything but falsely} [Al-Kahf: 4] Because most of them are ignorant of the religion, and they speak words whose meaning they do not understand, and which are not transmitted from the prophets until they are delivered. For the one who said it: Rather, they invented it, and if you ask them about its meaning, they say:

This is not known to the intellect, so they invent speech that they know they do not understand, and it is contradictory speech, the beginning of which contradicts the end, and for this reason there is no You find them agreeing on one statement regarding their deity, to the point that some people said, “If ten Christians were to come together, they would disagree on eleven opinions.”

He said: The Rabi’i Christians are the people who differ the most in their sects and have the least in their ability to attain them. It is not possible for their sect to be known, even if you ask a priest. And you asked his father and his mother, and the three of them disagreed with you, and each one of them said something that was not similar to The other said.
Some theorists said:

There is not a saying said by a group of wise people unless you contemplate it and imagine a reasonable meaning from it, even if it is false, except the saying of the Christians. The more you contemplate it, the more you do not imagine a reality for it that makes sense to it. Rather, their goals are to preserve trustworthiness or something else, and if they are asked to explain Each of them interpreted it with an explanation by which he declared the other to be unbelievers, just as the Jacobites, the Melkites, and the Nestorians declared one another to be unbelievers. Because of their differences in the origin of monotheism and the message, as their statement regarding monotheism and the message was among the most corrupt and most contradictory statements, as Explained elsewhere.

chapters.title: The separation of the invalidation of their claim is the union of the Word of God with the Body of Christ
paragraphs: [Chapter: Nullifying their claim about the union of the Word of God with the Body of Christ]

As for their saying: It was a bird by God’s permission, that is, by the permission of the Divinity, which is the Word of God united in humanity, then this is when they said it according to It is their doctrine, without them saying that Muhammad wanted it. We spoke to them about that and demonstrated the corruption of that in reason and tradition.

As for their saying: Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - used to say: What is meant then is divinity, which is the word of God united in humanity. This is one of the slanders that appeared against Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and it is of the same nature as their saying: “Guide us to the straight path, a path.” Those to whom You have bestowed grace} [Al-Fatihah: 6] What the Christians meant by it, and from the same line of their saying is that His saying: {And whoever desires other than Islam as a religion} [Al-Imran: 85] The Arabs meant by it and it is similar to their saying {We have sent Our messengers with clear proofs} [Al-Hadid:
25] The disciples meant by them, and similar to what they said.
{This is the Book in which there is no doubt, a guidance for the righteous} [Al-Baqarah:

1] What he meant by the Gospel, these are the places in which they interpreted the Qur’an and claimed that Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - was the one who explained to the people what It was revealed to them. He meant what they recited from the Qur’an. These meanings that they mentioned are clear lies that indicate the utmost ignorance. The one who said it or the one who opposes him, but such an interpretation is not objectionable to the Christians, for they have interpreted many places in the Torah. The Gospel, the Psalms, and the prophecies are similar to these interpretations in which they completely distorted the words that the prophets brought about their places. Apparently, they thus altered the Books of God and the Religion of God, and in that they compared themselves to the Jews who distorted and altered, even if the direction of the distortion and alteration differed. So their distortion of the Qur’an is of the same type as their distortion of the Torah and the Gospel, and they are among those who call on the arbitrator and follow what he created from him. Seeking temptation and seeking to interpret it, but in these cases they distorted the decisive meaning, whose meaning is apparent and can only have one meaning. So they were ignorant and stubborn, and far from the truth than those who distorted the meaning of the similar, and that is because he learned of the necessity of the religion of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace. May God bless him and grant him peace - that he used to say that Christ, the servant of God, was created like all other messengers, and that he declared the Christians to be disbelievers who say he is God. Or the Son of God.

He - the Almighty - said: {Those who say that God is the Messiah, the son of Mary, have certainly disbelieved. Say, “Who can have power over anything with God if He wishes to destroy the Messiah, the son of Mary?” Mary, and his mother, and all who are on the earth, and to God belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them. He creates whatever He pleases, and God has power over all things.” [Al-Ma’idah: 17]

And He Almighty said: {Indeed, those who say that God is the Messiah, the son of Mary, have disbelieved. And the Messiah said, “O Children of Israel, worship God, my Lord and your Lord.” Indeed, whoever associates anything with God, God has forbidden to him Paradise, and his abode is the Fire, and the wrongdoers will have no helpers.} [Al-Ma’idah: 72] (72) {Indeed, those who say have disbelieved. Indeed, God is the third of three, and there is no god but one god, and if they do not desist from what they say, a painful punishment will surely touch those who disbelieve among them.} [Al-Maeda:

73] (73) {Will they not repent to God and ask His forgiveness? And God is Forgiving, Merciful. The Messiah, the son of Mary, is nothing but a messenger. Messengers have passed away before him. And his mother is a truthful one. They used to eat food. See how We make clear to them the signs. Then see how they will be misled. Say, “Do you worship besides God that which He does not possess?” to you neither harm nor benefit, and God is the Hearer, the Knower} [Al-Ma’idah: 74] (76) {Say, “O People of the Book, do not go to extremes in your religion other than the truth, and do not follow The desires of a people who had gone astray before, and had misled many, and strayed from the right path.} [Al-Maeda: 77].

He mentioned the disbelief of the Christians in their saying: He is God twice, and he mentioned that the Messiah is nothing but a messenger. Messengers have passed away before him, so his goal is The message, as he said: in Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and Muhammad is nothing but a messenger. Messengers have passed away before him, and the purpose of his mother is to be a friend and a guide. Thus, she is not a prophet. Then he said: They were eating food, and this is one of the most apparent characteristics that negates the divine nature of the need for food. It goes into his stomach and what comes out of it is the waste.
And the Lord Almighty is one who is steadfast. He neither begot nor was born, and there is no one equal to Him.

The Christians say that he gives birth, that he is born, and that he has equals, as has been shown in another place, and he was told about the servitude of Christ in other than A place like His - the Almighty - saying: {And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, behold, your people turned away from it} [Al-Zukhruf: 57] (57) {And they said: Are our gods better or better? They did not strike at you except as an argument. Rather, they are a contentious people.} [Al-Zukhruf: 58] (58) {He is nothing but a servant upon whom We have bestowed a blessing and made him an example to my children. Israel} [Al-Zukhruf: 59] And God Almighty informed that the first thing that Christ spoke was his saying: {Indeed, I am the servant of God. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet} [Maryam: 30] And He - the Almighty - said:

{And when God said, “O Jesus, son of Mary, did you say to the people, ‘Take me and my mother as two gods besides God?’” He said, “Glory be to You. It is not for me to say what.” I have no right.} [Al-Ma’idah: 116] The verses up to His saying: Witness. And He - Most High - said: {O People of the Book, do not go to extremes in your religion and do not say anything about God except The truth is that the Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary” [An-Nisa’: 171], all of the verses.

So if he had learned from necessity the religion of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and the mutawatir transmission from him and the unanimous consensus of his nation They rely on the narration from him, his book revealed to him, and his Sunnah, which is known about him, that he used to say that Christ is the servant of God And His Messenger is nothing but a Messenger, and he declares the Christians to be unbelievers who say, “He is God, and He is the Son of God,” and those who say, “The third of three.” And similar to that, after this, was their interpretation of the word of God that was conveyed to him by His Prophet Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - so it is a bird, God willing. That is, with the permission of theology, which is the word of God united with humanity, an apparent lie against Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace.

This is what is known about their lies about Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - all the people of the earth who know the condition of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - Whether they acknowledge his prophecy or deny it.

What is meant in this case is that these people lied about Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - a lie that is clear and known to the people who believe in him. And for those who deny it, it is not a hidden lie.

And if it is assumed that what they said was reasonable, then how about it if it is impossible in the clear statements of minds? Rather, it is an unreasonable statement, meaning it is not reasonable and proven in The outsider, even if he understands what they differ and knows about it, the corruption of their minds is for him who says all the contradictory and corrupt statements that he refrains from. Its confirmation is external, as has been explained in another place. Their saying: With the permission of theology, which is the word of God united in Humanity is invalid in many ways.
Among them is that that word is either God or an attribute of Himself, or it is neither His essence nor an attribute of Him, or the essence and the attribute together.

If it is not the essence of God, nor His attribute, nor the essence and attribute, then it is separate from Him and created for Him, and there is no divinity, nor even its Creator. At that time, no divinity was united with Christ. Rather, if He was not united with Him, then only a created being was united with Him.

And if the Word is the essence or the entity and the attribute, then He is the Lord of the worlds and He is the Father to them, and they agree that Christ is not the Father. It was not the Father who was united with him, but the Son.

And if the word is an attribute of God - the Almighty - then the attribute of God is not the Creator God, and Christ, according to them, is the Creator God. The attribute of God is self-existent and does not separate from Himself. It resides in others and is united with Him. For them, the word of God was united with Christ.

And if they say: Our saying this is as a group of Muslims say that the Qur’an, the Torah, or the Gospel came into being among the reciters or was united with them. And that the ancient resided in the creature or united with it, and so on.

It was said that if what these people said were correct, they would have no argument for it. According to this assessment, there is no difference between Christ and other people. He reads the Torah, the Gospel, the Psalms, and the Qur’an, while you claim that the Messiah is God or the Son of God specifically for that and nothing else. Also, these and all nations agree that none of the readers of the Qur’an and other divine books is God, nor is he the Son of God. Nor is He the Creator of the world. If you make what these people say, you are bound to believe that the Christ is neither God, nor the Son of God, nor the رَبًّا لِلْعَالَمِ وَأَيْضًا فَلَمْ نَعْلَمْ أَحَدًا مِنْ هَؤُلَاءِ قَالَ:

That divinity was united with humanity, nor that the ancient was united with the new, nor that the word of God and the created thing became one thing, then the union is invalid. By agreement of these and others.

But a group of them used the term “permissible” and another group denied the term “permissible” and said, “We only say that the ancient has appeared in the modern and there is no solution.” But they said what required solutions.

The Muslim predecessors and the majority of them made these people wrong, and they explained their error through reasoning and narration, and their statement is not the statement of any of them. The imams of the Muslims, nor the opinion of a well-known sect of the Muslim sects, such as the Malikis, Shafi’is, Hanafis, and Hanbalis. Al-Thawriyyah, Al-Dawoodiyyah, Al-Ishaqiyyah, and others, nor the opinion of one of the sects of theologians among the Muslims, not those affiliated with the Sunnah. Such as the Ash'arites and the Karamiyyah, nor others, such as the Mu'tazilites, the Shiites, and their like. Rather, a small sect said that, affiliated with Some Muslim scholars, such as a few Malikis, Shafi’is, and Hanbalis, and their goal is to say that one of the attributes is permissible. By God, likewise whoever believes in the coming of the Lord and His unity in the servant from the sects of extremists who are affiliated with Shiism, Sufism, or others, they understand. Misguided like the Christians, even though the Christians have no proof against these people, since what they say is not specific to Christ, but is shared between him and غَيْرِهِ مِنَ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ.

The Christians claim that Christ is unique in the union, even though the one who is united with humanity has become one thing, and with the union it is impossible to One of them has an action or an attribute that is different from the other, and the Christians claim unity, then they contradict each other. Some of them say there is one essence. And among them are those who say two essences, and among them are those who say one will, and among them are those who say two wills, as the discussion will follow - God willing - Almighty for that.

chapters.title: Chapter: Refusing their claim is a credit to them over the Muslims, according to the Almighty’s saying, “And I will place those who follow you above those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection.”
paragraphs: [Chapter: Replying to their claim of credit to the Muslims, according to the Almighty’s saying: “And I will make those who follow you above those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection]

As for His saying - the Almighty -: {O Jesus, I will cause you to die, and I will raise you to Me, and I will purify you from those who disbelieve, and I will place those who follow you above those who disbelieve. On the Day of Resurrection} [Al Imran: 55] This is the truth as God informed of it. Whoever follows Christ - peace be upon him - God will make him above those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection. Resurrection, and those who followed him in his religion, which had not been changed, God had placed them above the Jews, and also the Christians were above the Jews who disbelieved in him. Until the Day of Resurrection.

As for the Muslims, they are believers in him, not disbelievers in him. Rather, when the Christians changed his religion and God sent Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - with a religion God, by whom Christ and other prophets were sent, God placed Muhammad and his nation above the Christians until the Day of Resurrection, as in the two Sahih books on the authority of Abu Huraira on the authority of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - that he said: “We, the company of the prophets, have one religion, and the people are most worthy of the son of Mary, because we There is no prophet between me and him.”

And He Almighty said: {He has legislated for you of the religion what He enjoined upon Noah, and which We have revealed to you, and what We enjoined upon Abraham, Moses, and Jesus, that you should establish the religion and not You will disperse therein.” [Al-Shura: 13]

And He Almighty said: {O Messengers, eat of the good things and do righteousness. Indeed, I am All-Knowing of what you do, and this is your nation, one nation, and I Your Lord, so beware of yourselves.} [Al-Mu’minun: 51] (52) {Then they divided their affairs into divisions among themselves, every party rejoicing in what they had.} [Al-Mu’minun: 53] So everyone is more complete in faith. God and His Messengers have more right to help from God Almighty, for God says in His Book {Indeed, We will certainly help Our Messengers and those who believe in the life of this world. And on the Day when the witnesses will be raised up} [Ghafir: 51] And He said: In His Book {And indeed Our word has preceded for Our messenged servants} [Al-Saffat:

171] (171) {Indeed, they are the ones who will be helped} [Al-Saffat: 172] (172) {And indeed, We have recruited for them those who are victorious} [Al-Saffat: 173] And the Jews denied the Messiah and Muhammad - May God’s prayers and peace be upon him - as God said about them: “Evil is that for which they have sold their souls, that they should deny what God has sent down, out of envy that God should send down His grace is upon whomsoever He wills of His servants, and they were treated with wrath.} [Al-Baqarah: 90] The first wrath was due to them denying the Messiah, and the second: due to their denying Muhammad. - May God bless him and grant him peace - And the Christians did not deny Christ, so they were victorious over the Jews, and the Muslims were victorious over the Jews.

And the Christians, for they believed in all the Books of God and His Messengers, and they did not deny any of His Books, nor did they deny any of His Messengers, but rather they followed what He said. God to them, where He said, “Say, ‘We believe in God and in what was sent down to us, and what was sent down to Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac and Jacob and the tribes and what Moses and Jesus were given, and what was given to the prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them, and to Him we submit.} [Al-Baqarah: 136] And He - the Most High - said:

{The Messenger believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and the believers are each of them who believe in God and His angels and His books and His messengers. We make no distinction between any of His messengers. And they said, “We have heard and obeyed. Your forgiveness is our Lord, and to You is the return.” [Al-Baqarah: 285] And since the Muslims were the followers of the Messengers of God, all of whom were the Messiah. And others, and God had promised to support the messengers and their followers. The Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - said in the authentic hadith: “There will never cease to be a sect. of my nation, adhering to the truth. They will not be harmed by those who oppose them, nor by those who abandon them, until the Hour comes.”
He also said: I asked my Lord not to let an enemy from other than them dominate my nation and invade them, so He gave me the hadith.
So what they used as evidence was an argument against them, not for them.

chapters.title: A chapter explaining the meaning of the Holy Spirit and defending the Christians’ belief in its divinity
paragraphs: [Chapter: Explaining the meaning of the Holy Spirit and refuting the Christian belief in its divinity]

As for His saying - the Almighty -: {And We gave Jesus, son of Mary, clear proofs, and supported him with the Holy Spirit} [Al-Baqarah: 87], it is true as God informed about it. The Almighty mentioned the support of Jesus, son of Mary, with the Holy Spirit in several places. He, the Almighty, said in Surat Al-Baqarah: {And We gave Moses the Scripture. We followed him with messengers, and We gave Jesus, son of Mary, clear proofs, and supported him with the Holy Spirit.} [Al-Baqarah: 87] And He - the Most High - said:

{Those are the messengers, some of whom We favored over others - whoever spoke to God, and raised some of them in degrees, and We gave Jesus, son of Mary, clear proofs, and We supported him. By the Holy Spirit, and if God had willed, those after them would not have fought each other after clear proofs had come to them, but they differed. Some of them believed and some And if God had willed, they would not have fought, but God does what He wills} [Al-Baqarah: 253] And He - the Most High - said:

{O Jesus, son of Mary, remember My blessing upon you and upon your mother, when I supported you with the Holy Spirit to speak to people in your cradle and at old age, and when I taught you The Book and the wisdom and the Torah and the Gospel. And when you created out of clay the shape of a bird by My permission, then you breathed into it and it became a bird by My permission. And you will heal the blind and the leper by My permission.} [Al-Ma’idah: 110]

And He - the Almighty - said: In the Qur’an: {And when We substitute a verse in place of another, and God knows best what He is sending down. They say, “It is only you who is an inventor.” Nay, most of them do not. They know} [An-Nahl: 101] (101) {Say, “It has been sent down by the Holy Spirit from your Lord in truth} [An-Nahl: 102] And He - the Most High - said: {The Trustworthy Spirit has sent down therewith} [Al-Shu’ara’: 193] (193) {On your heart that you may be among the warners} [Al-Shu'ara: 194] And He - the Most High - said: {Say: Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel - indeed he has sent it down to your heart, God willing. Verifying} [Al-Baqarah: 97] So the Holy Spirit that was sent down in the Qur’an from God is the Faithful Spirit, and He is Gabriel.

It is proven in the Sahih on the authority of Abu Hurairah that he heard the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - “saying to Hassan bin Thabit: “Answer on my behalf, O God, support him.” “By the Holy Spirit.”

And in Sahih Muslim and others, on the authority of Aisha - may God be pleased with her - she said: “I heard the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - saying to Hassan bin Thabit: The Holy Spirit will continue to support you as long as you defend yourself on behalf of God and His Messenger.”

And in the two Sahih books, on the authority of Al-Baraa bin Aazib, he said: “I heard the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - saying to Hassan bin Thabit: ‘Strike them or Attack them while Gabriel is with you.

This is Hassan bin Thabit, one of the believers when he defended God and His Messenger and criticized the polytheists who deny the Messenger, may God support him. By the Holy Spirit, who is Gabriel - peace be upon him - and the people of the earth know that Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - did not make divinity unified With the humanity of Hassan bin Thabit, he knew that telling him that God supported him with the Holy Spirit does not require the union of divinity with humanity, so he knew that the support The Holy Spirit is not one of the characteristics of Christ, and the People of the Book acknowledge this, and that other prophets were supported by the Holy Spirit, like David. And others. Rather, they say that the disciples had the Holy Spirit in them, and it has been proven by agreement of Muslims, Jews and Christians that the Holy Spirit is in Other than Christ, but in other than the prophets, as will come - God willing.

In this case, what is intended is to explain their lies against Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and this support is in parallel with his saying - the Most High -: {No You will find people who believe in God and the Last Day being friendly with those who oppose God and His Messenger, even if they are their fathers, sons, or brothers. Or their kindred. These are the ones in whose hearts He wrote faith and supported them with a spirit from Him.} [Al-Mujadila:

22] This support, in a spirit, is general for everyone who did not love the enemies of the apostles, even if they were his relatives. Rather, he loved those who believed in the apostles, even if they were Foreigners and hates those who do not believe in the messengers, even if they are relatives. This is the religion of Abraham.

And God Almighty said: “There has indeed been for you a good example in Abraham and those with him, when they said to their people, ‘Indeed, we are free from you and from what you worship. We have disbelieved in you other than God, and enmity and hatred have appeared between us and you forever, until you believe in God alone.} [Al-Mumtahina: 4] And He - the Most High - said: {And when Abraham said to his father and his people, “Indeed, I am disavowed from what you worship} [Al-Zukhruf: 26] (26) {Except Him who created me; indeed, He will guide me} [Al-Zukhruf: 27] (27) {And He made it a word that will remain on their heels so that they may return} [Al-Zukhruf: 28] And He said: {And when it became clear to him that he was an enemy of God, he disowned him} [Al-Tawbah:
