And other than that, which they mentioned and interpreted from the Qur’an in a sense other than that which God intended, and this is what supports that they did so. By the Torah and the Gospel, for if the Qur’an, the interpretation of which is known and what is meant by it, is general and specific, and that was narrated from the Messenger, Repeatedly until its meaning is known with absolute certainty, then they change its meaning and distort the word from its proper place. So what do they do with the Torah and the Gospel? The wording and meaning of that were not transmitted; Just as the Qur’an was transmitted, there is no one among the people of those books who will defend their wording and meaning. How do Muslims ignore the wording and meaning of the Qur’an?
And these people were deceived by his saying: {that Book} [Al-Baqarah: 2] so they thought that the word “that” when it was referring to the absent person was referring to it. The Gospel.

So it is said: To them, this is like His saying: {This We recite to you of the verses and the Wise Reminder} [Al Imran: 58] and he referred with that to what he recited before. This verse, and his saying: {And ask what you spent, and let them be asked what they spent. This is the judgment of God. He judges between you} [Al-Mumtahina: 10]

And He said: {Then when they have reached their term, retain them with kindness, or separate from them with kindness, and take witnesses from among you who are just and bear witness for God. This is what is admonished by him who believes in God and the Last Day} [At-Talaq: 2] And a similar example is His saying - the Almighty -: after mentioning the news of the truthful Joseph {This is of the news of the unseen that We have revealed to you} [Yusuf: 102] And he also said: When he mentioned the news of Maryam: {This is of the news of the unseen that We have revealed to you while you were not. With them when they cast their pens} [Al Imran: 44] As he said: When he mentioned verses in which he told about Noah: “These are of the tidings of the unseen that We have revealed to you” [Hud:

49] And he said: {The Lord - these are the verses of the clear Book - Indeed, We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur’an that you may understand} [Yusuf: 1-2] And those in the feminine are like that. In the remembrance, and with this, he referred to

The Qur’an, and from it His saying: {Ar - These are the verses of the Book and a clear Book} [Al-Hijr: 1] And His saying: {Tas - These are the verses of the Qur’an and a clear Book} [An-Naml: 1] And from it His saying: {Tasm - These are the verses of the clear Book} [Al-Qasas: 1 - 2] And from Him is His saying: {Ham - Asq - Thus does God reveal to you and to those before you, the Mighty. The Wise} [Al-Shura: 1 - 3] And His saying: {Thus have We revealed to you an Arabic Qur’an} [Al-Shura: 7] And His saying: {The bitter - these are the verses of the Book and that which has been revealed to you From your Lord is the Truth} [Al-Ra’ad: 1] the verse.

There are many such things, and that is because when His saying was revealed: {That Book - those are the verses of the Book} [Yunus: 2-1] and the like, it was not The book referred to was revealed at that hour, but it had only been revealed before that, so it became like the absent book to which it is referred to; The absent person is also referred to, and considering his presence with the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - he is referred to; It also refers to the present; As God Almighty said: {And this is a blessed Reminder which We have sent down} [Al-Anbiya’: 50]

That is why he said: Not one of the predecessors had that book, meaning this book. They say what is meant is this book, although the reference is sometimes A reference to an absent person and sometimes a reference to a present one. He said: “Guidance for the righteous - those who believe in the unseen” [Al-Baqarah: 2-3]. He described the Christians as not They believe in God or in the Last Day, but they are disbelievers and wrongdoers. So how can He make them righteous who believe in the unseen?

God Almighty said: {Fight those who do not believe in God or in the Last Day, and do not forbid what God and His Messenger have forbidden, and do not follow the religion of truth. They were given the Scripture until they were given the tribute out of hand, but they were submissive.} [At-Tawbah: 29].

The beginning of piety is piety of polytheism. He described the Christians as polytheists in His saying: “They took their rabbis and monks as lords besides God.” And the Messiah is the son of Mary. And they were not commanded except to worship one God. There is no god but Him. Glory be to Him above what they associate with Him.} [At-Tawbah: 31] And He - the Most High - said: When Christ mentioned {Then the parties differed from among them, so woe to those who disbelieve from the sight of a terrible day. Hear about them and see the day they come to us. But the wrongdoers today are in clear error.} [Maryam: 37-38] And God Almighty said: {Indeed, those who said, “Indeed, God is the Messiah, son of Mary” have disbelieved} [Al-Ma’idah:

72] And his saying: {Those who say, “Indeed, Allah is the third of three” have certainly disbelieved} [Al-Ma’idah: 73] and he forbade allegiance to them, saying, “O you who have believed! You take the Jews and Christians as guardians of one another, guardians of one another, and whoever of you befriends them is indeed one of them.} [Al-Ma’idah: 51] And it was reported that God is the Protector of the righteous, and He said, “Then We placed you upon a law of the matter, so follow it, and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know - for they will not be helped. Nothing is with you from God, and indeed the wrongdoers are allies of one another, and God is the Protector of the righteous.} [Al-Jathiya: 18-19]

If they had been among the pious, rather than being the pious, God would have been their guardian, and loyalty to them would have been obligatory for the believers, and He has He forbade allegiance to them, and made those who befriend them an oppressor, and made the believers protectors of one another, and the unbelievers, protectors of one another. For this reason, God cut off allegiance between the believers and the unbelievers.
The Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - said in the authentic hadith: “A Muslim does not inherit from an infidel, nor does an infidel inherit from a Muslim.”

The Muslims agreed that a Jew and a Christian do not inherit from a Muslim, even if it is his son and his father. Because God has severed allegiance between them, and God Almighty has said: “You will not find a people who believe in God and on the Last Day be friendly with those who oppose God.” And His Messenger, even if they were their fathers, or their sons, or their brothers, or their kindred, He wrote faith in their hearts and supported them with a spirit From Him} [Al-Mujadila: 22] And also, for He - the Most High - said: {Those who believe in the unseen and establish prayer} [Al-Baqarah: 3]

And it is the prayer that he commanded in his saying: “Establish the prayer from the setting of the sun until the dusk of the night, and recite the Qur’an at dawn. Indeed, the Qur’an at dawn is witnessed.” [Al-Isra: 78] He said: “God does not accept prayer without purification,” and Christians pray without purification.

And he - may God bless him and grant him peace - said: “There is no prayer except with the opening of the book,” and they do not recite it. The prayer that he enjoined and praised included facing the Kaaba, bowing and two prostrations in each rak’ah, and other things that are not permitted. Christians do it, so how can He praise them by performing the prayer when they do not perform the prayer that He commanded it to be performed?

Then if the Jew had said what is meant by his saying: {that Book} [Al-Baqarah: 2] the Torah and by the pious Jews, this, despite its invalidity, would have been nearer. According to the one who says that what is meant by the book is the Gospel; Because the Torah is more deserving of that than the Gospel, for it is the origin, and God Almighty connects it with the Qur’an in more than one place, as He says: {Is he then who is upon clear proof from his Lord, and a witness from Himself follows it, and before him the Book of Moses as a guide and a mercy?} [Hud: 17] And His saying - the Most High -:

{Say: Have you considered if it is from God and you disbelieve in it, and a witness from the Children of Israel bears witness to the like of it, and then believes, and you are arrogant? Indeed, God does not He guides the wrongdoing people} [Al-Ahqaf: 10].

And the jinn said, when they heard the Qur’an, “They said, ‘O our people, indeed we have heard a book sent down after Moses, confirming what was before it, guiding to the truth. And to a straight path} [Al-Ahqaf: 30] And he said: Al-Najashi, when he heard the Qur’an, “Indeed, this is what Moses brought to come out of a single niche.” Likewise, Waraqah bin Nawfal said: This is the law that was revealed to Musa bin Imran.

And He - the Almighty - said: They said: {If only I had not been given the like of what was given to Moses. Have they not disbelieved in what was given to Moses before? They said, “It is two magics pretending to be.” [Al-Qasas: 48] meaning: The Torah and the Qur’an. And they said: They are magicians who pretended to be, that is, Moses and Muhammad, and they said, “Indeed, we are disbelievers in everything.”

God said: {Say, “Then bring a book from God that is better guided than the two of them. Follow it, if you are truthful.” [Al-Qasas: 49] It has been made clear that he did not come. From God is a book better guided than the Torah and the Qur’an.

And He - the Most High - said: {And they did not estimate God as He deserved when they said, “God has not sent down to human beings anything.” Say, “Who sent down the Book with which Moses brought light?” And a guidance for the people, which you make on writings that you reveal and conceal much, and you have been taught what neither you nor your fathers knew. Say, “Allah.” Then leave them in They go out and play - and this is a book which We sent down. Blessed is the one who is in his hands, and that you may warn Umm al-Qura and those around her and those who believe. In the Hereafter they believe in it, and they guard their prayers} [Al-An'am: 91-92].

As for His saying - the Most High -: {And those who believe in what was revealed to you and what was revealed before you} [Al-Baqarah: 4] it is a second description of those who believe. In the unseen in general, then he described them with detailed faith in what was revealed to you and what was revealed before him. The connection with the waw is used to differentiate essences and is used to differ in attributes, as in His saying - the Almighty -: {Glorify the name of your Lord Most High - Who created and equalized - And it is He who destined and guided - and it is He who brings forth the pasture - and makes it bitter dung.} [Al-A'la: 1-5] And it is He who created and leveled it - it is He who destined and guided it and it is He who brings forth The pasture, and likewise His saying - the Most High -:

{And if you ask them who created the heavens and the earth, they will say, “He created them, the Mighty, the All-Knowing.” - He who made the earth a cradle for you and made for you paths therein. Perhaps you will be guided - And He who sent down from the sky water in measure, and We spread therewith a dead land. Thus will you be brought out - And He who created all pairs and made Of the ships and livestock you ride.} [Al-Zukhruf: 9-12] And the same is His saying:

{Indeed, the believers have succeeded - those who are humble in their prayers - those who turn away from idle talk - those who are obedient to zakat - and those They are guardians of their private parts - except for their wives or those whom their right hands possess, for they are not to be blamed - so whoever seeks beyond that - those are they. Those who are transgressors - and those who are careful about their trusts and covenants - and those who are careful about their prayers - those are the heirs - those who inherit Paradise, therein they will abide forever} [Al-Mu’minun: 1-11].
They are one class, and he described them with these characteristics with the letter waw, and likewise in his saying:

{Indeed, man was created with fear - when evil befalls him, out of fear - and fear when good befalls him - except for those who pray - those who are constant in their prayers - and those In their wealth there is a known right - for the beggar and the deprived - and those who give in charity on the Day of Judgment - and those who are afraid of the punishment of their Lord - indeed, the punishment Their Lord is not trustworthy - and those who guard their private parts - except for their wives or those whom their right hands possess, then they are not to blame - so whoever Go beyond that, for those are the transgressors - and those who are faithful to their trusts and their covenants - and those who stand by their testimonies - And those who maintain their prayers - those will be in Gardens of honor.} [Al-Ma’arij:

He explained before saying: They believe in the unseen. The quality of believers from other than the People of the Book is like the Arab polytheists, and those who believe in what was revealed. To you and what was sent down before you is the description of those of the People of the Book who believe in it.

Based on this saying: These are different from these, but this is weak, for it is necessary for believers other than the People of the Book to believe in what It was revealed to him and what was revealed before him, and it is necessary for the believer of the People of the Book to believe in the unseen. Each of the two faiths is obligatory for everyone, and no one is successful on guidance from his Lord except with this and this.

As for the saying of the Christians, “We are the ones who believed in the Lord Christ and we did not see him,” so the Jews believed in Moses - peace be upon him - and they did not see him. And the Muslims believed in Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and they did not see him. Rather, the Muslims believed in Moses and Jesus and the rest of the prophets and they did not see them other than Jews and Christians who believed in some and disbelieved in others.

Then what is meant by the unseen is the image of the Prophet - peace be upon him -, for the image of the Prophet is not from the unseen, for people see it and there is nothing in seeing it that necessitates Faith or disbelief, but the unseen is what is absent from the sight of creation, and it is what the prophets were informed of from the unseen, so faith enters into it. In God and His angels and His books and His messengers, which is belief that they are God’s messengers, and whether their bodies are seen or not, someone may see them. He did not believe in their message, and someone who did not see them might believe in their message.

What is meant is belief in their message, not in their forms, such that someone says, “We believe in a prophet and have not seen him,” and he may know from the evidence of his prophecy and signs. His message is better known to those who have not seen him than to those who have seen him.

Chapter: As for his saying: In Surah Al-Ma’idah {And We left in their tracks Jesus, son of Mary, confirming what was before him of the Torah, and We gave him The Gospel contains guidance and light, confirming what was before it of the Torah, and guidance and admonition for the righteous - and let the people of the Gospel judge by what was revealed. God is in it, and whoever does not judge by what God has revealed - those are the transgressors.} [Al-Ma’idah: 46-47] This is a praise from him for Christ and the Gospel and an order. For the Christians to judge according to what was revealed in it; He also praised Moses and the Torah more highly than He praised Christ and the Gospel, and God Almighty said:

{O Messenger, let not those who hasten to disbelief grieve you, among those who say, “We believe” with their mouths, but whose hearts do not believe, and among those who are Jews. They are listeners to lies, listeners to other people who have not come to you.} [Al-Ma’idah: 41] That is, they are tellers of lies, truthful, responsive and obedient to other people.
They did not come to you, for they believe the lie and are obedient to whoever opposes you, and you are the Messenger of God.
Both believing a lie and obeying one who disobeys the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - are among the greatest sins.
The word hearer means feeling the sound, understanding the meaning, and accepting it. It is said: So-and-so heard what so-and-so says, meaning he believes him. Or he obeys him and accepts him.
His saying: They listen to the lie, meaning they believe it. Otherwise, simply hearing the voice of the liar and understanding his words is not reprehensible at all.

Likewise, you are listeners to other people who did not come to you, that is, those who respond to them and are obedient. As he said: Against the hypocrites, and among you are those who listen to them, that is, responsive and obedient to them. And whoever says: What is meant by the spy is as wrong as an error. Who said:

Those who listen to them are the spies, for the spy only conveys the news of the people to those who do not know him, and it is known that the Prophet - may God’s prayers and peace be upon him And peace be upon him - what he mentioned, ordered, and did was seen and heard by everyone in Medina, whether they were believers or hypocrites, and he did not mean to The Jews of the city concealed what he said and did, unlike the Jews who used to come to him, and they believed the lie and obeyed the Jews.

others who did not come to Him, and God forbade His Prophet from letting those who hasten to disbelieve from these two hypocritical sects who showed grief to him grieve him. Believing in Him, but their hearts do not believe, and from the People of the Book who ask for He to judge between them, and their intention is not to obey Him and follow Him. Rather, if he ruled according to what they liked, they accepted it, and if he ruled otherwise, they did not accept it because they were obedient to other people who did not follow him.

God Almighty said: “Those who listen to lies are listeners to other people.” [Al-Ma’idah: 41] That is, those other people have not come to you saying, that is, the listeners say, “Indeed, You have been given this, then take it, but if you are not given it, then beware. And whose trial God desires, it will not possess for him anything from God. Those are whom God does not desire. To purify their hearts. For them in this world is disgrace, and for them in the Hereafter is a great punishment.} [Al-Ma’idah:

41] Judgment lacks honesty and justice, so the witness must be truthful and the judge just, and these people believe the lying witnesses. And they follow the rule of those who oppose the Messengers who rule by other than what God has revealed, and if their intention is not to follow truthfulness and justice, then you do not have to do so. To judge between them. Rather, if you wish, judge between them, and if you wish, do not judge.
But when you judge, do not judge except by what God has revealed to you, since it is justice.

God Almighty said: {Those who listen to lies are devourers of evil. But if they come to you, judge between them, or turn away from them, but if you turn away from them, you will not. They will harm you in any way, but if you judge, judge between them with justice. Indeed, God loves those who are just.} [Al-Maeda:

42], Then he said, {And how can they make you judge when with them is the Torah, in which is the judgment of God? Then they turn away after that, and those are not believers. - Indeed, We sent down the Torah, in which is guidance and light. The prophets who submitted to those who are Jewish, and the divines, and the rabbis, judge by it by what they were preserved from. The Book of God, and they were witnesses to it. So do not fear people, but fear me, and do not exchange My verses for a small price. And whoever does not judge by what God has revealed Those are the disbelievers - and We prescribed for them therein that life for a life, an eye for an eye, nose for nose, ear for ear, tooth for tooth. With tooth and wounds there is retaliation, so whoever gives it in charity, it will be an expiation for him, and whoever does not judge by what God has revealed - those are the wrongdoers.} [Al-Maeda:

43 - 45] So this is his praise of the Torah and telling him that in it is the judgment of God and that He sent down the Torah and in it is “guidance and light by which He judges.” The prophets who submitted to those who are guided} [Al-Ma’idah: 44] And he said: after mentioning it: {And whoever does not judge by what God has revealed - those are the disbelievers} [Al-Ma’idah: 44]

This is greater than what he mentioned in the Gospel, for he said: In the Gospel {And We gave him the Gospel, in it was guidance and light} [Al-Ma’idah: 46] and he said in it: {And let the people of the Gospel judge by what God has revealed therein, and whoever does not judge by what God has revealed - those are the disobedient} [Al-Ma’idah: 47] And he said: in The Torah {by it the prophets who have submitted to those who have been guided shall judge} [Al-Ma’idah: 44] and he said: after mentioning it: {and whoever does not judge by what God has revealed It is those who are the disbelievers.} [Al-Ma’idah: 44] And He, Glory be to Him, while informing Him of the revelation of the two Books, describes the Torah in a greater way than what He describes with it. The Gospel.
As He - the Almighty - said: {Indeed, We sent down the Torah, in which is guidance and light; by it the prophets who submitted to those who were Jews judged.} [Al-Ma’idah:

44] And if what he mentioned of praising Moses and the Torah does not necessitate praising the Jews who denied Christ and Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - There is no praise in it for the changed religion of the Jews, which was abrogated by agreement of Muslims and Christians. Likewise, what he mentioned of praising Christ is also not in it. The Gospel does not contain praise for the Christians who denied Muhammad and changed the rulings of the Torah and the Gospel and followed the changed and abrogated, and the Jews agree. The Muslims agree that there is no praise for the Christians in what was mentioned, and the Christians agree with the Muslims that there is no praise for the Jews in what was mentioned after the abrogation. And the switch.

It is known that all religions: Muslims, Jews, and Christians agree that the Torah is not mentioned in the Qur’an. The Gospel, Moses, and Jesus are praise for the People of the Book who denied Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and there is no praise for their changed religion before he was sent. There is no praise in that for one who adheres to a changed religion or an abrogated religion, so how about one who adheres to a changed and abrogated religion?

chapters.title: The chapter on establishing the proof for those to whom the call of the Messengers has reached
paragraphs: [Chapter: Establishing the proof for those to whom the call of the Messengers has reached]
Here is a principle that must be clarified, which is that the texts have indicated that God does not punish except those to whom He sends a messenger with whom the proof can be established. On him.

God Almighty said: {And every human being We have bound his bird around his neck, and We will bring forth for him on the Day of Resurrection a book which he will find spread open - Read your book, it is enough. Today, you are a judge over yourself - whoever is guided, it is for his own soul that he is guided, and whoever goes astray, he only misleads it, and no female bearer of burdens bears the burden of another, and what We will punish until We send a messenger.} [Al-Isra: 13-15] And God Almighty said: {Messengers bringing good tidings and warnings, so that people may have no argument against God after the messengers.} [An-Nisa: 165] And God Almighty said:

Concerning the people of Hell: “Whenever a crowd is thrown into it, its keepers will ask them: Has there not come to you a warner?” They will say, “Yes, a warner has come to us.” But we lied and said: “What?” God sent down something} [Al-Mulk: 8-9] and said:

{And those who disbelieved will be led into Hell in groups until, when they have reached it, its gates will be opened, and its keepers will say to them: Did not messengers from among you come to you? They recite to you the verses of your Lord and warn you of the meeting of this day of yours. They said, “Yes, but the word of torment has become certain upon the disbelievers.” [Az-Zumar: 71] And he said - God Almighty -: {O community of jinn and mankind, did not come to you messengers from among you who narrated to you My verses and warned you of the meeting of yours? This is your day. They said, “We bear witness.” against Ourselves, and they were deceived by the life of this world, and they bore witness against themselves that they were disbelievers.} [Al-An'am: 130] And God Almighty said:

{And your Lord will never destroy the towns until He has sent into their towns a messenger reciting to them Our verses. And We will never destroy the towns unless their people are wrongdoers.} [Al-Qasas: 59] And God Almighty said: {And that some calamity should not strike them for what their hands have sent forward, so that they should say, “Our Lord, had You not sent to us a messenger” [Al-Qasas: 47] To his saying: {And when the truth came to them from Us, they said, “If only I had not been given the like of what Moses was given. Have they not disbelieved in what Moses was given before?” They said: Two magicians put themselves together and said, “Indeed, we are disbelievers in everything.” [Al-Qasas: 48].

And He - the Almighty - said: {O People of the Book, Our Messenger has come to you, making clear to you much of what you were concealing from the Book} [Al-Ma’idah: 15] and He said: {O People of the Book, Our Messenger has come to you, explaining to you, for a period of time, the meaning of the Messengers, so that you should say, “None of good tidings or warner has come to us. Indeed, there has come to you.” A giver of good tidings and a warner, and God has power over all things.} [Al-Ma’idah: 19] And if that is the case, then it is known that the proof is established only by the Qur’an over those who reach it. Such as His saying: {That I may warn you therewith and whomsoever it reaches} [Al-An’am:

19] So whoever is informed of some parts of the Qur’an and not others, the argument will be established against him by what he was informed of and not by what he did not convey. If the meaning of some verses is doubtful, The people disputed over the interpretation of the verse, and what they disputed over must be returned to God and His Messenger. If the people strive to understand what the Messenger - may God bless him and grant him peace - intended Peace and blessings of God be upon him - the one who is right has a reward and the one who is wrong has a reward, so it is not forbidden for that to be said about the People of the Book before us, so whoever did not reach it. In all the texts of the Book before us, no proof was established except by what was conveyed to him and what was hidden from them in its meaning, so he strove to know it.

If he gets it right, he will have two rewards, and if he makes a mistake, he will have a reward, and his mistake will be forgiven. As for whoever intentionally distorts the Scripture, its wording or meaning, and knows Whatever the Messenger brought and he rebelled against him, this person deserves to be punished. The same applies to whoever neglects to seek the truth and follow it, following his own desires and distracted from his desires. That is his worldly life.

Based on this, if some of the People of the Book have distorted some of the Book and there are others among them who did not know that, then they strive to follow what The Messenger brought it. It is not necessary to make these people among those subject to the threat. And if it is permissible for there to be among the People of the Book those who do not know all What Christ did not bring, rather some of what he brought or some of its meanings were hidden from him, so he worked hard and was not punished for what he did not convey. There may be news The Jews who were with Tuba and those who were waiting to believe in Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - were from the people of Medina, like Ibn al-Tayhan. And others agreed on this, and that they were not denying Christ like other Jews were.

People have disputed over whether it is possible, with diligence and exhaustion of effort, to not make it clear to the discerning observer the truthfulness of the Messenger or not. If this is not made clear to him, does he deserve punishment in the hereafter or not? .

Some people also disagreed about the imitator among them, and the discussion was in two places: The first place: in explaining the error of the one who opposes the truth and his misguidance, and this is what He teaches in multiple ways, intellectual and auditory, and he may recognize the error in many statements of the people of the Qiblah who are contrary to the truth and are not people of the Qiblah. The qibla is indicated by various types of indications.
The second place: speaking about their disbelief and their deserving of the threat of the Hereafter.
This contains three sayings from the people of the famous imams Malik and Al-Shafi’i, and I praise them for the three opinions.

It was said: He will be tortured in Hell who does not believe, even if a messenger is not sent to him to establish the argument against him with reason, and this is the opinion of many who say With rational judgment from the scholars of theology and jurisprudence from the companions of Abu Hanifa and others, and this is the choice of Abu Al-Khattab.

And it was said: There is no proof against him based on reason. Rather, it is not permissible to torture someone who has not established proof against him, neither according to law nor reason, and this is the opinion of those who It is permissible to torture the children of infidels and the insane, and this is the opinion of many theologians, such as Al-Jahm, Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ash’ari and his companions. And the judge Abi Ya’la, Ibn Aqeel and others.

The third saying: The predecessors and imams agreed upon it, that no one is punished except the one to whom the message has been conveyed, and no one is tortured except the one who disobeys the messengers. As indicated by the Qur’an and Sunnah.
God Almighty said: To Iblis: “I will certainly fill Hell with you and those who follow you, all of them” [p. 85]. And if that is the case, then we will debate. In it are the People of the Book:

Their early and late ones. Sometimes we speak in the first place, which is an explanation of their violation of the truth, their ignorance, and their misguidance. This is a warning. For all the legal and rational evidence, and sometimes we explain their disbelief, by which they deserve torment in this world and the hereafter, this is his matter until God and His Messenger do not speak about it except what the Messengers have been informed of; Just as we also do not bear witness to faith and Paradise except for those to whom the Messengers testified and against whom no proof has been established in this world by means of the Message. Like children, the insane, and people of different periods, these people have statements among them, the most evident of which is what the narrations have brought, that they will be tested on the Day of Judgment. Resurrection, then God will send to them those who will command them to obey Him. If they obey Him, they will deserve reward, and if they disobey Him, they will deserve punishment.
If that is the case, then we bear witness that whoever believed in Moses and followed him, that he is a believer and a Muslim deserving of reward.

Likewise, whoever believes in Christ follows him, and we bear witness to the one against whom the argument was established through Moses and did not follow him, like the people of Pharaoh, that they were among the People of Hell.

And likewise those upon whom the proof of Christ has been established, about whom God said: “God said, ‘Indeed, I am sending it down to you. But whoever among you yet disbelieves, then I will I will punish him with a punishment that I will not punish anyone among the worlds.} [Al-Ma’idah: 115] And about them He said:

{O Jesus, I will cause you to die, and I will raise you to Me, and I will purify you from those who disbelieve, and I will place those who follow you above those who disbelieve, until the Day of Resurrection, then to Me. Your return is that I will judge between you concerning that wherein you differed - but as for those who disbelieve, I will punish them with a severe punishment in this world and the Hereafter, and that is not theirs. As for those who are helpers - and as for those who believe and do righteous deeds, He will give them their rewards in full. And God does not like wrongdoers.} [Al Imran:

55 - 57] As for him after his covenant with the Messiah and some of his news reached him but not others, or with Moses and some of his news reached him but not some, For these people, the argument was based on what had reached them of their information, not what had not reached them of what had not reached them. And if they differed in the interpretation Some of the Torah and the Gospel, so whoever seeks the truth and strives to seek it, it is not obligatory

That he be punished, even if he was wrong about the truth, ignorant of it, and strayed from it, like one who strives to seek the truth from the nation of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace.
Based on this, when it is said:

That the disciples, or some of them, or many of the People of the Book, or most of them, believed that Christ himself was crucified. They were wrong. In that, this error was not something that would taint their faith in Christ if they believed in what he brought and it did not make them subject to Hell. The Gospels Which, in the hands of the People of the Book, mentions the crucifixion of Christ, and according to them it is taken from the four: Mark, Luke, John, Matthew, and Among the four there was no one who witnessed the crucifixion of Christ, nor among the disciples, nor among his followers anyone who witnessed his crucifixion, but rather those who witnessed the crucifixion. A group of Jews. Some people say that they are:

They knew that the one who was crucified was someone else, and they deliberately lied that they had crucified him, and his crucifixion was likened to those who told them. This is the opinion of a group of the people of The words of the Mu'tazila and others, and this is the statement of Ibn Hazm

And others, and among them are those who say, “Rather, he made suspicion against those who crucified him.” This is the saying of most people, and the early ones say that his saying: {And what They killed him, but they did not crucify him, but it was made similar to them.

The public say: Rather, it is likened to those who say they crucified him, as the story has been mentioned elsewhere. What is meant here is that people in this position are on two extremes and a middle.

As for one party: they are the extremists among the Christians who claim that the disciples were infallible in what they said and narrated and saw. They also say that Christian scholars are correct in what they say regarding the interpretation of the Gospel.
The other side says: Rather, everyone who errs and commits a mistake in any of these things is deserving of the threat, but rather an unbeliever.

And the third: The middle: They are not infallible nor are they held accountable. Rather, they may be wrong, a mistake that will be forgiven if they are diligent in finding out. The truth and following it according to their ability and energy, and the correct evidence indicates this and the books of God indicate the condemnation of the misguided and the ungrateful and his abhorrence with them. He is not punished except after being warned.

It has been proven in the Sahih on the authority of Iyadh bin Himar, on the authority of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - that he said: “Indeed, God looked at the people of the earth and hated them.” “Arabs and non-Arabs, except a remnant of the People of the Book.”

So he told that he hated them, except for these remnants, and hate is hatred, in fact, the most intense hatred, and despite this, he told in the Qur’an He would not punish them until He sent to them a messenger, and He said: {And We would not punish until We had sent a Messenger} [Al-Isra: 15] And He said: {Even if We We destroyed them with a punishment before it. They would have said, “Our Lord, had you not sent to us a messenger so that we might follow Your signs before we were humiliated and disgraced.” [Taha: 134] This indicates that the necessitation for their punishment exists, but the condition of punishment is the attainment of the message, and for this reason he said {so that people may have no argument against God after the messengers} [An-Nisa’:

165] And in the two Sahih books on the authority of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - that he said: “No one loves an excuse more than God; For that reason He sent messengers and sent down the scriptures.

And in a narration, “For that reason, the messengers were sent as bearers of good tidings and warnings, and no one loves praise more than God. For that reason He praised Himself, and no one is more jealous than God. For that reason He forbade immoral acts, both apparent and hidden.”

People have disputed over the goodness and badness of actions, such as the goodness of justice, monotheism, and truthfulness, and the badness of injustice, polytheism, and lying. Does he know? By reason, or does he not know except by hearing? If it is said that he knows by reason, will he be punished who did that before a messenger comes to him?

Based on three well-known sayings among the companions of the Imams and others, and these are three sayings of the companions of Imam Ahmad and others, so she said A group that does not know this except by Sharia law, not by reason, and this is the opinion of the theorists of the forced, such as Al-Jahm bin Safwan and his likes, and it is The saying of Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ash’ari and his followers among the companions of the four imams, such as the judge Abu Bakr bin Al-Tayyib and Abu Abdullah bin Hamed, Judge Abi Ya’la, and Abi Al-Maali
Abi Al-Wafa bin Aqeel and others, and it was said that the goodness and badness of actions may be known by reason.
Abu Al-Khattab Mahfouz bin Ahmad said, and this is the opinion of most jurists and theologians.

This is what is narrated on the authority of Abu Hanifa himself, and on the authority of most of his companions, and many of the companions of Malik, Al-Shafi’i, Ahmad, and the people of The hadith is like Abu Al-Hasan Al-Tamimi, Abu Al-Khattab, Abu Bakr Al-Qaffal, Abu Nasr Al-Sajzi, and Abu Al-Qasim Saad bin Ali Al-Zanjani, and he is The saying of the Karamiyyah and others from the view of predestination is the view of the Mu’tazila and other view of Qadariyya, then these are on Two sayings: Some of them say:

They deserve the punishment of the Hereafter simply because they contradict reason, as the Mu’tazila, the Hanafi, and Abu Al-Khattab say, and the opinion of these people is contrary to For the Qur’an and the Sunnah.

And among them are those who say, “Rather, they will not be punished until a messenger is sent to them.” As indicated by the Qur’an and Sunnah. But their actions are reprehensible and abhorrent, God condemns them and hates them, and they are described as disbelief, which God condemns and hates, even if it is not the case. He tortures them until he sends a messenger to them. As he said: The Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - in the authentic hadith; As mentioned above, “Indeed, God looked at the people of the earth and detested them, their Arabs and non-Arabs, except for remnants of the People of the Book. And indeed, my Lord said: For me, arise in Quraysh, so warn them. I said, “Then they will cut off my head until they call it bread.”

He said: “Indeed, I have afflicted you and I will be afflicted by you, and I have revealed to you a book that cannot be washed away by water. You read it while asleep and awake, so send an army.” Like them, and fight with those who obey you and those who disobey you, and spend and I will spend on you.”

And he said: “Indeed, I created My servants as single-minded people, but the devils swindled them and prohibited for them what I had made lawful for them, and I commanded them to associate with Me as long as I had not been sent down. There is authority in Him.”
He said: The Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - said in the authentic hadith: “Every child is born according to the fitrah.”

And in a narration: “He followed this religion, and his parents converted him to Judaism, converted him to Christianity, and converted him to Christianity; “Just as an animal produces a whole animal, do you sense any calf in it?” Then Abu Hurairah - may God be pleased with him - says: “Read if you wish.” {The nature of God with which He created people} [Al-Rum: 30] It was said, O Messenger of God, have you seen any of the children of the polytheists who die when they are young? He said: God knows best. Because of what they were doing and despite God’s detestation of them, He declared that He would not torture them until He sent to them a messenger.” This indicates that Invalidating the statement of those who said:

Because they were not doing evil nor committing any evil until the hearing came. And the saying of those who said: They were tortured without hearing, either for establishing the argument with reason; As said by those who say it out of destiny or out of pure will; As the forced one says.

God Almighty said: {And your Lord will never destroy the towns until He has sent into their towns a messenger reciting to them Our revelations. And We will never destroy the towns except And its people are wrongdoers.} [Al-Qasas: 59] And God Almighty said: {And had not a calamity afflicted them for what their hands have forwarded, they would say, “Our Lord, had you not sent to us as a Messenger, so we will follow Your revelations and be of the believers.} [Al-Qasas: 47]

And He Almighty said: {And if We had destroyed them with a punishment before it, they would have said, “Our Lord, had You not sent to us a messenger so that we might follow Your signs before that.” He was humiliated and disgraced} [Taha: 134] This makes it clear that he would not torture the disbelievers until he sent them a messenger, and it made clear that before the messenger they were They have acquired deeds that necessitate abhorrence and censure and are a cause of torment, but the condition of torment is that the proof against them be established by the Message.

chapters.title: Separating the reasons for the misguidance of Christians and those like them
paragraphs: [Chapter: Reasons for the misguidance of Christians and those like them]
It should be known that the reason for the misguidance of the Christians and others like them, like the extremists of the worshipers, the Shiites, and others, is three things: One of them:

Similar, general, problematic words that were transmitted from the prophets, but they turned away from the clear and precise words and adhered to them, while they always They heard a statement of theirs that contained a suspicion in it, and they adhered to it and accepted it according to their doctrine, even if there was no evidence for that. And the explicit words that contradict Therefore, they either delegate it, or they interpret it as the misguided people do, following the similar from the mental and auditory evidence. They deviate from the clear ruling in both parts.

The second: supernatural phenomena that they thought were signs, but they are from the states of the devils, and this is what led astray many of the polytheists and others astray, such as the entry into Demons in idols and their words to people, and such as demons telling soothsayers unseen things, and they must also be lying. Such actions occur from demons.

And the third: News conveyed to them that they thought was the truth, but it is a lie. Otherwise, neither the Christians nor other misguided people will be with them in their falsehood. There is no clear and reasonable narration, nor a true narration, nor any of the verses of the prophets. Rather, if they speak in a reasonable manner, they speak in similar, comprehensive words. If they inquire about the meanings of those words, and differentiate between their truth and falsehood, the confusion and suspicion in them will become clear.
If they speak something that is transmitted, then it is either true but does not indicate their falsehood.
Or it is not true and proven, but rather a lie.

The same applies to what they mention of supernatural customs: either it is true and it appeared at the hands of a prophet, like the miracles of Christ and those before him. Like Elijah, Elisha, and other prophets, and like the miracles of Moses, this is true.

Or it may have appeared at the hands of some righteous people, such as the disciples, and that does not necessitate that they be infallible, like the prophets. The prophets are infallible in what they convey. It is inconceivable that they would say anything about God except the truth, and that nothing falsehood would be found in their words, whether intentionally or by mistake.

As for the righteous, one of them may make a mistake and make mistakes while supernatural things appear at his hands, and that does not remove him from being a righteous man and does not He must be infallible if he did not claim infallibility and did not bring verses indicating that. If he claimed infallibility and was not a prophet, he would have been A liar whose lie will inevitably become apparent and the devils will associate with him and lead him astray, and it will be included in His saying - the Most High -: {Shall I inform you upon whom it was revealed? The devils descend upon every sinful predator.} [Al-Shu’ara’:

221] The Christians have a narration in the Gospels that the one who was crucified and buried in the grave was seen by some of the disciples and others after he was buried, and he rose from the grave. They saw his grave two or three times, and he showed them the place of the nails and said: Do not think that I am a devil.

If this is true, then this is a devil who claimed to be the Messiah and misled those people, and something like this has happened to a great creation in our time. Before our time, people were in Palmyra and saw a great person flying in the air. He appeared to them several times in various types of clothing and said to them: I am the Messiah, the son of Mary, and I ordered them to do things that the Messiah, peace be upon him, would not have ordered. They came to the people and explained to them that That is Satan who wanted to lead them astray.

And others, one of them comes to the grave of someone whom he venerates and thinks highly of among the righteous and others, and sometimes he sees that the grave has split open and out of it comes out. A man in the image of that man. Sometimes he sees that man having entered the grave, and sometimes he sees him either riding or walking entering that place. The dead person is like a dome built over the grave, and sometimes he sees him leaving that place and thinks that this is that righteous man. He thinks that some people asked him for help, so he went to them, and this is a devil who took his own image, and this happened to more than one of the people I know. Sometimes he cries for help

People are concerned about a person whom they have good suspicions about. He is either dead or absent. They see him with their own eyes. He has come, he may speak to them, and he may decide some of the matters. their needs, so they think he is that dead person, but it is a devil who claimed to be him, but he is not him, and often the person comes after... Death takes the form of the dead person, so he talks to them, pays debts, returns deposits, and tells them about the dead, and they think that he is the dead person himself. He has come to them, but he is a devil who took his own image.

This is very common, especially in polytheistic countries such as India and the like. Among these people you see under his bed, taking his son’s hand in... The funeral, and among them are those who say, “When I die, do not let anyone wash me,” for I come from this direction and wash myself, so it will come after death. A person in the air in his own image, being washed by him and the one who commanded him. This person thinks that he has come, but it is a devil who was created in his own image at times. One of them sees a person who is either flying in the air, or has a great character, or tells him unseen things, and the like, and says to him I am Al-Khidr, and that person may be a devil who lied to that person.

The seer is from the people of religion, asceticism, and worship, and this has happened to more than one person, and sometimes he sees at the grave of a prophet or someone else that the dead person has He came out either from his room or from his grave and embraced that visitor and greeted him, and he became a devil taking on his image, and sometimes someone comes. He goes to that person's grave and asks him for permission to do things and asks him about matters, and a person he sees or hears a voice but does not see will speak to him. A person, and that is a devil who led him astray.

He may see people while awake, either riding or not riding, and they say: This is so-and-so, the Prophet, or Abraham, or the Messiah, or Muhammad. This is so-and-so, the truthful, either Abu Bakr, or Omar, or some of the disciples, and this is so-and-so, for someone who believes in righteousness, either Girgis or Others whom the Christians venerate or some Muslim sheikhs, and that is a devil who claimed to be that prophet or that sheikh or friend or Saint.

Something like this happens frequently to many polytheists, Christians, and many Muslims, and one of them sees a sheikh who thinks well of him and says: I am such-and-such sheikh, and he is a devil, and I know a lot of this, and I know more than one person who seeks help from some of the absent and dead sheikhs. He sees that he came to him during his wakefulness and helped him.

Something like this happened to me and to others I know. More than one of them mentioned that he had sought help from me from a far away country and that he had seen me come to him and among them. Who said: I saw you riding in your dress and image, and among them was he who said: I saw you on a mountain, and among them was he who said: Other than that, so I told them that I I did not help them, but that is a devil who took my image to mislead them when they associated partners with God and called on other than God.

Likewise, more than one of our companions I know sought help from someone who thought well of him and saw that he had come to him and fulfilled his need. My companion said: And I do not know of that. Among these sheikhs is someone who says that he hears the voice of that person who is calling for help and answers him, and the devils are She made him hear a voice similar to the voice of the sheikh to whom he was seeking help, so the sheikh answered him with his own voice, so she made the one seeking help hear a voice similar to the voice of the sheikh. He thinks it is the voice of the sheikh.

This happened to someone I know and he told this about himself and said: The genie who speaks to me continues to inform me like the voice of those calling for my help. And He conveys to them something like my voice, and He shows me something white corresponding to what I ask about, so I inform the people of it that I have seen Him and that He will come, but not I may have seen him, but I saw his resemblance.
This is what the jinn do to those who swear upon them and swear by them.

Likewise, what Constantine saw of the cross that he saw was made of stars, and the cross that he saw another time was what the devils represented and he showed them. That is to mislead them thereby; And the devils did something even greater than that to idol worshipers.

Likewise, whoever mentions that Christ came to him during his wakefulness and spoke to him about matters; As it is mentioned about Paul, if he was telling the truth, then he was the one whom he saw in his wakefulness and said: He is the Messiah, a demon from among the demons. This also happened to more than one person.

Satan only misleads people and tempts them with what he thinks they will obey him, so he speaks to Christians in a way that is compatible with their religion, and he speaks to whomever he speaks From misleading the Muslims in a way that is consistent with his belief and moving it to a place in which he responds to them in accordance with their belief.

For this reason, he is represented by the Christians who seek help from George, in the image of George, or in the image of someone whom the Christians seek help from among the leaders of their religion. Either some patriarchs, or some bishops, or some monks, and he is represented by a sheikh of the Muslims who seek help from the error of the Muslims. The elders in the image of that sheikh; He also appeared to a group of people I know in my image and in the image of a group of sheikhs who mentioned that, and he often appears in the image of some The dead sometimes say, “I am Sheikh Abdul Qadir.” Sometimes he says, “I am Sheikh Abu Al-Hajjaj Al-Aqsari,” and sometimes he says, “I am Sheikh Uday,” and sometimes he says, “I am Sheikh Adi.” I am Ahmad bin Al-Rifa’i, and sometimes he says I am Abu Madin.

The Moroccan, and if he says I am the Messiah, or Abraham, or Muhammad, then change them to the path of the first. And the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - said: “Whoever sees me in a dream has truly seen me, for Satan does not appear in my form.” And in one narration, “in the form of The Prophets.
Seeing the prophets in a dream is true, but as for seeing the dead person awake, this is a jinn taking his form.

Some people call this the sheikh’s spirituality, and some say it is his companion, and many of these people are seen getting up from his place and leaving in In his place is an image like his image, and many of these people, and of these people, say that he was seen in two places, and he was seen standing in Arafat, and he was not in his country. He goes away, and the people who do not know remain confused.
A clear mind knows that one body cannot be in two places at the same time.
The truthful people have seen this with their own eyes and do not doubt it. This is why conflict often occurs between some people and others. As this has happened more than once.
This is true in what he saw and witnessed, and this is true in what the clear mind indicated.
But that person who was seen was a genie who took the form of a human.
As for the senses, if there are no rationalities with them that reveal their truths, otherwise a major mistake will occur in them.

This oath that is witnessed outside is not what a person imagines in himself, for this is known by all people and all rational people are correct about it. They imagine things within themselves; Just as the sleeper imagines it in his dream, and that image exists in the imagination, not outside.

Philosophers and all other wise people acknowledge this, but many philosophers think that what the angels and prophets saw The speech I heard was of this type, and they think that what is seen of the jinn is of this type, and these people are ignorant in this matter. They were also ignorant and mistaken in their belief that extraordinary customs are caused by psychological, natural, or astronomical forces, and that the difference between the Prophet - May God’s prayers and peace be upon him - and the magician only has the good intention of the one, and the bad intention of the other. Otherwise, they are both supernatural things caused by forces. psychological or astronomical, and this denial is false; We have also expanded the discussion on it and demonstrated the ignorance and misguidance of these people in other than this place.

And those who witnessed this abroad and whose existence has been confirmed by reliable and frequent reports of the existence of this abroad know that these people They are ignorant and misguided, and they know that angels appear in the form of humans. Just as she appeared to Abraham, Lot, and Mary in human form, and as Gabriel used to appear to the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - sometimes in the form of Dihya al-Kalbi sometimes appears in the form of a Bedouin, and many people see him with their own eyes, and what is in a person’s imagination no one else sees, and likewise as it appears. Satan appeared to the polytheists in the form of Sheikh Al-Najdi, and he appeared to them on the day of Badr in the form of Suraqa bin Malik bin Jasham, and when he saw the angels He ran away.

God Almighty said: {And when Satan made their deeds seem pleasing to them, and said, “None of the people can defeat you today, and indeed I am your neighbor.” When the two groups saw each other, He turned on his heels and said, “I am innocent of you. Indeed, I see what you do not see. Indeed, I fear God, and God is severe in punishment.” [Al-Anfal: 48] It was narrated on the authority of Ibn Abbas and others said: Satan appeared in the form of a host of devils and with him a banner in the form of men from a mall, and Satan appeared in the form of Suraqa bin Malik bin Jasham said: {No man can defeat you today, and indeed I am your neighbor} [Al-Anfal:

48] And Gabriel - peace be upon him - approached Satan, and when he saw him and his hand was in the hand of a man of the polytheists, Satan snatched his hand and turned away. He and his companions said: The man, thief, do you claim that you are our neighbor? Then he said: {Indeed, I see what you do not see. Indeed, I fear God, and God is severe in punishment.} [Al-Anfal: 48]

Ibn Abbas said: That was when he saw the angels. Al-Dahhak said: Satan walked with them with his banner and his soldiers and cast into the hearts of the polytheists No one will defeat you while you fight for your religion and the religion of your fathers.

Many people are carried by the jinn to a far place, and they carry many people to Arafat and non-Arafat, and if one of these is seen In a country other than his country, he is sometimes carried by the jinn and sometimes created in his image, and this is not one of the God-fearing guardians whom they have. Karamat, but he may be one of the unbelievers or sinners, and I know of many issues that this is not the place to detail.
The polytheists and Christians have many of these things, which they think are of the same type as the signs of the prophets.

Rather, it is of a kind for magicians, soothsayers, and those who do not differentiate between the guardians of the Most Gracious and the guardians of Satan and do not differentiate between miracles. The prophets, the miracles of the righteous, and the miracles of magicians, soothsayers, and those with whom the devils are associated. Otherwise, he will confuse truth with falsehood, then either Either he disbelieves in the truth brought by the true prophets, or he believes in the falsehood that he says: the liars and the deceivers.

These matters have been explained in another place, and the intention here is to point out this principle, and Christian scholars accept this. And they have many news of that, from the stories of the guardians of Satan, whom the guardians of the Most Merciful opposed and invalidated their conditions. Just as Moses - may God’s prayers be upon him - nullified the supernatural things that the magicians had opposed to him, as was mentioned in the Torah and as they mention it on the authority of so-and-so. And so-and-so, like the story of Simon the Magician with the Apostles and other things. If this is known, then what they mention is of this type. If it contradicts what has been proven from the Prophets regarding Satan, then it is not permissible to use it as evidence for what contradicts the laws of the Prophets proven from them. Rather, these are of the same type as the great antichrist whom all the prophets warned about, even Noah warned his people and said:
Seal of the Messengers: “There is no prophet who did not warn his nation, even Noah warned

His people, and I will tell you about him something that no prophet has ever said to his nation, that he is one-eyed, and indeed your Lord is not one-eyed. Infidel is written between his eyes. (KFR) Every believer, reader and non-reader, reads it and says: And know that none of you will see his Lord until he dies.

It was reported that the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, the Messiah of guidance, would descend to earth at the white minaret east of Damascus, and kill the Messiah. Misguidance: This is what the Jews are waiting for, and they deny the Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, and say, “This is what the prophets preached about.” And seventy thousand of the Jews of Isfahan will follow him, and the Muslims will kill them, along with Jesus, son of Mary, with the worst kind of murderers, so much so that the trees say And the stone, O Muslim, this is a Jew behind me. Come and kill him.

All of this is proven in the Sahih on the authority of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - and for this reason he commanded his nation to seek refuge in God from his temptation, and he said: “If If one of you sits in the tashahhud of prayer, let him seek refuge in God from four torments of Hell, from the torment of the grave, and from the trials of life and death. And from the temptation of the Antichrist.”

And all the prophets warned of liars who imitate the prophets, but there are people who deliberately lie, and many of them He does not do it intentionally, but rather he becomes confused and makes a mistake, so he tells what he thinks is true and it is not so, and he sees in waking life what he thinks is so-and-so, his guardian or The Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - or Al-Khidr, but that is not the case.

Error is permissible for everyone except the prophets - peace be upon them - for they are infallible and do not admit to error, so whoever does not weigh his knowledge And his deeds, words, and actions are according to what is known about the prophets. Otherwise, he is misguided. We ask God Almighty to guide us to the path. The straight is the path of those upon whom He has bestowed blessings, of the prophets, the truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous. And He is a good companion to those.

Muslims and the People of the Book agree on proving two Messiahs: the Messiah of guidance from the descendants of David and the Messiah of misguidance. The People of the Book say that he is from the descendants of Joseph and they agree that the Messiah of guidance will come just as the Messiah of error will come. But the Muslims and Christians say: The Messiah of guidance is Jesus, son of Mary, and God sent him, then he will come a second time, but the Muslims They say that he will descend before the Day of Resurrection and kill the false Messiah, break the cross, and kill the pig, and no religion will remain except religion. Islam, and the People of the Book, the Jews and Christians, believe in it.

As God Almighty said: {And there is not one of the People of the Book except that someone will believe in him before his death} [An-Nisa’: 159] and the correct statement that the majority adhere to. Before the death of Christ, God Almighty said: “And indeed, it is knowledge of the Hour, so do not confuse it.” [Al-Zukhruf: 61] As for the Christians, they think that He is God and that He The Day of Resurrection will come for the reckoning of the creatures and their recompense, and this is what they went astray into. The Jews acknowledge the coming of the Messiah as a guidance who will come but They claim that Jesus - peace be upon him - was not the Messiah of guidance because they think that he brought the replaced religion of the Christians, and whoever brings it is a liar and they are false. They are waiting for the Christians.

chapters.title: Chapter on the supernatural things by which the devils mislead the children of Adam
paragraphs: [Chapter: The supernatural things by which the devils mislead the children of Adam]

And the miracles by which the devils mislead the children of Adam, such as the devil imagining the image of an absent or dead person and the like, are led astray by them. There are many people who are affiliated with the Muslims or the People of the Book and others, and they build this on two premises.
One of them is: Whoever did this appear on his hands, he is a guardian of God, and in the language of the Christians, he is a great saint.

The second: Whoever is like that is infallible, so everything he tells is true, and everything he commands is just, and it may not be. Paranormal phenomena appeared at his hands, neither merciful nor satanic, but he created a trick from the tricks of the people of liar and immorality, and the tricks of the people of liar. There are so many debaucheries that it is thought that this is one of the supernatural miracles, and it is not like the tricks mentioned about the monks.

Some people have classified the tricks of the monks, such as the trick that was reported about one of them in turning water into oil by having the oil in a hollow. A lampstand, and when it is short, water is poured into it, and the oil floats on the water, and those present think that the same water has turned into oil.

An example of the trick told about them regarding the height of the palm tree is that some of them passed by a monk’s monastery and a palm tree was lower than it, and he saw it. The palm tree went up little by little until it reached the monastery, so he took some of its moisture. Then it went down until it returned to how it was, so the man discovered the trick and found The palm tree is in a ship in a low place. If water is sent over it, it will be filled until the ship comes up. If the water is directed to another place The ship landed.

And like the trick that is told about them in applying kohl with the woman’s tears, they put kohl in gently moving water and it flows until it comes out of the water. That picture, and what appears to be tears come out of her eyes.

And like the trick they did with the image they call Al-Quna in Saydnaya, which is their greatest shrine after the garbage and Bethlehem, where Christ was born and where he was buried, this is the image of the Lady Mary, and its origin is the wood of a palm tree that was watered with ointments until it softened and became The oil comes out of it, an artificial oil that is thought to be from the pool of the image.

One of their many tricks is the fire that their common people think comes down from the sky during their festival in garbage. This is a trick that more than one person has witnessed. Muslims and Christians, and they saw it with their own eyes that it was an artificial fire, with which they misled their common people into thinking that it came down from the sky. And they are blessed by it, but it is the work of a shopkeeper and a fabricator.

There are many Christian tricks like this. Everything that the Christians who changed the religion of Christ have of the supernatural is either a satanic situation or impossible. It is slanderous and does not contain any of the virtues of the righteous.

And likewise the people of atheism who change the religion of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - who adopt a religion that God and His Messenger have not legislated. And they make it a path to God, and they may choose it over the path that God and His Messenger have legislated, such as when they choose to listen to tambourines and drums over Hearing the Book of God Almighty may cause one of them to suffer from satanic temptation and love, such that Satan confuses him with him until he speaks in the tongue of Someone said words that that person would not know if he woke up; Just as the jinn speaks on the lips of the person who is paralyzed, and he may tell some of those present what is within himself, and that is from the devil. If the devil departs, That person did not know what he said:
Among them are those whom Satan carries and ascends in front of the people into the air.
Some of them point to some of those present and they die, fall ill, or become like a piece of wood.
Among them is someone who points to some of those present, and Satan engulfs him and his mind is lost until he stays around for a long time without his choice.
And among them are those who enter fire and consume it, and its flame remains in his body and hair.

And among them are those to whom the devils bring food or something made of lemon, or sugar, or saffron, or rose water, and among them are those to whom they bring money. Demons steal it from some places.

Then among these people, when the dirhams are distributed among those present, they are taken from them and they are not able to dispose of them for matters that are too long to describe, and others are not They have those who help them in this from the devils, and they create tricks and tricks.

Atheists who change the religion of the Messengers, the religion of Christ or the religion of Muhammad - may God bless them and grant them peace - are like their counterparts among the people of atheism. And the astray, the apostate infidels, the polytheists, and the like, such as Musaylimah the liar, Al-Aswad Al-Ansi, Al-Harith Al-Dimashqi, and Baba Al-Rumi. And others who have satanic supernatural powers.

As for the people of deception, they are many, and these are not the saints of God, but rather their supernatural powers, if they are satanic, are of the same type as the supernatural powers of priests. The magicians did not have a satanic state, but rather a deceitful state, for they deliberately lie and confuse, unlike those with whom the devils are associated. For there are those among them who are confused about this and think that this is of the same nature as the karamat of the righteous. Also, there are those among them who know that this is from the devils and do it to achieve their goals, so what is meant is that there are many supernatural things that occur. from the devils, or it uses tricks and tricks and thinks that it is one of the good deeds of the righteous, for what resembles polytheism or immorality is only from the Satan, such as a man associating partners with God and calling upon the stars, or calling upon a human being dead or absent, or summoning and swearing By calling unknown names whose meaning he does not know, or knowing that they are the names of devils, or seeking help from immoralities and injustice, for whatever This is caused by the supernatural, so it is from Satan. This has also been discussed in detail elsewhere.

And the righteous have karamats like the karats of the righteous of this nation and like the karats of the disciples and others who followed the religion of Christ, but The presence of honors at the hands of righteous people does not necessitate that they be infallible like the prophets, but rather the man must be righteous and loyal to God, and he has honors and with This man may make mistakes and err in what he thinks, or in what he hears and narrates, or in what he sees, or in what he understands from the books, and for this reason all Who other than the prophets is taken from their saying:

Other than the prophets - may God’s prayers be upon them all - are left alone, for it is necessary to believe them in everything they are informed of from the unseen, and obey them. In everything they were commanded to do, and for this reason God made it obligatory to believe in what they were given, and He did not make it obligatory to believe in everything that others bring.

God Almighty said: {Say, “We believe in God and in what was sent down to us, and in what was sent down to Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac and Jacob and the tribes and what was given.” Moses and Jesus and what was given to the prophets from their Lord - We make no distinction between any of them, and to Him We submit.} [Al-Baqarah: 136] And He - the Most High - said: {It is not righteousness that you turn away. Your faces face the east and the west, but righteousness is he who believes in God and the Last Day and the angels and the Scripture and the prophets} [Al-Baqarah:

177] For this reason, the Muslims agreed that whoever denies a prophet whose prophecy is known is an infidel and apostate, and whoever insults a prophet must be killed. It is necessary to believe in everything that was given to the prophets.

All of them, and that we make no distinction between any of them, so we believe in some and disbelieve in part. God Almighty said: {Indeed, those who disbelieve in God and His Messengers And they want to make a distinction between God and His messengers, and they say, “We believe in part, and we disbelieve in part,” and they want to take a path between that. Those are they. The disbelievers, indeed, and We have prepared for the disbelievers a humiliating punishment} [An-Nisa: 150] And this is not for anyone except the prophets, even if he were among the messengers of the prophets and they were One of the greatest of the best friends.
The misguidance of these people is based on two premises.
One of them: This man has dignity and is a friend of God.

The second: It is not permissible for God’s guardian to make mistakes, but rather it is necessary to believe him in everything he informs, and obey him in everything he commands, and no one has the right to A human being must be believed in everything he is told and obeyed in every matter, unless he is a prophet.

Of the two aforementioned premises, one of them may be false, or both may be false, as the appointed man may not be one of God’s saints. His supernatural powers are from the devils, and he may be one of God’s saints, but he is not infallible. Rather, he is permitted to make mistakes, and he may not be one of God’s saints, nor It has miracles, but it also has impossibilities and lies.

chapters.title: Separating what the name of the messengers addresses in his saying: Messengers before you lied
paragraphs: [Chapter: What the name of the Messengers mentions in his saying: Messengers before you have been lied to]

They said: And He said in Surah Al-Imran: {Then if they deny you, so have been denied messengers before you. They brought clear proofs and the Psalms and the Book that enlightens.} [Al-Imran: 184] I also mean the enlightening book, which is the Holy Bible.

It is said: It has been mentioned before that the messengers definitely include the messengers whom God mentioned in the Qur’an, especially those of determination such as Noah, Abraham, Moses, and Jesus. The son of Mary, for these are with Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - the Seal of the Prophets - may God’s prayers and peace be upon them - God has singled them out and favored them. By His saying - the Almighty -: {And when We took from the prophets their covenant, and from you and from Noah and Abraham and Moses and Jesus son of Mary, and We took from them A solemn covenant - that He may question the truthful about their truthfulness, and has prepared for the disbelievers a painful punishment} [Al-Ahzab: 7-8]

And in His saying - the Almighty -: {He has prescribed for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah, which We have revealed to you, and what We enjoined upon Abraham, Moses, and Jesus, that you should establish religion, and do not become divided concerning it} [Al-Shura: 13] For religion, the religion of the Messengers of God, is one religion; As God has made clear in His Book, and as it is proven in the two Sahih books on the authority of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - that he said: “We, the company of the prophets, are our religion.” One, and the most worthy of people is the son of Maryam, because there is no prophet between me and him.”

He also mentions the name of the messengers, whom he did not name specifically in the Qur’an. God Almighty said: “Indeed, We have revealed to you just as We revealed to Noah and the prophets.” After him, We revealed to Abraham, and Ishmael, and Isaac, and Jacob, and the tribes, and Jesus, and Job, and Yunus, and Aaron, and Solomon, and We gave David is a Zabur - and messengers whom We have narrated to you before, and messengers whom We have not narrated to you. And God spoke to Moses in speech - messengers bringing good tidings and warnings. So that people may have no argument against God after the Messengers, and God is Mighty, Wise.} [An-Nisa: 163-165]

And He - the Almighty - said: {And We have sent messengers before you. Among them are some whom We narrated to you, and among them are those whom We did not narrate to you.} [Ghafir: 78] And as for The disciples, for God Almighty mentioned them in the Qur’an and described them as Islam, following the Messenger, and believing in God. As was revealed in His saying - the Most High -: {And when Jesus sensed disbelief on their part, he said, “Who are my helpers to God?” The disciples said, “We are God’s helpers. We have believed.” By God, and I bear witness that we are Muslims - Our Lord, we believe in what You have sent down, and we follow the Messenger, so we are recorded with the witnesses} [Al Imran: 52-53] And He - the Most High - said:

{And when I inspired the disciples, “Believe in Me and in My Messenger.” They said, “We believe,” and bear witness that we are Muslims.} [Al-Ma’idah: 111] And God Almighty said: “O Those who believe, be helpers of God, as Jesus, son of Mary, said to the disciples. “Who are my supporters of God?” The disciples said, “We are helpers of God.” So a group of the Children of Israel believed, and a group disbelieved, so We supported those who believed against their enemy, so they became victorious} [As-Saff: 14].

God Almighty did not mention in the Qur’an at all that He sent them, but rather He mentioned that He inspired them to believe in Him and His Messenger and that they were commanded By following His Messenger and his saying: {And when I revealed to the disciples} [Al-Maeda: 111] does not indicate prophecy, for He - Most High - said: {And We revealed to The mother of Moses to breastfeed him} [Al-Qasas: 7]
And the mother of Moses was not a prophet, but there is no prophet among women. As you say: Christians and Muslims in general.
