More than one person mentioned their consensus on that, such as the judges Abu Bakr ibn al-Tayyib and Abu Ya’la ibn Abi al-Farra’ and the professor Abi Al-Ma’ali Al-Juwayni and others, and this is indicated by His saying - the Most High -: {And We did not send before you except men to whom We revealed revelation from the people of the towns} [Yusuf: 109] And His saying - the Most High -: {The Messiah, the son of Mary, is no more than a messenger. Messengers have passed away before him, and his mother is truthful.} [Al-Ma’idah: 75] So He made Maryam’s destination Al-Siddiqiyya; He also made the goal of Christ the message.

It has been proven in the two Sahih books on the authority of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - that he said: “Many men have perfected it, but none of the women have perfected it except Maryam, daughter of Imran and Aasiyah bint Muzahim” means among the women of the nations before us, and this indicates that the mother of Moses was not one of the perfect women, so how could she be a prophet? And He - the Almighty - said: {They brought clear proofs and the Psalms and the enlightening Book} [Al Imran: 184] And the book is a generic noun, as mentioned above, that refers to every book. God Almighty revealed it, and He Almighty said:

{And among the people is he who disputes about God without knowledge or guidance and without an enlightening Book} [Al-Hajj: 8] And his saying: “And there is no enlightening Book” is indefinite in the context of the meaning, so it is general. Every Book is enlightening, and if it were nothing but the Gospel, it would be said, “Not the Book is enlightening,” and also

The Torah is greater than the Gospel, and God has made it clear that He has not sent down a book better guided than the Torah and the Qur’an, so God Almighty said: {They say, “If only it had been given Like what was given to Moses. Did they not disbelieve in what was given to Moses before? They said, “Two magic.” [Al-Qasas: 48] And it was read that two magicians pretended to be. “And they said, ‘Indeed, we are disbelievers in everything. Say, “Then bring a book from Allah. It is better guided than the two of them. Follow it, if you are truthful.” [Al-Qasas: 48] And this is an impossibility for them to come. With a book from Allah that is better guided than either of them, as He says: “Or do they say, ‘He fabricated it?’ Say, ‘Then produce a surah like it.’” [Yunus:
38] This shows that neither the Gospel nor the Psalms are more guided than the Torah and the Qur’an, so how can the enlightening book be made the Gospel and not The Torah and the Psalms.
Also, God Almighty only specializes in mentioning from the previous books the Torah and not anything else, for it is the one He associates with the Qur’an, as He said - Almighty -:

{And they did not estimate God as He deserved when they said, “God has not sent down anything to humankind.” Say, “Who sent down the Book which Moses brought as a light and a guidance to the people?” You make it into writings that you reveal, but you conceal much, and you have been taught what neither you nor your fathers knew. Say, “Allah.” Then leave them in their midst playing. And this is a book which We have sent down, blessed is He who confirms what is before it, and that you may warn Umm al-Qura and those around it, and those who believe in the Hereafter will believe in it. And they guard their prayers} [Al-An’am: 91-92]

He described the Torah as that in it is light and guidance for the people, so how could light be placed in the Gospel instead of it? And He Almighty said: {Then We gave Moses the Scripture Completely upon him who does good, and as an explanation of everything, and as guidance and mercy, that they may believe in the meeting with their Lord - and this is a book which We have sent down, blessed, so follow it. And beware that you may receive mercy - lest you say, “Indeed, the Book was sent down to two groups before Us, and if we were heedless of their study.” [Al-An’am:

154 - 156] He mentioned the Torah and the Qur’an, and their saying, “The Book was sent down to two groups before us,” so it is clear that the Book is the name of a type that deals with Here is the Torah and the Gospel, as His - Most High - saying: {O People of the Book} [Al Imran: 64] And His - Most High - saying: {And the food of those who were given the Book is permissible And your food is lawful for them, and the chaste women are among the believing women and the chaste women are among those who were given the Book before you.} [Al-Ma’idah: 5] So he mentioned the Book. In a separate word, and it is known that he meant those who were given the Book before us, the Jews and Christians. This is not specific to the Christians. As he said:
{Lest you say, “The Book was sent down only to two groups before Us” [Al-An’am: 156].

The falsehood of the statement of those who distort words from their proper meaning and interpret the words of God and His Messenger according to what everyone who knows them knows. His situation as a believer and an unbeliever is that he did not want it.

He clarified that God did not intend the Book, the Gospel alone; Just as he did not mean by the messengers the disciples, but rather he meant by the enlightening book, the books that God has sent down, such as the Torah and the Gospel. He also meant by messengers those whom God sent in absolute terms, such as Noah, Abraham, Moses, and the Messiah, the son of Mary - may God’s prayers and peace be upon them all.

chapters.title: Chapter proving that the People of the Book have evidence of the truthfulness of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace
paragraphs: [Chapter: Proving that the People of the Book have something that proves the truthfulness of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace.]

They said: And He also said: {If you are in doubt about what We have revealed to you, then ask those who read the Book before you. Indeed, the truth has come to you from your Lord, so do not You will be among those who doubt.} [Al-Fatihah: 94 - 28981] So it is said: They have what is known by necessity that this is not meant by Christians only; As previously mentioned, the Jews read the book before us, and the Christians read the book before us, and the book is a generic noun. Just as its counterparts have been presented in His saying: {Lest you say, “Indeed, the Book was sent down to two groups before Us} [Al-An’am: 156] and His saying: {And the food of those They were given the Book} [Al-Ma’idah:

5] And his saying: {O People of the Book} [Al Imran: 64] in more than one place, and his saying: {Those who disbelieve are not among the People of the Book and the polytheists} [Evidence: 1] And He - the Most High - said:

{Allah bears witness that there is no god but Him, and the angels and the possessors of knowledge, standing with justice. There is no god but He, the Mighty, the Wise - Indeed, the debt is with God is Islam, and those who were given the Book did not differ except after knowledge had come to them, out of envy among themselves. And whoever disbelieves in the verses of God, then surely God is swift. Reckoning - Then if they dispute with you, then say, “I submit my face to God and to those who follow me.” And say to those who were given the Scripture and the unlettered people, “Have you submitted?” If they submit, Indeed, they are rightly guided, and if they turn away, then it is your duty to convey the message, and God is Seeing of His servants.} [Al Imran: 18-20]

And God Almighty said: {O you who have been given the Scripture, believe in what We have sent down, confirming what is with you, before We obliterated faces and restored them to Turn it away or We will curse them as We cursed the companions of the Sabbath, and the command of God will be carried out.} [An-Nisa: 47]. The use of the word “People of the Book” here for the Jews is more clear than its use for the Christians because of his mention of the curse of the people of the Sabbath, and likewise his saying - God Almighty -: {And a group of the People of the Book said, “Believe in what was revealed to those who believe at the beginning of the day, and disbelieve at the end of it, so that they may return.” [Al Imran: 72] This is news about a group of Jews who said:
That is what God Almighty said: {O you who have believed, if you obey a party of those who were given the Scripture, they will turn you back into disbelief after your belief} [Al Imran: 100].
The reason for its revelation was that a group of Jews wanted to create discord among the Muslims. They are definitely included, even if the discourse is general and covers both sects.

God Almighty commanded him to question those who read the book before him with the due regard for doubt. This does not necessitate that the Messenger doubted or asked, if it is said. The speech is for him, and if it is said about someone else, it is better and more appropriate. Suspending the ruling to a condition does not indicate the fulfillment of the condition, but rather it may be linked to an impossible condition to explain its ruling.

God Almighty said: {And from his descendants are David and Solomon and Job and Joseph and Moses and Aaron. And thus do We reward the doers of good - and Zechariah and Yahya. And Jesus and Elias - each of the righteous - and Ishmael and Elisha and Yunus and Lot - and each of them We preferred over the worlds} [Al-An'am: 84-86] So it was reported that if They committed polytheism, so that what they were doing would be nullified for them even though polytheism was no longer from them, or even with it being abstained from, because they had died. Because the prophets are infallible from polytheism.

And He Almighty said: {Say, “Do you command me to worship anyone other than God, O ignorant ones? And indeed it has been revealed to you and to those before you, if you associate They will certainly make your work worthless, and you will be among the losers - but rather Allah, so worship and be among those who are thankful.} [Az-Zumar: 64-66] This is a speech to everyone. He mentioned the word “inna” here because it refers to “existent.” And there is news about a dead person, and likewise his saying: {So if you are in doubt about what We have revealed to you, then ask} [Yunus: 94] does not indicate that doubt has occurred, nor The question, but the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - was not in doubt and did not ask any of them, but rather it was narrated that he said:
“By God, I neither doubt nor ask.”
But what is meant is to show that the People of the Book have something that makes you believe in what the disbelievers have denied you.

As He - the Almighty - said: In the other verse {Say: “Allah is sufficient as a witness between me and you and whoever has knowledge of the Scripture} [Al-Ra’ad: 43] And He - the Most High - said: {Say: Have you considered if it is from God and you disbelieve in it, and a witness from the Children of Israel bears witness to the like of it, and then believes, and you are arrogant? Indeed, God does not He guides the wrongdoing people.} [Al-Ahqaf: 10] And God Almighty said: “Has there not been a sign for them that the scholars of the Children of Israel should have taught?” [Al-Shu’ara’: 197] And God Almighty said:

{Those to whom We gave the Scripture before it, they believe in it. And when it is recited to them, they say, “We believe in it. It is the truth from our Lord. Indeed, we were of Muslims before him.} [Al-Qasas: 52] And he said: {Indeed, those who were given knowledge before him, when it is recited to them, bow down to their chins in prostration and say, Glory be to Him. Our Lord, if the promise of our Lord is to be fulfilled - and they bow down to their chins, weeping, and His humility increases them} [Al-Isra: 107-109].

And He Almighty said: {And when they hear what was sent down to the Messenger, you will see their eyes overflowing with tears because of the truth they have recognized. They will say, “Our Lord, we believe, so write us down.” With the witnesses} [Al-Ma’idah: 83] And God Almighty said: {But those among them who are well-grounded in knowledge and the believers believe in what has been revealed to you} [An-Nisa: 162] And He said - God Almighty: {And We did not send before you except men to whom We revealed; so ask the people of the Remembrance if you do not know} [Al-Anbiya’: 7] And He Almighty said: {Those to whom We have given the Book know it as they know their own children} [Al-Baqarah:
146] So what is meant is to show that the People of the Book have something that makes you believe in what the disbelievers have denied you about, and that is for several reasons.
One of them: The previous books say that Moses and others called for the worship of God alone and forbade polytheism, so this was An argument against those who think that polytheism is a religion.
And similar to this is His saying - the Almighty -:.
{And ask those whom We sent before you of Our messengers: We have made gods to be worshiped, besides the Most Gracious.} [Al-Zukhruf: 45].

And His saying - the Almighty -: {And We did not send before you any messenger except to him that We revealed to him: There is no god but Me, so worship Me.} [Al-Anbiya’: 25] And His saying - God Almighty -: {And We have certainly sent into every nation a messenger, saying, “Worship God and avoid tyranny.” And among them are those whom God has guided, and among them are those upon whom error has occurred. So travel through the land and see what was the end of the deniers.} [An-Nahl: 36].

The second aspect: The People of the Book know that God only sent to the people a human being like them. He did not send to them an angel. For indeed, among the disbelievers Whoever claims that God only sends a king or a human being who has an angel with him, and they are astonished at sending a human being who does not have an apparent king with him; As God Almighty said: {And nothing prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them except that they said, “Has God sent a human being as a Messenger} [Al-Isra: 94] Say: “If only it had been On earth there are angels who walk in tranquility. Indeed, We have sent down to them from heaven an angel and a messenger.} [Al-Isra: 95] And God Almighty said:

{And We sent Noah to his people, and he said, “O my people, worship God. You have no god other than Him. His people, this is nothing but a human being like you who wants to bestow favor upon you. And if God had willed, He could have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers. He is nothing but a man in whom is a garden; so wait for him for a while.” [Al-Mu’minun: 23-24]

And He - the Almighty - said: {Thamud denied the vow, so they said, “Have we given good tidings to one of us whom we should follow?” Indeed, then indeed we were in error and perdition.} [Al-Qamar: 23] And so said those who After them, “This is nothing but a human being like you, who eats of what you eat and drinks of what you drink. And if you obey him, he will be a human being like you. Indeed, you will Then indeed we are losers.} [Al-Mu’minun: 33] And so did Pharaoh’s people say to Moses and Aaron: “Shall we believe in two human beings like us, while their people are worshipers of Us?” [Al-Mu’minun: 47] And he said:

Pharaoh {Or am I better than this one who is humiliated and can hardly be seen? Had bracelets of gold not been thrown upon him or brought with him The angels are joined together} [Al-Zukhruf: 52] And so they said: to Muhammad, and he said:

God Almighty {These are the verses of the Wise Book. Is it a wonder to mankind that We have revealed to a man from among them, “Warn the people and give good tidings to those who believe that To them is truthfulness from their Lord. The disbelievers say, “Indeed, this is an obvious sorcerer.” [Yunus: 1] And He, the Most High, said: “And they say, ‘If only an angel had been sent down to him.’” We sent down a king to decide the matter, and then they would not be looked back. - And if We had made him a king, We would have made him a man and clothed them with what they wear.} [Al-An’am: 8-9].

So, Glory be to Him, has made it clear that you cannot bear to learn from the angel. Had We sent him down as an angel, We would have made him in the form of a human. At that time you would have thought he was a human. So confusion arises among you, so God Almighty commanded that the People of the Book be asked about the one who was sent to them, whether he was a human being or an angel, in order to establish the argument based on that. Whoever denies sending people; As God Almighty said:

And We did not send before you except men to whom We revealed: So ask the people of the message if you do not know - and We did not make them flesh that they should not eat. food, and they were not immortal. Then We made the promise true to them, and We saved them and whom We willed, and We destroyed the extravagant.} [Al-Anbiya’: 7-9] And the People of the Remembrance. They are the people of the Remembrance which God Almighty has sent down.

The third aspect: They ask the People of the Book about what happened to the Messengers among their nations and what was the outcome of those who believed in them, and the outcome of Those who deny them.

The fourth aspect: They ask the People of the Book about the religion with which God sent His messengers, and it is the religion of Islam upon which the messengers agreed. Such as enjoining monotheism, truthfulness, justice, honoring one’s parents, maintaining family ties, and forbidding polytheism, injustice, and immoral acts.

The fifth aspect: They ask them about what the messengers described their Lord with. Is it consistent with what Muhammad described him with or not? These matters about which he is asked are frequent among the People of the Book and are known to them and are not something they doubt about, and not if there is such a thing as This is known to them through frequent transmission, so they are asked about it. Everything they say must be known to them through frequent transmission.
Also, they are also asked about the testimonies and glad tidings they have of the prophecy of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace.

God has told about this in the Qur’an, and the Almighty said: {And My mercy encompasses all things, so I will record it for those who fear and pay zakat and those They believe in Our signs - those who follow the Messenger, the unlettered Prophet, whom they find written with them in the Torah and the Gospel, commanding them. He enjoins what is right and forbids them what is wrong, and makes lawful for them the good things and forbids for them the evil, and relieves them of their burden and the shackles that It was upon them} [Al-A’raf: 156-157].

And He - Most High - said: {And when Jesus, son of Mary, said, “O Children of Israel, indeed I am the Messenger of God to you, confirming what was before me of the Torah and bringing good news.” With a messenger who will come after me, and his name is Ahmad. So when he came to them with clear proofs, they said, “This is clear magic.” [As-Saff: 6]

It was told about Jesus that he believed in the Messenger and the book before him, which is the Torah, and he gave good tidings about the Messenger who would come after him, which is Ahmad. God Almighty said: {Then We will certainly turn you to a qiblah that you will be pleased with. So turn your face toward the Sacred Mosque. And wherever you are, turn your faces toward it. And those who were given the Scripture know that it is the truth from their Lord, and God is not unaware of what they do.} [Al-Baqarah: 144] to His saying: {Those to whom We have given They know the Scripture as they know their own children, and indeed a party among them conceals the truth while they know it.} [Al-Baqarah: 146] And God Almighty said:

{And it is a revelation of the Lord of the worlds - the Faithful Spirit has sent it down to your heart, that you may be among the warners - in a clear Arabic tongue - and indeed, it is in the Psalms. Of the ancients - was there not a sign for them that the scholars of the Children of Israel did not know? {And when they hear what was revealed to the Messenger, you will see their eyes overflowing with tears because of the truth they have recognized. They say, “Our Lord, we believe.” [Al-Ma’idah: 83]

And He - the Most High - said: {And a Qur’an which We have divided into parts so that you may recite it to the people over a period of time, and We have sent it down as a revelation - Say, “Believe in it or do not believe.” Indeed, it is those who have been given knowledge. Before Him, when it is recited to them, they bow down to their chins in prostration and say, Glory be to our Lord, if the promise of our Lord is to be fulfilled - and they bow down to their chins. They weep, and He increases their humility} [Al-Isra: 106-109] And He - the Most High - said: {Do I seek judgment other than Allah, when He is the One who has sent down to you the Book in detail, and those who We have given them the Scripture; they know that it is sent down from your Lord in truth, so do not be of those who doubt.} [Al-An'am: 114] And He - the Most High - said:

{And We have conveyed to them the word that they may remember - those to whom We gave the Scripture before it believe in it - and when it is recited to them, they say: We believe in it. Indeed, it is the truth from our Lord. Indeed, before it we were Muslims - those will be given their reward twice, because they were patient and repelled with good deeds. evil, and spend out of what We have provided them.} [Al-Qasas: 51-54] And He - the Most High - said: In Surat Al-An’am {Those to whom We have given the Scripture recognize it as they recognize it. Their children who have lost their lives, so they do not believe.} [Al-An'am: 20]

And He, the Most High, said: {And when there came to them a book from Allah, confirming what is with them. And previously they were seeking victory against those who disbelieved, but when there came to them They recognized it and disbelieved in it, so the curse of God is upon the disbelievers.} [Al-Baqarah: 89] And the reports of the People of the Book’s knowledge of the character of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - They have it in the previous books that have been transmitted from them.

And before the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - was sent, wars and fighting were taking place between the Arabs and the People of the Book, and the People of the Book would say, “It is near.” The Messenger of this Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - is the illiterate who will be sent with the religion of Abraham. So when he appears, we will follow him and kill them with him, the worst killers. When the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - was sent, there were some of them who believed in him and some of them who disbelieved in him, and God Almighty said: {And they used to seek victory before.} [Al-Baqarah:

89] That is, they seek victory through Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - against those who disbelieve {But when there came to them what they recognized, they disbelieved in it, so the curse of God is upon the disbelievers} [Al-Baqarah: 89] That is why the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - in his speech to the People of the Book used to say to them, “By God, there is no god but Him. So that you may know that I am

Messenger of God.” Likewise, those of them who converted to Islam, such as Abdullah bin Salam, used to say to other People of the Book, “And God is the One whom there is no god but It is that you know that he is the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - and this is a well-known matter in the authentic hadiths narrated in the two Sahihs. And others, and from what we have mentioned, it has become clear that these people have distorted the word of God and that they have no proof for what was revealed to Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace. Similar examples of this were also presented.

chapters.title: A chapter rejecting their claim that the Qur’an confirms their books that are in their hands
paragraphs: [Chapter: Rejecting their claim that the Qur’an authenticated their books that were before them]

They said, “So what is with us is confirmed by this. Yes, and he negates from our Gospel and our books that are in our hands the accusations, the alteration of them, and the changing of what is in them by believing it.” It's her.
It is said:

Your words that you use as evidence in this and other places are either pure falsehood or they are something that you have disguised as truth. Falsehood, for your statement that he believed it, if you want, is that he believed the Torah, the Gospel, and the Psalms that God revealed to His prophets. There is no doubt about this, for this is mentioned in the Qur’an in more than one place, and He has made it obligatory upon His servants to believe in every Book He has revealed and every A prophet from among the prophets, with the information that he sent down these books before the Qur’an, and he sent down the Qur’an confirming what was before him of the book. And dominant over him.

And He - the Most High - said: {M - Allah - there is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Ever-Subsisting - He has sent down to you the Book with truth, confirming what was before it, and sent down the Torah. And the Gospel - before, is a guidance for the people, and He sent down the Criterion} [Al Imran: 1-4] And He - the Most High - said: {And We sent down to you the Book with the truth, confirming what is clear. His hands are of the Book, and He has dominion over it.} [Al-Ma’idah: 48]

And God Almighty said: {O you who have been given the Scripture, believe in what We have sent down, confirming what was with you before We obliterated faces and transformed them into Turn it away or We will curse them as We cursed the companions of the Sabbath.} [An-Nisa: 47] And He said: “And We have sent down to you the Book with the truth, confirming what was before it of the Book. And dominating over it} [Al-Ma’idah: 48] And He said: “And what We have revealed to you of the Scripture is the truth, confirming what is before it. Indeed, God is aware of His servants.” All-Seeing} [Fatir: 31] And he said:

{And when there came to them a messenger from God, confirming what they had, a party of those who had been given the Book threw the Book of God behind their backs, as if they had no They know} [Al-Baqarah: 101] And He - the Most High - said: {Believe in what We sent down, confirming what is with you} [An-Nisa: 47] And He has obligated His servants to believe in all His books and messengers and he ruled with disbelief

Whoever believes in some and disbelieves in part, then God Almighty says: {Say, “We believe in God and in what was sent down to us and what was sent down to Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac.” And Jacob and the tribes, and what was given to Moses and Jesus, and what was given to the prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them, and to Him we submit - so if they believe. 85] He declared the disbelief of the Christians in more than one place, and ordered their jihad and fighting against them, and ruled the disbelief of those for whom it is not necessary to jihad or fight them. One of them: That they say that some of his information contradicts another; As these people claim, that his book sometimes praises the People of the Book and criticizes them at other times, and that he believes the revealed books sometimes and criticizes them. As for whoever follows the changed and abrogated religion, he has declared it a disbelief.
As for their claim of contradicting his news with the news of others, it is said: He confirms the prophets and what they were informed of.

As for any of their words or other words that were changed in the translation or interpreted in a way other than what they intended, it is not believed. It is also said that the prophecy of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace Peace and blessings of God be upon him - it is confirmed in a way that the prophecies of the prophets before him were confirmed, and in a greater way than that, as it has been explained in another place. He explained that denying the prophecy of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - while believing in the prophecy of others is extremely contradictory and corrupt, and that there is no A path by which someone else’s prophecy is known, unless his prophecy is known by a similar path and by a greater one than it. Such as the prophecy of others and the way to prove it due to the necessity of believing in his prophecy. Just as it is necessary to believe in the prophecy of others, even though his denial would be like the denial of Abraham, Moses, and other messengers, so how if that is greater? In many ways.

Then all the prophets are truthful, truthful, and infallible in what they report about God. It is not possible for anything to be proven in their information about God. False news, neither intentionally nor by mistake, so it is not permissible for one of them to tell someone else something different than what he told others. Rather, they should not be separated in the unifying religion. As God Almighty said: {He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah, which We have revealed to you, and what We enjoined upon Abraham, Moses, and Jesus, that you should establish the religion. And do not become divided therein.} [Al-Shura: 13] And God Almighty said:

{O Messengers, eat of the good things and do righteousness. Indeed, I am All-Knowing of what you do - and this is your nation, one nation, and I am your Lord, so fear Me - So they divided up their affairs among themselves, each party rejoicing in what they had.} [Al-Mu’minun: 51-53] Abrogation only occurs in some laws; Just as abrogation falls within the law of one Messenger, then it will be known that everything that is transmitted from the previous prophets contradicts what was taught from Telling Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - is false, whether the wording itself is false, whether that prophet did not say it, or he said it verbally. Those who translated it from one language to another, or the pronunciation and its translation were correct, but a mistake occurred in knowing what that prophet meant by that. Speech.

For all the words that are used as evidence that were transmitted from the prophets, the prophets of the Children of Israel, and others who were sent in a language other than Arabic: In order to use his words as evidence from these introductions, it is necessary that he know the wording that he said, know its translation, and know its meaning. With that word.

Muslims and the People of the Book agree on the occurrence of mistakes in interpreting some words and explaining what the prophets intended by them and in translating them. Some of them, for you find in the Torah several translated versions, and between them there are differences that differ in the understood meaning, and the same applies in the Gospel. And others, this path in the answer is a general path for everyone who believes in Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and bears witness that he is the Messenger of God, inwardly and outwardly. It is addressed to every Jew and Christian on the face of the earth, even if he does not know what the People of the Book have, for no one is able to If the people of the earth provide sound evidence for the prophecy of Moses and Jesus and the invalidity of the prophecy of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - then this is self-defeating. Indeed, it is not possible for him to establish valid evidence for the prophethood of one of them unless he establishes evidence similar to that, or greater than it, for the prophethood of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace. May God bless him and grant him peace - it is better, and then he will not enable any of the people of

The book is to use as evidence some of the narrations from the prophets that are contrary to what has been proven from Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - whether he affirms By his prophecy or denying it. Rather, if he uses as evidence something that has been reported from Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - the invalidity of his evidence against it will be made clear to him. And it is an argument against him, not for him.

If he uses as evidence something from what was transmitted from other prophets - peace be upon them - he is asked to confirm the prophethood of that prophet despite the denial of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace. May God bless him and grant him peace - otherwise, by decree, it would be transmitted from two who claimed to be prophets and brought the verses by which the prophecies prove two reports. This will not be rejected by the Muslims if they reject what the People of the Book use as evidence from what they transmit from the prophets in contradiction to the information of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace. May God bless him and grant him peace - Muslims do not challenge the prophecy of any of the known prophets, but rather they challenge the fact that they were informed of what It contradicts the report of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace -, for that is not proven, that is, the pronunciation, translation, interpretation of the word, and these introductions are not proven. It is forbidden to do anything that contradicts the information of Muhammad, neither in its entirety nor in its detail.
The People of the Book demand three principles regarding what they oppose.
One of them: assuming that those are truthful and Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - is a liar.
The second: Verifying what they brought verbally.

The third: knowing what is meant by the word, translation and interpretation, and if the writer says to the Muslim: You agree with me regarding the prophethood of these predecessors, The Muslim’s answer is in many ways.

Among them is that he says, “I did not agree with you on the prophecy of any one of them while disbelieving in Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - but rather it is the religion of all Muslims.” Whoever believes in some of the prophets and disbelieves in others is an unbeliever, so how about whoever disbelieves in one who, according to Muslims, is the best of the prophets? And their seal. Indeed, most Muslims may say to him: We did not know the prophethood of those except by telling Muhammad that they were prophets. So if we discredit In the original by which we learned of their prophecy, it is necessary to slander their prophecy, and if the branch is slandered in its origin, it indicates its corruption in itself. Its origin is determined to be correct or corrupt, for if its origin is corrupt, then it is corrupt, and if its origin is correct and it contradicts it, then it is invalid. For if its origin is corrupt, then it is corrupt, and if its origin is correct and it contradicts it, then it is invalid, then it is invalid, its origin is invalid. All appreciation.
Likewise, if he said: To him the Scripture: We have agreed to believe Moses, the Torah, Christ, and the Gospel.

The Muslim said to him, “I only agreed with you to believe Moses and Jesus, who gave good tidings about Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace. As Muhammad told us about it on the authority of God, where God Almighty said: {And My mercy encompasses all things, so I will record it for those who fear and pay zakat. And those who believe in Our signs - those who follow the Messenger, the unlettered Prophet, whom they find written in their possessions in the Torah and the Gospel. He enjoins upon them what is right and forbids them from what is evil” [Al-A’raf: 156-157] the verse.

And He - Most High - said: {And when Jesus, son of Mary, said, “O Children of Israel, indeed I am the Messenger of God to you, confirming what was before me of the Torah and bringing good news.” With a messenger who will come after me, whose name is Ahmad} [As-Saff: 6] and the likes of that.

As for belief in Moses, who stated that his law was upheld and nothing of it could be abrogated, or in a Messiah who claimed to be God or that God united with him Or it was permissible in it, and the like of what the People of the Book claim about the two Messengers and the two Books, and the Muslims disagree with them about it. This is one of the sources of conflict. No, from a standpoint of consensus, none of the People of the Book has the right to protest against any of the Muslims by agreeing with him on that.

The completion of this is for the Muslim to say, “Yes, I acknowledge the prophecy of Moses and the Messiah, and that the Torah and the Gospel are the words of God,” but he refuses rationally. Acknowledging the prophecy of one of these people rather than the prophecy of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace -, for the proofs, verses and evidence indicate the truth of Moses and Christ indicate the prophecy of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - in the first way. If that evidence is contradicted, it must be corrupted or not. I believe in any of the prophets, and if it is true then it is necessary to believe them all, then we must either believe them all or deny them. All of them, and for this reason whoever believes in some and disbelieves in others is an unbeliever.

One of the answers given to Muslims is to say, “We believe the prophets of old in everything they were informed of, but those who reported from them said that they They reported something that contradicts the report of Muhammad, so it must have two premises. That wording is proven from the prophets and knowledge in its meaning, which is known to be Contrary to the meaning that is known to have been given by Muhammad, then knowledge of the word is needed along with speech other than the tongues of the Arab prophets alike. Whether it was Arabic, Roman, Syriac, or Coptic, until it is known that the word with which it was translated is identical to the word. وَيَمْتَنِعُ ثُبُوتُ الْمُقَدِّمَتَيْنِ ; Because their proof contradicts scientific evidence, and scientific evidence does not contradict.

The second way: For Muslims to say: What you remember from the prophets contradicts what Muhammad told us are matters whose authenticity is not known. It is not permissible to believe in its validity and be certain of it even if it is not known that Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - reported something contrary to it. One of them: knowledge of their prophecy, and this is impossible despite the denial of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace.
The second: They said: These words, and this requires proving the frequency of these words from the prophets, but it has not been proven It was transmitted from them.
The third: that its meaning is the meaning that contradicts the information of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and this was not known.
Each one of these premises prevents knowledge of proving these meanings that contradict the story of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - so how then? She met.
