The third way: The way of those who show that the words of these books were not repeated, and they prove this by the cessation of the Torah’s continuity when the House of God was destroyed. The sanctuary and the cessation of the continuity of the Gospel in the beginning.
The fourth way: The way of those who show that some of the words of the books have been corrupted.
He evaluates legal and rational evidence for changing some of its words.

The fifth way: To show that the words in their hands do not contradict what Muhammad told us, but rather indicate the truthfulness of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace. He talks about the interpretation of these words in their specific meanings.
This path is followed by those Muslims who do not dispute the validity of the words.
As for the masses who say that these words are changed, they follow this path and they also follow the lack of frequency of the words. Rather, it is an explanation of the changes in its words.

chapters.title: Separating the occurrence of changes in the words of the Torah and the Gospel and the cessation of their chain of transmission
paragraphs: [Chapter: The occurrence of changes in the words of the Torah and the Gospel and the cessation of their chain of transmission]

Among the arguments of the majority who deny it is that all the words of these ancient books found among the People of the Book were revealed from In the sight of God, no change occurred in it, and they say that some of its words were changed, and they say that it was not known that its words were revealed. It is from God, so it is not permissible to use the words it contains as evidence in opposition to what is known to be proven, as they said:

The Torah and the Gospel that exist today in the hands of the People of the Book were not traced back to Moses and Jesus - peace be upon them - as for the Torah, if it was transmitted It was cut off when the Holy House was first destroyed, and the children of Israel evacuated from it. Then they mentioned that what had dictated it to them after that was one person. He was called Ezra, and they claimed that he was a prophet.
Some people say that he was not a prophet and that it was met with a version that was found to be outdated.

It has been said that a copy was brought that was in Morocco, and all of this does not necessitate the repetition of all its words, nor does it prevent mistakes from occurring in Some of them; The same applies to books that were copied, compared, and memorized for a little while.

As for the Gospel that is in their hands, they acknowledge that it was not written by Christ - peace be upon him - nor did he dictate it to whoever wrote it, but rather It was dictated after the ascension of Christ by Matthew and John, who had accompanied Christ, but it was not memorized by many people, reaching the number of generations, and Mark. And Luke, while they had not seen the Messiah - peace be upon him - and these people mentioned that they mentioned some of what the Messiah said and some of his news. And they did not comprehend the remembrance of his words and deeds.

It is permissible to quote two, three, or four as a mistake, especially since they made a mistake about Christ himself, to the point that he was suspected of being crucified. But the Christians claim that the disciples are messengers of God, like Jesus, son of Mary, and Moses - peace be upon them - and that they are infallible and that they were safe. To them is the Torah and the Gospel, and that they perform miracles, and they say to them: This is the Torah and this Gospel, and they acknowledge with this that they They are not prophets, so if they are not prophets, then whoever is not a prophet is not infallible from error, even if he is one of the greatest saints of God, even if he is He has extraordinary customs, as Abu Bakr, Omar, Uthman, Ali, and others among the best companions of the Muslims are better than the disciples and are not infallible. They have only one who is a prophet.

The claim that they are messengers of God even though they are not prophets is a contradiction, and the fact that they are messengers of God is based on the fact that Christ is God, for they are apostles of Christ, and this principle is false, but in the way of debate and debate, which is better, we prevent them from this. position, and we demand from them proof that they are the messengers of God, and they have no proof of that, for it is not proven that they are the messengers of God if it is not It is proven that Christ is God, and their proof that Christ is God is either by reason or by hearing.
The mind does not prove this, but rather distorts it, and they do not claim to prove this with the mind.

Rather, the goal of what they claim is to prove its possibility with reason, not to prove its existence, even though that is also false. Rather, they claim to prove its existence By hearing, which is the words they transmit from the prophets, which they claim to be proven from the prophets, and their indication that Christ is God. Like everyone else who uses the auditory argument as evidence, the general statement of the validity of the chain of transmission is without clarifying the significance of the text, and both premises are invalid.

But in this case it is said to them: You cannot prove that Christ is God except by these books, and you cannot correct These books only prove that the disciples are infallible messengers of God, and you cannot prove that they are messengers of God except by proving that Christ is God, so that became an impossible role.

For the divinity of the Messiah is not known except through the confirmation of these books, and these books are not proven except through the confirmation that they are messengers of God, nor This is proven only by proving that he is God, so proving his divinity depends on proving his divinity, and proving that they are messengers of God depends on proving his divinity. Because they were messengers of God, this became an unavoidable role.

They may claim the infallibility of the Apostles and the infallibility of the people of the councils after the Apostles, like the people of the first council which was in the presence of Constantine. Which was attended by three hundred and eighteen, and they laid down for themselves the trust, which is the belief of the Christians, without which no sacrifice is valid for them. They claim that supernatural miracles occurred at the hands of the disciples or these people, and they may mention that among them were those at whose hands the dead were revived. If this is true, even though its author did not mention that he is a prophet, this does not indicate his infallibility, for God’s saints are among the companions and followers. After them, with goodness, and the rest of the saints of God from this nation and other than them, they have miracles of customs that are too long to describe, and none of them are infallible. It is necessary to accept everything he says. Rather, it is permissible to make mistakes about each one of them, and everyone is taken from what he says and left out, except the prophets - on them. Peace be upon you.
For this reason, God made it obligatory to believe in what was given to the prophets, and He did not make it obligatory to believe in everything that every guardian of God says.

God Almighty said: {Say, “We believe in God and in what was sent down to us, and in what was sent down to Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac and Jacob and the tribes and what was given.” Moses and Jesus and what was given to the prophets from their Lord} [Al-Baqarah: 136] And God Almighty said: “But righteous is he who believes in God and the Last Day and the angels and the Scripture. And the prophets} [Al-Baqarah: 177] And for this reason it is necessary to believe in all of the prophets and in what they were given, all of them.

Whoever denies a single prophet whose prophecy is known is an unbeliever, according to Muslim agreement, and whoever insults him must be killed as well, unlike the one who is not a prophet. No one is declared a disbeliever by disobeying him, nor should he be killed simply because he curses him, unless the cursing is accompanied by something that makes blood permissible.

And what the predecessors of the nation, such as the Companions and those who followed them in goodness, the imams of religion, and the masses of Muslims, is that the best of this nation after Its prophet is Abu Bakr, then Omar, and there are no prophets better than them yet, and this nation is the best of nations, and it has been proven in the two Sahih books on the authority of The Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - said: “There were scholars of hadith scholars before you among the nations, so if there is anyone among my nation, then he will live in life.” And the inspired narrator. The addressee.

Omar had put the truth on his heart and tongue, and he would not say anything, “Indeed, I see him as such and such” except that it was so. As he says, calmness was speaking on his tongue, and despite this, neither he nor anyone else who was not a prophet was infallible from error and it was not obligatory to The Muslim accepts what he says: if the Qur’an and Sunnah do not indicate it, and it is not permissible for him to act on what finds his heart unless he presents it to others. The Book and the Sunnah. If that agrees, he accepts it, and if it contradicts that, he rejects it.

According to Muslims, there is no one among the followers of Christ - peace be upon him - like Abu Bakr and Omar - may God be pleased with them - so if they say about The disciples: They are not infallible. They say that about someone who is better than the disciples, just as when they said: about Christ is a created servant, not a god. They say that about those who, according to them, are better than Christ, such as Muhammad and Abraham - on them. The best prayers and peace -.

And among the atheists affiliated with the Ummah, those who harbor heresies of extremism that resemble the extremism of the Christians are like those of the Ismailis who claim divinity. Like the Banu Ubaid Al-Qaddah, like Al-Hakim and others, and he claims divinity in Ali bin Abi Talib or others, like the claim of the Nusayris, and these are infidels according to Muslims.

The same applies to those who claim divinity in some of the sheikhs, such as Ghulat al-Adawiya, al-Hallajiya, al-Yunusiyyah, and others, as well as those who claim infallibility. Banu Ubaid, the Ismat of the Twelve, or the Ismat of some sheikhs.
The Christians claim the infallibility of the twelve disciples, and they claim the infallibility of the twelve imams.

These people attribute the origin of their religion to the words of their infallible disciples, and they say that they are infallible in transmitting from Christ and in The fatwa, and what they said was said by Christ - peace and blessings be upon him.

And these people say about those people that they are infallible in transmission and fatwa, and that what they said was said by the Messenger - peace and blessings be upon him - This is explained elsewhere.

What is meant here is that with the Christians there is no reliable transmission of Christ in the words of these Gospels, nor is there a reliable or single transmission. With most of the laws they follow, neither with them nor with the Jews is there a reliable transmission of the words of the Torah and the prophecies of the prophets as Among Muslims, there is a frequent transmission of the Qur’an and the apparent laws known to the public and the private, and this is an example of trust, which is The origin of their religion, their prayer to the East, the permissibility of the pig, abandoning circumcision, veneration of the cross, making images in churches, and other such matters. Their laws are not transmitted from Christ, nor are they mentioned in the Gospels that they transmit from him, and they agree that the trustworthiness that They made it the foundation of their religion and the basis of their belief. Its words are not found in the Gospels, nor are they mentioned by the disciples, and they agreed. However, those who made it were the people of the first council who were with Constantine, which was attended by three hundred and eighteen people, and they disagreed with Abd. God is the son of Arius, who made Christ a servant of God, as Muslims say, and they entrusted this trust.

This council took place after Christ for a long period of more than three hundred years, and this was discussed in another place, but what is meant here is The answer to their saying: Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - confirmed what was with them and that he denied the accusations from their Gospel and their books that are in their hands. And changing it and changing what is in it by believing in it.

It has become clear that Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - did not believe in anything of their altered or abrogated religion, but rather he believed the prophets before him and those who They brought him and he praised those who followed them, not those who disagreed with them or denied any of the prophets. And the disbelief of the Christians is of the same type as the disbelief of the Jews, for the Jews changed the meanings of the first book and denied the second book: which is the Gospel. Likewise, the Christians changed the meanings of the first book, the Torah and the Gospel, and denied the second book:
It is the Qur’an, and they claimed that Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - believed in all the words of the books that they had.

The majority of Muslims prohibit this and say that some of its words have been changed. Many of its meanings have also been changed, and some Muslims say: The change only occurred in its meanings, not in its words, and this opinion is acknowledged. In general, Jews and Christians.

According to the two opinions, they have no justification for believing Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - because of the false religion they follow, for the divine books that Their hands do not indicate the validity of what Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and his nation disbelieved in, such as the trinity, the union, the permissibility, and the change of The law of Christ and the denial of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - for there is nothing in the books in their hands that indicates, neither textually nor apparently, the trustworthiness that is The origin of their religion and what is in that of the trinity, unity, and solutions, and there is nothing in it that indicates most of their laws.
Such as praying facing the east and making forbidden things such as pigs and dead animals permissible, and the like, as has been explained in another place.

It is said to them: Where is what you have on the authority of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - which indicates that nothing has been changed in the words of the books in your hands. It is known that if Muslims and others disagree, the statement of one group is not an argument against the other group.

If the Muslims disagreed about changing some of the words of the previous books, then the opinion of one group is not an argument against the other, and it is not permissible. It is permissible for any of the Muslims or among you to add a word to the Messenger unless there is evidence.

So where is there in the Qur’an and the Sunnah proven on the authority of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - that everything that is in the hands of the People of the Book of the Torah, the Gospel and the Psalms is And the prophecies of the prophets were not changed with any of their words so that they could say: Muhammad denied that from their books? .

These people based their words on the fact that the words of their books indicate the validity of their religion, which they followed after the sending of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace. And after they denied Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and that none of its words were changed.
The corruption of this has become clear in many ways.

Then they claimed that the Muslims claim that the words of these books were completely corrupted in all their languages after the sending of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace. This saying was not said by any of the Muslims, as far as I know, and they thought that by answering this, they would have answered the Muslims.

chapters.title: Chapter on the response to the Christians in their claim that Muslims say that the distortion occurred after the sending of the Prophet Muhammad
paragraphs: [Chapter: The response to the Christians in their claim that the Muslims say that the distortion occurred after the sending of the Prophet Muhammad]

So the narrator said on their behalf: So I said to them: If someone said: It is permissible for substitution and change to occur after this statement, then they said: We are amazed. Of these people, despite their knowledge, intelligence, and knowledge, how do they protest against us with such a statement? And that is when I, too, We protested against them with this statement and said: Indeed, the book that is in their hands this day has been changed, altered, and written in it what They wanted and desired. Were they permissible for our words? The narrator said about them: So I said to them:
This is something that is not permissible and cannot be said by anyone, and it cannot be changed until the end of the chapter, and words will come after this.

The answer is that this Christian questioner, who mentioned a question about the Muslims that they do not say about the Christian scholars, his answer is an illusion they constructed. Their words are based on two corrupt principles.
One of them:

The Messenger confirmed what was with them and denied the accusations, alterations and changes in their books that were in their hands, and their intention by that would only be accomplished. If he denied changing its wording and meaning, and this is what every rational person knows, that the Messenger did not deny it, but rather the mutawatir transmission of it is the opposite. This is also the case with them, and every sane person knows that the interpretation of the books in their hands is due to disagreement and confusion between the groups of Christians and among the Christians. And the Jews do not necessitate conclusively that much of this was changed and distorted, and this also occurred in changing the laws of these books, for the books included Two origins:
Information and command. Belief in it cannot be achieved except by believing in what it has told us and obliging us to obey it in what it has made obligatory.

And the People of the Book deny much of what she has informed, and they do not oblige her to be obeyed in much of what she has made obligatory and commanded, and every group of them She bears witness to the other group in the same way.

The Christians have seven famous synagogues, and in each synagogue they curse a large group of them and declare them infidels and say On their authority, they denied some of what was in those books and did not require obedience to some of its commands, and this group bears witness to the others that they It denied some of what was in it, then the three famous sects divided them: the Nestorians, the Melkites, and the Jacobites, each sect declaring the other to be infidels. And you curse her and bear witness against her that she disbelieves in some of what is in the prophecies and does not necessitate obedience to some of what is in them. Rather, they differ in the same Monotheism and the Message. Each group of them claimed that Christ brought what they were upon, and Christ - peace be upon him - and all the messengers were innocent of those who divided Their religion, and they were Shiites, and innocent of those who say something about God that is not true, or say something about God that He does not know, and are innocent of every false statement that is said about God. Almighty - even if he who said it was wrong, he did not intend to lie.
There are Christian articles of these types that are described at length and have been expanded elsewhere.

And if you know that all sects of Muslims, Jews, and Christians testify that there has been distortion and alteration in these books, Its meanings, interpretations, and laws. This amount is sufficient, and from the time Muhammad was sent - may God bless him and grant him peace - everyone who did not believe in him became An unbeliever, unlike the condition of the Christians before the sending of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - for there were among them those who followed the religion of Christ and the Muslims. And if there were among them those who distorted the religion and changed it, and the majority of them differed from these people, then there would still remain among them a visible group that adhered to the truth and would not be harmed by those who He disagreed with them and let them down until the Hour comes, unlike the Christians, for all of them have disbelieved. Just as the Jews disbelieved in denying Christ.

Muslims prove with abundant evidence that they changed the meanings of the Torah, the Gospel, the Psalms, and other prophecies of the prophets. They invented a law that neither Christ nor anyone else brought, and no rational person would say like their claim that all the sons of Adam are prophets, apostles, and others. They were in hell, in the prison of Satan, because their father Adam ate from the tree, and they only got rid of that when Christ was crucified.

If this speech had been transmitted by a transmitter on the authority of some of the prophets, we would be certain that he lied to them. So how come this speech was not transmitted by them from them? One of the prophets, but they only transmit it from someone whose statement is not a necessary proof, for much of their religion was taken from their leaders who were not With prophets.

So if we are certain that the one who transmits it from the prophets is a lie, then how about if he did not transmit it from them, and that is because the prophets - peace be upon them - They tell people what their minds fail to know, not what they know to be false and impossible, so they inevitably tell them things that baffle the minds. The minds and Adam - peace be upon him - even if he ate from the tree, then God turned to him and chose him and guided him.

He - the Almighty - said: {And Adam disobeyed his Lord and went astray - then his Lord chose him, and He turned to him and guided him} [Ta-ha: 121-122] And He - the Most High - said: {So Adam received from his Lord Words, and He turned to him. Indeed, He is the Forgiver, the Merciful.} [Al-Baqarah:

37] And the People of the Book do not have anything in their books that denies his repentance. Rather, their speaker may say: We do not know that he repented, or we do not have it. His repentance and not knowing something is not knowledge of its absence, and the absence of something in one of the books of God does not deny that it is in another book, so in The Torah is what is not in the Bible, and in both of them is what is not in the Psalms, and in the Bible and the Psalms is what is not in the Torah and in all other prophecies, what is not found in these If the books and the Qur’an were other than the Torah, the Gospel, the Psalms, and the prophecies, or were like them, it would be possible for there to be in it what is not in it, so how? If it is better and nobler and contains greater knowledge than what is in the Torah and the Gospel, and God Almighty has made clear His grace over them in more than one place. As God Almighty says:
{Allah has sent down the best of hadith, a book similar to one another, from which you shudder.} [Az-Zumar: 23]

And He - the Almighty - said: {We narrate to you the best of stories by what We have revealed to you this Qur’an} [Joseph: 3] And He - the Most High - said: {And We sent down to you The Book with the truth, confirming what was before him of the Book and dominating it.} [Al-Ma’idah: 48] And whether Adam repented or not, how could it be possible that there were messengers? Are those who are better than him imprisoned in Satan’s prison in Hell due to his sin? And Ibrahim, the friend of the Most Gracious, whose father was an infidel, and God did not hold him accountable for his sin, so how could He put him in Hell, in the prison of Satan, because of his sin? His utmost father, Adam?

Even though he was a prophet and Noah - peace be upon him - had stayed among his people for a thousand years minus fifty years, calling them to worship God alone. And God overwhelmed the people of the earth with his call and made his descendants the ones who remain. So how could he be in Hell, in the prison of Satan, for Adam’s sin? .

And Musa bin Imran, to whom God spoke clearly and showed proofs and signs at his hands, the like of which had not appeared at the hands of Christ, and he was killed. A soul who was not commanded to be killed, so God forgave him for that, and he has a status with God and honor that cannot be estimated, so how can he be in Hell? In the prison of Satan.

Then there is any correspondence between crucifixion, which is one of the greatest sins, whether they crucified Christ or someone like him, and saving these people from Satan. If Satan did that to his offspring, he would be an oppressor and a transgressor, and God - the Mighty and Majestic - is able to prevent him from oppressing them and even punish him. If he does not stop oppressing them.
So why did he delay preventing them from oppressing them until the time of Christ?

And He, Glory be to Him, is the Guardian of the believers, their helper and supporter, and they are His messengers whom He helped over those who were hostile to them. Rather, He destroyed their enemies who They are the soldiers of Satan, so how can Satan, after their death, not prevent him from oppressing them and putting their souls in Hell? This, if it is decreed that Satan was capable of that, and how is it permissible for Satan to do that after the death of his prophets and saints and the cessation of the obligation from them? And their deserving of His honor, benevolence, and Paradise by virtue of His promise and His wisdom, so He made them the authority to imprison them in Hell? ! .
And if they say:

The Lord - Almighty and Majestic - would not have been able to save them from Satan, despite His knowledge that he is an oppressor who attacks them after death, except by He deceives him by hiding himself so that Satan can get hold of him. As they claim, this is in addition to the great disbelief in it and making the Lord Glory be to Him powerless. Just as they made him unjust in the first place, there is a contradiction in it that suggests the greatness of their ignorance with which they made the Lord ignorant. They say that he deceived the Satan to take him justly; Just as Satan deceived Adam with the serpent and hid from him, so that he would not know that he is a man of God, and a man of God has never committed a sin other than Change it.

When Satan wanted to take his soul to imprison him in Hell, like everyone else who had gone before and had committed no sin, Satan deserved for the Lord to take him. And he frees the offspring from his imprisonment.

This is their ignorance of the Lord - Glory be to Him, the Most High - about what they say, in addition to His incapacity and injustice, for if He is the authority of Satan over The children of Adam, as they say. There is no difference between the humanity of Christ and anyone else, since everyone is the son of Adam. Also, if it is determined that humanity truly defends Satan from himself, then they They say that he entered hell and brought out the descendants of Adam.

So it is said: If Satan had the power to detain them in Hell rightly because of their sins along with the sin of their father, then it is not permissible to take them out. For the safety of the humanity of Christ from sin, even if they were oppressed by Satan, they must be saved before the humanity is crucified, and it is not permissible to delay Therefore, the mere fact that Christ was free from sins does not necessitate the safety of others, even if they say that without His authority over His crucifixion, He was incapable of To repel him, even though he has control over his core, he is more and more incapable.

The second principle: The corrupt one on which they based their question, which they made from the side of the Muslims, and their answer, because they thought that the Muslims would say: The wording of all existing copies of these books was distorted after the sending of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace.

This is something that Muslims do not say, but some of them may say: Some words were distorted after the sending of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace. Copies, the majority of those who say that some of its words have been corrupted include those who say this was before the Messenger.

Among them are those who say it was after him, and among them are those who confirm or permit both matters, but do not say: The words of all versions were distorted. existing in the east and west of the earth, as this narrator told about them, but Muslim scholars and scholars of the People of the Book are in agreement. On the occurrence of distortion in meanings and interpretation.
Even if each sect claims that the other is the one that distorted the meanings.
As for the words of the books, a group of Muslim scholars said that their words were not changed. As those of the People of the Book say.
Many Muslim scholars and People of the Book are of the view that some of its words were changed.
This is well-known by many Muslim scholars, and many scholars of the People of the Book also said it.

Even in the crucifixion of Christ, a group of Christians believed that only the one who was likened to Christ was crucified. As the Qur’an told of him, and those who told of his crucifixion had told of the apparent meaning of the matter, for when his likeness was cast on the crucified They thought that he was the Messiah, or they deliberately lied, and then there are those among them who say: There is something changed in the words of the Scriptures.

And among them are those who make the substitutes of the Torah and the Gospel many of them, and perhaps some of them make the substitutes most of them, especially the Gospel. The criticism in it is more frequent and more apparent than in the Torah.
Among these people are those who go so extravagant as to say: None of them is forbidden, but rather it is permissible to clean oneself with them.
And among them are those who say, “A few of them have changed their words,” and this is more apparent.
The changes in the Gospel are more apparent, and many people say that these Gospels contain nothing of the word of God except a little.
The Gospel, which is the word of God, is not these Gospels.

chapters.title: Detailing the call of the People of the Book to rule according to the correct words in their books
paragraphs: [Chapter: Calling the People of the Book to judge according to the correct words in their books]

What is true is that this Torah, which is in the hands of the People of the Book, contains what is the ruling of God, even if some of its words have been altered and changed. As God Almighty says: {O Messenger, do not grieve you those who hasten into disbelief among those who say, “We believe” with their mouths, but their hearts do not believe. And among those who are Jews are listeners to lies, listeners to other people who have not come to you distorting words.} [Al-Ma’idah: 41]

To his saying: {And how can they judge you when with them is the Torah, in which is the judgment of God?} [Al-Ma’idah: 43] So it was known that the Torah that was present after the destruction of the House of The Holy Place, after the coming of Bukhtassar, after the sending of the Messiah, and after the sending of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - therein was God’s ruling.
And the Torah that was with the Jews of Medina at the time of the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - even if it is said:

Some of its wording was changed after he was sent, so we do not bear witness to every copy in the world like that, for this is not known to us and it is It is also impossible, but it is possible to change many versions and spread that among the followers until many people do not find anything except what has been changed afterward. In addition to this, many of the versions of the Torah and the Gospel mostly agree, but they differ in a few of their words, such as changing words. A small amount of abrogation after the sending of the Messenger - may God bless him and grant him peace - is possible. No one can be certain of its denial, and no one can confirm its denial. The Jews and Christians must bear witness that every copy in the world of the two books is in agreement with the wording, as there is no way for anyone to know this. The slight difference in the wording of these books

It is found in many versions, just as the versions of some books of hadith may differ or some of the words may be changed in some versions, and this is contrary to the Qur’an. The Glorious One, whose words have been preserved in the chests through frequent transmission, does not need to be preserved in a book; As God Almighty said: {Indeed, it is We who have sent down the Remembrance, and indeed, We will be its guardian} [Al-Hijr: 9]. That is because the Jews before the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - During his reign and after him, they were spread throughout the east and west of the earth, and they had many copies of the Torah.

Likewise, the Christians have many copies of the Torah, and no one was able to collect and alter these copies, even if that were possible. This would be one of the great facts for which there are reasons to convey it. Likewise, in the Gospel, God Almighty said: {And let the people of The Gospel according to what God has revealed in it} [Al-Maeda:

47] So it was known that in this Gospel there is a ruling sent down by God Almighty, but the ruling is within the framework of commands and prohibitions, and that does not prevent it from being The change is in the section on information, which is the one in which the change occurred verbally. As for the rulings in the Torah, hardly anyone claims to have changed them. Its words.

A group of scholars have mentioned that what God Almighty says in the Gospel: “And let the people of the Gospel judge by what God has revealed in it” [Al-Ma’idah: 47] It is an address to those who followed the religion of Christ before the abrogation and alteration, not those who existed after the sending of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace.

This saying fits an apparent occasion for the reading of the one who reads “And let the people of the Gospel judge” by breaking the lam, like the reading of Hamzah, for this Lam Ki, for God Almighty said: {And We left in their tracks Jesus, son of Mary, confirming what was before him of the Torah, and We gave him the Gospel in which is guidance. And a light and a confirmation of what was before him of the Torah and a guidance and an admonition for the righteous - and so that the people of the Gospel may judge by what God has revealed in it and whoever does not. He judges by what God has revealed - it is they who are the transgressors.} [Al-Ma’idah: 46-47]

So when it was read, “And let him judge,” the meaning was, “And We gave him the Gospel for such-and-such, and let the people of the Gospel judge by what God revealed in it,” and this necessitates Judging by what God revealed in the true Gospel does not indicate that the Gospel existing at the time of the Messenger - may God bless him and grant him peace - is that. The Gospel.

As for the public reading “And let the people of the Gospel judge” [Al-Ma’idah: 47], it is an order for that. Among the scholars are those who said: It is an order for whom. The true Gospel existed with them, and they were required to judge by what God revealed in it, and on this basis His saying - the Most High -: “And let him judge” is a matter. to them before the sending of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and he said: Others have no need for this expense, for the saying in the Gospel is like the saying in The Torah, and God Almighty said:

{O Messenger, let not those who hasten to disbelief grieve you, among those who say, “We believe” with their mouths, but whose hearts do not believe, and among those who are Jews. Those who listen to lies are those who listen to other people who have not come to you. They distort words after their places, saying, “If you are given this, then take it.” But if not You give it, so beware. And whomever God intends to tempt, it will not possess for him anything from God. These are those whose hearts God did not want to purify for themselves in This world is a disgrace, and for them in the Hereafter is a great punishment - they are listeners to lies and devourers of wickedness. So if they come to you, judge between them or turn away from them. And if you turn away from them, they will not harm you at all, but if you judge, then judge between them with justice. Indeed, God loves those who are just. - And how can they judge you while in their presence? In the Torah is the judgment of God. Then they turn away after that, but those are not believers. Indeed, We have sent down the Torah, in which is guidance and light that gives judgment. With it are the prophets who submitted to those who are Jews, and the rabbis, and the rabbis, because they preserved the Book of God and were witnesses to it, so do not fear. people, and fear Me, and do not exchange My verses for a small price. And whoever does not judge by what God has revealed - those are the disbelievers - and We have decreed upon them therein that A life for a life, an eye for an eye, a nose for a nose, an ear for an ear, a tooth for a tooth, and wounds are retaliation, but whoever gives it in charity, it is an expiation. And whoever does not judge by what God has revealed - those are the wrongdoers - and We follow in their footsteps with Jesus, son of Mary, confirming what was before him. The Torah and We gave him the Gospel} [Al-Maeda:

41 - 46] This has clearly stated that those of the Jews who referred to the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - were judged. They have the Torah in which God’s judgment is. Then they turned away from God’s judgment and said: After that, “And let the people of the Gospel judge by what God has revealed in it” [Al-Ma’idah: 47] and this is the blame of the matter. It is a command from God that He revealed on the tongue of Muhammad, and the command of those who died before this speech is forbidden. Rather, the matter is a command for those who believe.

with it after God had spoken to His servants about the matter, and it was known that it was a command for those who were present at that time to judge by what God revealed in The Gospel, and God revealed in the Gospel the command to follow Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - As He commanded in the Torah, let them judge by what God revealed in the Gospel, which Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - did not abrogate; Just as he commanded the people of the Torah to judge by what he revealed, what Christ did not abrogate, and what he abrogated, they were commanded in it to follow Christ, and they were commanded In the Gospel, by following Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - whoever among the People of the Book after sending Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - ruled by what was revealed God, in the Torah and the Gospel, did not rule in a way that contradicts the ruling of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - since they were commanded in the Torah and the Gospel. By following Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - ; As God Almighty said:

{Those who follow the Messenger, the unlettered Prophet, whom they find written with them in the Torah and the Gospel} [Al-A'raf: 157] And He - the Most High - said: {And We sent down To you is the Book in truth, confirming what was before it of the Book and dominating it. So judge between them according to what God has revealed, and do not follow their inclinations. He has come to you from the truth} [Al-Ma’idah: 48].

So he made the Qur’an dominant. The dominant is the witness, the trustworthy arbiter. He judges according to what is in it, which God has not abrogated, and he bears witness to the truthfulness of what is in it, of what has not been changed, and for this reason He said: “For each of you We have made a law and a course of action” [Al-Ma’idah: 48] and this has been proven in the Sahihs, Sunnahs, and Musnads. In the two Sahih books, on the authority of Abdullah bin Omar - may God be pleased with them - he said: “The Jews came to the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - So they mentioned to him that a woman among them and a man had committed adultery, so he said:

They asked the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - what you find in the Torah regarding stoning. They said: We expose them and they are flogged. He said: Abdullah bin Peace, you lied that it included stoning. So they brought the Torah and spread it, and one of them put his hand on the verse about stoning and recited what came before it and what came after it, and said: Abdullah bin Salam told him: “Raise your hand.” He raised his hand, and lo, in it was the verse of stoning. They said: “You have spoken the truth, O Muhammad.” So the Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, ordered them to do so. He said hello - so they were stoned.

Al-Bukhari narrated on the authority of Abdullah bin Omar that he said: “A Jew was brought to the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - and he and a Jewish woman had committed adultery. So he set off until the Jews came and said: What do you find in the Torah regarding one who commits adultery? They said: We blacken their faces and circumambulate them. He said: {Then bring the Torah. So recite it if you are truthful.} [Al Imran: 93] He said:

So they brought it and recited it until when they passed the verse about stoning, the boy who was reading placed his hand on the verse about stoning and read what was before it and what was behind it. Then Abdullah bin Salam said, while he was with the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - command him to raise his hand. He raised it, and beneath it was the verse of stoning. They said: The verse about stoning is true, but we are keeping it secret among ourselves, and our rabbis introduced the prohibition and the stoning tax, so the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - ordered He, peace and blessings be upon him - stoned them both, and they were stoned.

Muslim narrated on the authority of Al-Baraa bin Aazib - may God be pleased with him - that he said: “A Jew who had bathed in water passed by the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace. He was flogged, so he called them and said: Is this how you find the punishment for an adulterer in your book? They said: Yes, so he called a man from their scholars and said: I ask you, by God who sent down the Torah to Moses, is this how you find the punishment for the adulterer in your book? He said:

No, had you not urged me to do this, I would not have told you. We find stoning, but it was widespread among our nobles, so if we took the honorable we would leave it. We took the weak and imposed punishment on him, so we said, “Come, let us come together on something that we will impose on the honorable and on the lowly.” So We made bathing and flogging a place. Stoning, and he said: The Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - O God, I am the first to revive your command when they killed him, so he ordered that he be stoned, so God sent down God Almighty {O Messenger, do not grieve you those who hasten into disbelief from among those who say, “We believe” with their mouths} [Al-Ma’idah: 41] to His saying:
Those are the disbelievers, to the wrongdoers, to the transgressors. He said: It is among the disbelievers in all of them.

And in Sahih Muslim on the authority of Jabir bin Abdullah - may God be pleased with him - that he said: “The Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - stoned a man who converted to Islam and a man who “From the Jews.”

As for the Sunan, it is in the Sunan of Abu Dawud on the authority of Zayd bin Aslam on the authority of Ibn Omar - may God be pleased with them both - that he said: “A group of Jews came So they called the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - to Al-Qaf, and he came to them in the school house, and they said: O Abu Al-Qasim, a man among us committed adultery with a woman. So judge between them. They placed a pillow for the Messenger of God - may God bless him and grant him peace - and he sat on it. Then he said: Bring me the Torah. So he brought it and he took it off. He took the pillow from under him and placed the Torah on it and said: I believe in you and in Him who sent you down. Then he said:
Bring me the most knowledgeable of you, and a young man was brought, then he mentioned the story of stoning.”

Abu Dawud and others also narrated on the authority of Abu Hurairah - may God be pleased with him - that he said: “A Jewish man committed adultery with a woman and he said: One to another. Take us to this prophet, for he is a prophet who was sent with relief. If he gives us a fatwa without stoning, we will accept it. We argued for it before God and said: A prophet from your prophets. They said: So they came to the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - while he was sitting in the mosque in His companions said: O Abu Al-Qasim, what do you see in a man or a woman among them committing adultery? He did not speak a word to them until he came to their school house and stood up. the door and said:
I adjure you by God who sent down the Torah to Moses: What do you find in the Torah regarding one who commits adultery when he is married? .

They said: We will give him a bath, and we will flog him, and the duty is that the two adulterers are carried on a donkey, and their buttocks are faced, and they are taken around. He said: And a young man remained silent. Among them, when the Prophet - may God’s prayers and peace be upon him - saw him remaining silent, he called him out and said: Oh God, when you have called upon us, we find in the Torah stoning, and he said: The Prophet - May God’s prayers and peace be upon him - What was the first time you took the command of God lightly? He said:

A relative of one of our kings committed adultery and stoning was delayed for him. Then a man among a family of people committed adultery and wanted to have him stoned, but his people prevented him and said: Our companion will not be stoned until you bring your companion and stone him. So they agreed upon this punishment among themselves. He said: The Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace -, for I I judge according to what is in the Torah. So he commanded that they be stoned.”

Al-Zuhri said: We have been informed that this verse was revealed about them: {Indeed, We have sent down the Torah, in which is guidance and light; by it the prophets who have submitted shall judge.} [Al-Maeda: 44] So the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - was one of them.

Also, they brought him to court regarding the dispute that took place between Banu Qurayzah and al-Nadir, and al-Nadir was more honorable than Qurayzah, so whenever some of them killed one of the If a member of the other tribe is killed, they kill him and do not double the blood money, and if he is killed from the honorable tribe, they kill him and double the blood money.

Abu Dawud Sulaiman bin Al-Ash’ath said in his Sunan, Muhammad bin Al-Ala’ narrated to us, Ubayd Allah bin Musa narrated to us, on the authority of Ali bin Salih, on the authority of Samak. Ibn Harb, on the authority of Ikrimah, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, said: “There were Qurayzah and al-Nadir, and al-Nadir was more honorable than Qurayzah. So if a man was killed by Qurayza killed a man from al-Nadir, and if a man from al-Nadir killed a man from Qurayza, a hundred wasq of dates was given.

When the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - was sent, “A man from al-Nadir killed a man from Qurayza, and they said: Give him to us, we will kill him.” They said: Between us and you. Muhammad, so they came to him, and then “And if you judge, judge between them with justice” [Al-Ma’idah: 42] “And justice, life for life,” was revealed. The people of the pre-Islamic era are seeking.” [Al-Ma’idah: 50] He said: Abu Dawud Qurayzah and An-Nadir are from the descendants of Aaron.

This has another place to be explained, and according to every statement, God - the Almighty - has told us that in the Torah that existed after the Messiah - peace be upon him - The judgment of God, and that the Jewish People of the Book abandoned the judgment of God that is in the Torah, along with their disbelief in Christ, and this is a rebuke from God to them for what They left out some of his ruling that was brought in the first book and the Messenger - may God bless him and grant him peace - did not abrogate it - the second:.

This is part of the second change: the one against whom they were censured, and this indicates that in the Torah that existed after the sending of the Messiah there was a ruling sent down by God. They were commanded To judge by it, and this is how it can be said in the Gospel.

It is known that the ruling with which they were commanded to rule is one of the rulings of the Torah and was not abrogated by the Gospel or the Qur’an. Likewise, what they were commanded to They rule by it from the provisions of the Gospel, which is something that the Qur’an did not abrogate, and that is because the comprehensive religion is to worship God alone and command what God commanded it and He judges by what God revealed in whatever book He sent down and did not abrogate, for He judges by it.

For this reason, the doctrine of the masses of the Salaf and the Imams was that those before us legislated for us what our law did not want contrary to it, and whoever ruled by the law abrogated, so he did not rule by what God revealed, just as God commanded the nation of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - to rule by what God revealed in the Qur’an. And it includes the abrogator and the abrogated. This is the saying regarding the type of revealed books.
God Almighty said:

{And We have sent down to you the Book with the truth, confirming what was before it of the Book and dominating it. So judge between them according to what Allah has revealed, and do not follow Their inclinations are beyond what has come to you of the truth. For each of you We have made a law and a course of action. And if God had willed, He could have made you one nation, but that He might test you in what He has come to you, so strive for good deeds. To Allah is the return of all of you, and He will inform you of that concerning which you differed - and that I should judge between them according to what Allah has revealed. Follow their inclinations and beware lest they tempt you from some of what God has revealed to you. But if they turn away, know that God only desires to befall them. For some of their sins, and indeed, many people are transgressors - are they then seeking the wisdom of ignorance? And who is better than God in judgment for a people who are certain - oh, Those who have believed, do not take the Jews and Christians as allies of one another. And whoever of you takes friends with them is from them. Indeed, God does not He guides the wrongdoing people - Then you see those in whose hearts is a disease hastening toward them, saying, “We fear that some calamity will afflict us.” Perhaps God will bring about conquest. Or a command from Him, and in the morning they will regret what they concealed within themselves - and those who believe will say: These are those who swore by God, the best of their faith. Indeed, in your presence, their deeds have become worthless, so they have become losers - O you who have believed! Whoever among you turns away from his religion - God will bring a people. He loves them and they love Him. They are humble toward the believers, honorable toward the disbelievers. They strive in the way of God and do not fear the blame of the blamer. That is the grace of God. He gives it to whom He wills, and God is All-Summary, All-Knowing. - Indeed, your guardian is God and His Messenger and those who have believed who establish prayer and pay zakat while they bow down. And whoever turns to Allah, and His Messenger, and those who believe, then indeed, it is the Party of Allah that will be victorious.} [Al-Maeda:

His Prophet Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - commanded him to rule according to what God revealed to him, and warned him against following their desires, and made clear that the one who opposes Because his ruling is the ruling of the pre-Islamic era, as God Almighty said: {Is the ruling of the pre-Islamic era? They seek, but who is better than Allah in judgment for a people who are certain?} [Al-Maeda:

50] And God Almighty informed him that He had appointed for each of the people of the Torah, the Gospel, and the Qur’an a law and a method, and God Almighty commanded him to rule according to God has revealed a general command to the people of the Torah, the Gospel, and the Qur’an. No one is permitted at any time to judge other than what God has revealed. What God has revealed is one religion upon which the books and messengers have agreed, and they agree in the principles of the religion and the rules of the Sharia, even if they differ in the Sharia. The method is between abrogated and abrogated, so it is similar to the diversity of the condition of one book, for the Muslims were first commanded to pray at home. The Holy Mosque, then they were commanded to pray to the Sacred Mosque, and in both matters they only followed what God - the Almighty - revealed.

Likewise, Moses - peace be upon him - was commanded to observe the Sabbath, forbidden to him what God had forbidden in the Torah, and he was following what God - the Almighty, the Majestic - had revealed. And the Messiah made lawful some of what God had forbidden in the Torah, and he was following what God - the Mighty and Majestic - revealed - so it is not in God’s command for the people of the Torah and the Gospel. To judge by what God has revealed, a command by what He has abrogated; Likewise, it is not in the matter of the people of the Qur’an to rule by what God has revealed that it is a matter of what has been abrogated. Rather, if it is abrogated and abrogated, then it is what God has revealed. It is the ruling by the abrogated rather than the abrogated. So whoever rules by the abrogated has ruled by something other than what God - the Mighty and Majestic - has revealed, and what clarifies this is His saying - the Almighty -:

{Say, “O People of the Book, you are not upon anything until you uphold the Torah and the Gospel and what has been sent down to you from your Lord.” And He will certainly add to many of them what What has been sent down to you from your Lord is transgression and disbelief, so do not despair over the disbelieving people.} [Al-Ma’idah:

68] This shows that this is an order for Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - to say to the People of the Book to whom he was sent that they are not on nothing until they establish the Torah and the Gospel and what was sent down to them from their Lord. This indicates that they have what is known to have been sent down from God. And they are commanded to establish it, since that was one of the

It was approved by Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - and he did not abrogate it. It is known that everything God commanded was on the tongue of a prophet and was not abrogated by the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace. And peace be upon him - the second. Rather, he approved it. God commanded it on the tongue of prophet after prophet, and there was nothing in the mission of the second that would nullify the obligation to follow what the prophet commanded. The first was decided by the second Prophet.

It is not permissible to say that God abrogates in the second book everything that He legislated in the first book, but what has been abrogated is small in comparison to what was The books and laws agreed on it.

Also, in the Torah and the Gospel there is evidence of the prophecy of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - so if the people of the Torah and the Gospel judged by what was revealed, God judged them both by making it obligatory for them to follow Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace.

This indicates that there is nothing in the Torah and the Gospel that they know that God sent down, since they were not commanded to judge by what God sent down, and they do not know. What God has revealed, the ruling is only about commands and prohibitions, and knowledge of some of the meanings of the books does not negate lack of knowledge of some of them, and this is agreed upon. Accordingly, in meanings, Muslims, Jews, and Christians agree that in the divine books there is a command to worship God alone, without any partner. And that He sent human messengers to creation, and that He made justice obligatory and forbade injustice, immoral acts, polytheism, and the like of that. Laws

Universality, and that it contains the promise of reward and the threat of punishment. Rather, they agreed on believing in the Last Day, but they disputed some of it. Its meanings and they differed in interpreting that; Just as the Jews and Christians differed regarding the Messiah whom the prophecies were heralding, is he the Messiah, the son of Mary - peace be upon him - or another Messiah? It is expected that the Muslims know that the correct thing in this is with the Christians, but they do not agree with them regarding the immorality and polytheism they have introduced into it.

Likewise, it is said that if a few of its declarative words are changed, this does not prevent most of its words from being changed, especially if There is something in the same book that indicates what was changed, and it may be said that whatever words in the Torah and the Gospel were changed, there is something in the same Torah and the Gospel that indicates By changing it, this is how the answer is obtained regarding the suspicion of those who say that none of its words were changed, for they say that if The change occurred in the words of the Torah and the Gospel before the sending of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - he did not distinguish truth from falsehood, so it was lost. They are used as evidence and it is obligatory for the People of the Book to act according to them, so they will not be blamed for abandoning their following.
The Qur’an has condemned them for abandoning the ruling according to what is in them, and has cited them in several places.

The answer to that is that what was changed was small, and most of it was not changed, and in which no explicit words were changed, the meaning of the word was made clear. Whatever contradicts it is wrong, and it has multiple evidence and counterparts, some of which confirm each other, unlike the changer, for it is a few words, and the rest of the texts of the books It contradicts it, and this has become like the books of hadith transmitted from the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - if it falls into the Sunan of Abu Dawud Al-Tirmidhi or others had few weak hadiths. There were in the authentic and proven hadiths on the authority of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - something that showed weakness. That one.

In fact, the same applies to Sahih Muslim, which contains a few incorrect words, and in the same authentic hadiths with the Qur’an there is nothing that shows their error, such as what was narrated that God created the soil on a Saturday and caused the creation of creatures in the seven days. This hadith has been explained by imams of hadith such as Yahya ibn Moin, Abd al-Rahman bin Mahdi, al-Bukhari, and others said that it was a mistake, and that it was not in the words of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - rather, Al-Bukhari stated In his great history, it is from the words of Ka’b al-Ahbar; As it was spread out in its place, and the Qur’an indicates the error of this, and makes clear that creation occurred in six days, and it is proven in the Sahih that the last of creation It was Friday, so the first day of creation would be Sunday.
Likewise, it was narrated that he - may God bless him and grant him peace - “He prayed the eclipse prayer by bowing two or three times.”

The proven hadith on the authority of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - in the two Sahihs and other than them is the hadith of Aisha, Ibn Abbas, and Abdullah bin Amr. And others said that he prayed each rak’ah with two bows, and for this reason Al-Bukhari did not narrate anything other than that, and Al-Shafi’i, Al-Bukhari, and Ahmad were weak in Uhud. The two narrations from him and others are the hadith of three and four. The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, only prayed the eclipse once and in the hadith of three. The fourth is that he prayed it on the day his son Ibrahim died, and the hadiths about bowing were that day, so if such a mistake occurred, it would have occurred in The same authentic hadiths do not show that it is wrong, and if Al-Bukhari narrated the hadith in some ways, he made a mistake in some of the wording, he mentioned it along with it. The methods that explain this mistake; As we have discussed this in detail in its place.

Likewise, if it was said that there was a change in some of the words of the previous books, there would be something in the books that would show you the error, and we have presented that Muslims do not claim that every copy in the world from the time of Muhammad - may God bless him and grant him peace - is in every tongue of the Torah, the Gospel and the Psalms. Its wording was changed. I do not know of any of the predecessors who said this, even if there were among the later people who might say that, as some of the later ones said. Whoever permits seeking cleansing with all the abrogations of the Torah and the Gospel in the world, these sayings and similar sayings are not from the sayings of the ancestors of the nation. And its imams, and Omar bin Al-Khattab - may God be pleased with him - when he saw in Ka’b Al-Ahbar’s hand a copy of the Torah, he said:
O Ka’b, if you know that this is the Torah that God sent down to Moses bin Imran, then read it and the matter will be settled.
For what is beyond knowledge, and Omar - may God be pleased with him - did not confirm that those words were changed, since he did not contemplate everything in them.

The Qur’an and the Mutawatir Sunnah indicate that the Torah and the Gospel that existed at the time of the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - contained in them what he revealed. God - the Mighty and Majestic - and asserting that this has been changed in all the versions in the world is impossible, and we have no need to mention it, and we have no knowledge of that, nor It is possible for any of the People of the Book to claim that every version of the Book in the world, in all languages, agrees on one word, for this Which it is not possible for any human being to know by testing and testing him, but such a thing is known only by revelation, otherwise no one can

It is human to compare every copy existing in the world with every copy of all tongues with the twenty-four books. We saw that they differed significantly in wording, and the Torah is the most correct and most famous book among Jews and Christians, and despite this The Samaritan version differs from the version of the Jews and Christians, even in the same ten words. The Samaritan version of it says something about The reception of the stage is something that is not in the copy of the Jews and Christians, and this indicates that the change occurred in many of the copies of these books. Samaria, multiple versions.

Likewise, we have seen in the Psalms multiple versions that differ greatly from one another in many of the words and meanings. Anyone who sees them is certain that Many of them are lies about the Psalms of David - peace be upon him - and as for the Gospels, the confusion in them is greater than in the Torah.

If it is said that if the previous books were abrogated, then why were the People of the Book condemned for abandoning judgment by what God revealed from them? It was said: Abrogation only occurred in a few of the laws. Otherwise, there is no abrogation in reporting about God, about the Last Day, and other than that.

Likewise, there is no abrogation in the comprehensive religion and universal laws, and He, Glory be to Him, condemned them for abandoning following the First Book. Because the People of the Book disbelieved in two ways: on the one hand, they changed the First Book, and abandoned faith and acting in part of it, and on the other hand, Their denial of the Second Book: which is the Qur’an, as God Almighty said: {And when it is said to them, “Believe in what God has revealed,” they say, “We believe in what God has revealed.” against Us, and disbelieve in what is behind it, while it is the truth, confirming what is with them. Say, “Why did you kill God’s prophets before, if you were believers?” [Al-Baqarah:
91] So he explained that before he was sent, they disbelieved in what was revealed to them and killed the prophets as

When he was sent, they disbelieved in what was revealed to him, and God Almighty said: “Indeed, God has covenanted with us that we will not believe in a messenger until he brings us an offering.” Fire will consume it. Say, “Messengers have come to you before me with clear proofs and with what you said. Then why did you kill them, if you were truthful?” [Al Imran: 183] And he said - God Almighty -: {And if they deny you, then indeed have been denied messengers before you. They brought clear proofs and the Psalms and the Book that enlightens} [Al Imran: 184] And God Almighty said:

{So when the truth came to them from Us, they said, “If only I had not been given the like of what Moses was given. Have they not disbelieved in what Moses was given before?” They said, “It is magic.” They pretended to do so. And they say, “Indeed, we are disbelievers in everything.” Say, “Then bring a book from Allah. It is better guided than them. I will follow it, if you are truthful.” [Al-Qasas: 48-49] And when The matter was like that, for He, Glory be to Him, condemns them for abandoning following what He revealed in the Torah and the Gospel and for abandoning following what He revealed in The Qur’an and explains their disbelief in the First Book and in the Second Book:
And in none of that, they are commanded to rule by what is abrogated from the first book. Nor is it their command to rule by what is abrogated in the second book.
